In this paper, aiming at the characteristics of high school mathematics text, such as strong logic, formula doping, including letters and numbers, a symmetrical twin network structure model combining CNN and BiLSTM is proposed. The local mathematical text feature matrix extracted by CNN and the global text feature matrix extracted by BiLSTM are modeled at different levels to obtain the deep level language features of sentences. Then the two similarity matrixes are fused and spliced to maximize the mathematical text features. Finally, the text similarity value is calculated by the matching layer, and then the answer score is obtained. The accuracy of the model is 84.3% when tested on real mathematics test questions. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Index Design of Electronic Medical Record Database Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Electronic Medical Record (EMR) is a kind of data, which is highly sensitive and worthy of biomedical research. The storage security, integrity, and data sharing of EMRs need further research and discussion. Blockchain is a block-chain storage structure, which has the characteristics of tamper-proof, traceability, and high sharing. Although blockchain technology provides a new solution for the storage and data sharing of EMRs, the research on user-oriented data query is not comprehensive. Traditional SQL database opens its data access, so the data stored in it has easily been tampered with, which is not suitable for storing sensitive medical data. Based on the characteristics of blockchain and traditional databases, we design a model with high security and easy retrieval for the storing and querying the EMRs. In the case of ensuring the safety of medical data storage, it is convenient for users to query and retrieve.

articleTitle: An FPGA-based 3D-2D RANSAC Architecture for Matching Feature Points in RGB-D Slam
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In RGB-D slam, 3D-2D RANSAC is an algorithm widely used to eliminate the mismatch between 3D camera coordinates. In this paper, an FPGA-based 3D-2D RANSAC architecture is proposed to achieve hardware acceleration. By simplifying matrix operations and reusing results, the calculation in the process of calculating hypothetical parameters is reduced by 67%. Besides, the architecture is pipelined to enhance the ability of image processing. In addition, self-regulation of the number of iterations is supported, which effectively speeds up the convergence of the iterative process. The proposed architecture is capable of processing any number of matching pairs between 42048, while reaching 130MHz on the Xilinx XC7V2000T FPGA platform. In the case of 2048 matching pairs which takes the most time per iteration, the system handles 126 fps video stream, and thus real-time requirement is met.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Planning and Construction of Rural Distribution Networks in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: After years of development, the rural distribution network in Xinjiang has achieved remarkable achievements, but the problem of uneven development of the distribution network is still serious. Due to the limited access to new energy, the unsound grid structure and the long distance of power supply, the problems of the difficulty in ensuring the quality of power supply, the low intelligent coverage, and the uneven development of North and South Xinjiang still need to be resolved. This paper makes an in-depth analysis and investigation of the current situation of the rural distribution network in Xinjiang, and the situation facing the rural distribution network in Xinjiang under the background of rural revitalization is studied. On this basis, the weakness of the rural power distribution network in Xinjiang are analyzed. Finally, according to the current situation of rural power distribution network planning and construction in Xinjiang, suggestions for future distribution network construction are proposed.

articleTitle: A Recognition Method For Radar Emitter Signals Based on EEMD and EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the weak representation ability under low signal noise ratio (SNR) in radar emitter signals recognition, a recognition method based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) noise reduction and EfficientNet is proposed. First, the appropriate EEMD parameters to denoise the time domain signals and Ambiguity Function Contour Map of Tangent Matrix (AFCMTM)' datasets are created. Then, a Deep Network based on EfficientNet-B0 model is established and Transfer Learning is used to complete the training of labeled data. Finally, the network is used to achieve radar emitter signals identification. The simulated experiments show that the average recognition accuracy rate of six kinds of complex modulated signals, i.e., BPSK, BFSK, FMCW, QPSK, LFM-BC and MSEQ, by proposed method keeps above 96.83% in fixed SNR environment above -5dB with good generalization ability and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Finding key actors on social movement networks through improved k-shell method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the age full of conflicts and contradictions, the frequency of social movements has increased. Finding keys actors in social movement networks is a very important task to protect the social stability and ensure citizen security. The structural organization of the social movement is a key factor of the problem. In this paper, by taking into account both the global attributes and local attributes of the nodes, we present an improved k-shell method to calculate the raking value of the nodes. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, three representative real social movement networks are introduced into this paper, which include The Milan environmental alliance network, Communication network of striking employees, 911 terrorist hijackers' network neighborhood. Comparing with the reality of the three representative real social movements, the proposed method could find key actors more accurately then ones generated by degree centrality, closeness centrality, betweenness centrality, eigenvector centrality, k-shell value methods. At the same time, the proposed method has less time complexity O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). This work would be helpful for intelligence analysis of social movements. Furthermore, it has the potential to be extended to large-scale social movement networks.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph of Multi-Source Heterogeneous Distribution Network Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To solve the problems that the business data in state grid corporation cannot be crossed professionally, and the data resources cannot be intelligently analyzed and managed, this paper proposes a knowledge graph construction method oriented for heterogeneous data sources. On the basis of multi-source data from marketing management system (MBS), production management system (PMS), geographical information system (GIS) collected by the big data technology, the semantic annotation method is used to extract the knowledge entities, attributions and relations from the structured, semi-structured and unstructured data firstly. Secondly, the knowledge graph is constructed through the knowledge fusion technology based on ontology fusion and instance fusion algorithms proposed in this paper. Finally, the ontology model for multi-source data is constructed. Experiments show that the proposed algorithms improve the matching degree and F1 score, and have better visualization ability.

articleTitle: Architecture design and hardware implementation of AES encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information society, network information security has attracted more attention. Traditional software encryption technology is becoming more and more difficult to ensure people's information security. How to quickly and efficiently ensure people's information security has become one of the key projects studied by scholars. Under this background, this paper designs a simple advanced encryption standard AES FPGA hardware implementation. The content includes the hardware structure design of AES encryption algorithm, comprehensive wiring with Quartus II 13.0, and simulation verification on Modelsim se 10.5.

articleTitle: Computer music and traditional music under the background of “Internet + Music” ‐‐ Take the film “Song of the Phoenix” for example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet era, Internet technology has penetrated into every aspect of people's life. The concept of “Internet +” has emerged, this concept is simply to the combination of information technology and traditional field on the Internet, the Internet and music combine words became the “Internet + music”, a combination of both the impact on the music culture industry greatly, have even changed the music industry's development trend. Professionals engaged in the field of music create through the Internet and make certain profits. But also due to the development of Internet technology, people can get lower and lower cost of the music culture, and consumers have grown accustomed to the habit of online music pay, this is a big challenge for traditional music, traditional development has been greatly impact, it is very difficult for traditional music to gain profits. It is difficult for traditional music to gain profits in music creation, music performance, music communication and other aspects, which leads to a huge obstacle to the development of traditional music. This paper mainly focuses on the development of music culture industry under the background of Internet +, and explores the development status of traditional music under the background of “Internet +” through the film song of the Phoenix.

articleTitle: The Influence of College Students' Self-Cognition and Learning Environment on Learning Concentration in Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Under the influence of the epidemic, online learning has become a new way for many college students to attend classes. Due to the characteristics of online learning, the learner's concentration has been a great concern. As two key factors in learning, self-cognition and learning environment are considered to be closely related to learning concentration. The paper aims to explore the specific effects of self-cognition and learning environment on learning concentration. This paper adopted a quantitative research approach, collecting 259 effective questionnaires through Sojump and the results indicated that self-cognition and learning environment have the significant effect on concentration in online learning. By exploring the influence of self-cognition and learning environment on concentration, it is helpful to improve the concentration of college students in online learning and enhance the learning effect of online learning.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal search problem of UAV based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Traditional genetic algorithm is prone to precocious problem. An improved genetic algorithm based on improved ring is proposed. First, the parent generation is improved and optimized by the improved circle method, then the offspring are obtained by crossing, and the inferior individuals produced after crossing are reduced by keeping the excellent genes to the maximum extent in the process of crossing, and the convergence rate is improved. The population diversity of the algorithm is guaranteed by improved ring and by choosing crossover probability and the mutation probability. Finally, the optimal search path is obtained by selecting the parent and offspring. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional Hamilton trilateral exchange algorithm, the improved genetic algorithm is simple, fast, and it can jump out of local convergence and obtain the optimal solution. It is a more reasonable UAV route method to solve the optimal search problem.

articleTitle: Construction of composite mode of sports education professional football teaching based on sports video recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Sports video recognition technology is a set of high-tech products, science and technology and football sports combined with a special equipment system. The main purpose of sports video recognition technology is to assist football teaching. With the help of modern science and technology, the accuracy of football teaching can be improved by replays in slow motion, motion capture, analysis of results and so on. This paper proposes a more characteristics and neural network combining sports video recognition model (MF-RBFNN), extracted respectively reflect the static and dynamic characteristics of sports video, and then the RBF neural network is adopted to static and dynamic characteristics of classification, respectively, The basic probability assignment is constructed for the preliminary identification results, and the identification results are fused by using relevant theories, The results show that it can improve the accuracy of sports video identification. The research results can be applied to physical education and football teaching, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: MBSE-based functional hazard assessment of civil aircraft braking system
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Safety is the basic condition that civil aircraft needs to guarantee. Safety analysis is one of the key processes in the aircraft design phase. Functional hazard assessment is the first step required for safety analysis. Its integrity affects the entire safety assessment process, and even it is the basic outline document for the entire aircraft design. The aircraft brake system is one of the key systems to ensure the aircraft deceleration on the ground, especially at low speeds is the only system that decelerates the aircraft. In the safety analysis, the aircraft brake system is the key to whether the aircraft can land safely. This paper proposes a model based system engineering (MBSE)-based functional hazard assessment construction process for aircraft brake systems. It provides guidance for the aircraft to further carry out the overall design of the aircraft from a system perspective, and effectively improves the efficiency of aircraft safety analysis.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Role of Social Network in the Field of Anti-Terrorism Take the "East Turkistan" Organization as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to analyze the network structure of the “East Turkistan” organization and identify members with higher individual threats, so as to conduct a better attack on the “East Turkistan” organization. We use Gephi, a network analysis software, and collect open source information on three batches of 25 terrorists announced by the Ministry of Public Security and use networkX, a Python package to study the structure of complex networks, to conduct social network analysis(SNA) of the “East Turkistan” organization personnel. The “East Turkistan” organization presents a combination of scale-free network and hierarchical network in the topological structure. To manifest the analysis of social network methods' importance in combating terrorism, we simulate the effect of removing the core members of the “East Turkistan” organization. The construction of SNA requires a large deal of open source information. How to obtain intelligence is an important factor that restricts precision strikes. In addition, how to combine social network analysis with computer deep learning knowledge is also a new hot spot and direction in the field of anti-terrorism.

articleTitle: Development and realization of home online teaching system based on video data analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the outbreak of the COVID-19, most students can only take classes online at home. However, many students cannot consciously control their learning behaviors when they are in class at home, and some negative learning behaviors such as sleeping on the table or wandering have appeared. These negative learning behaviors greatly affect the effectiveness of learning. In order to deal with these problems, a online teaching system based on human action recognition is developed to assist teachers in real-time capturing the class status of classmates and improve the efficiency of home-based online teaching. Here, the system uses the OpenPose human body gesture recognition algorithm to obtain the key points of the student's body in class in front of the camera, and recognizes the student's class behavior through the analysis of the coordinates. The RTMP protocol is used to solve the problem of audio and video transmission during the live broadcast. We have conducted experiments to show the effectiveness of our system for analyzing the status of students and evaluating the online class.

articleTitle: Adaptive K-valued K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on particle swarm optimization (PSO), the algorithm for selecting appropriate K values is improved by combining k-mean algorithm. When the algorithm converges, the expansion and reduction of K value can be determined by comparing the relationship between different K value selection and global optimal fitness. Experiments show that the improved algorithm can assist K value selection effectively and obtain a better clustering effect.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System Based on Big Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rapid popularization of the Internet has promoted the transformation of the Internet industry, and a large number of new businesses have emerged. It has ushered in new development opportunities and challenges in all walks of life. Information technology is deeply integrated with human production and life, global data is showing explosive growth, and the problem of information explosion is getting worse. With the increasing volume of data, people's ability to understand and process data is limited. How to help individuals effectively manage these data and help them obtain the information they need is extremely important. Researchers try to use information filtering technology to solve the problem of information overload. Big data mining technology represented by personalized recommendation has become an important tool. This article discusses related theories such as big data and big data mining technology, and uses it as a guide basis, combined with related recommendation algorithms, to build a personalized recommendation system based on big data mining technology. The article analyzes the application cases of personalized information recommendation systems in some industries, discusses the processing methods and basic processes of massive data mining, analyzes the basic framework of personalized recommendation systems, and provides references for data mining and application researchers and related workers.

articleTitle: Principle and Application Research of Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the increasing size and complexity of modern industrial production, the requirements for control systems are becoming higher and higher. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is a population-based stochastic optimization method. This paper first introduces the origin, principle and implementation steps of PSO algorithm, and then introduces the application of particle swarm algorithm in control system. In this paper, the fuzzy control strategy based on particle swarm optimization is proposed to improve the performance of fuzzy control. The design idea and implementation of the control strategy are described in detail. Finally, the system simulation is carried out with Matlab, and the simulation results are compared and analyzed. The results show that the control strategy can effectively improve the dynamic quality and steady-state accuracy of the control system, and has a good practical application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of Microgrid Load Frequency Control Based on V2G Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The vehicle to grid (V2G) technology of electric vehicles brings a new direction to the load frequency control (LFC) of the microgrid. The research and development of microgrid technology can improve and accelerate the large-scale integration of distributed power and renewable energy into the grid system, and it is a key technology from traditional grid to smart grid. Through the “source-load” characteristics of electric vehicles, the feasibility of V2G technology participating in microgrid load frequency is analyzed. The working principle of diesel generator set (classic micro-grid generator system) and electric vehicle is described, and a general and accurate dynamic mathematical model of micro-grid load frequency control based on V2G technology is established. The established model provides a basis for the design and research of control strategies and algorithms for microgrid LFC problems based on V2G technology, and provides a theoretical basis for the development of microgrid technology and smart grid modeling.

articleTitle: Assessment of aero-engine service reliability based on Akaike information criterion
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To solve the problem that it is hard to choose the best model when the sample data test satisfies two or more kinds of distribution models, Akaike information criterion(AIC) was used for model selection in aero-engine reliability assessment. And 261 cases of failure data from three types of military aero-engines were chosen to test the effectiveness of the AIC. Results show that the AIC can choose the better fitting model than the traditional model.

articleTitle: Design of High Reliability Control Strategy for Automatic Fire Protection System of Offshore Booster Station
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The fire safety of offshore booster station has an extremely important impact on the reliable operation of the whole offshore wind farm. The article establishes the corresponding fire protection scheme around the offshore wind turbine group, offshore booster station and the on-land central control center of the offshore wind farm. Among them, each offshore wind turbine, offshore booster station and onshore centralized control center are equipped with independent fire alarm systems. The inspiratory smoke detector and point type composite smoke and temperature detector are mainly used to confirm the secondary alarm. At the same time, the fire extinguishing systems of offshore wind turbines, offshore booster stations and on-land control centers are: high-pressure CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fire extinguishing system, fine water mist fire extinguishing system and water spray fire extinguishing system. Finally, combined with an engineering case, the fire protection scheme of an offshore wind farm is designed.

articleTitle: A Field Programmable Process-In-Memory Architecture Based on RRAM Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Conventional reconfigurable architectures, e.g., Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), are confronted with the inflexibility of the on-chip local memory architecture and the scarce memory resource, which result in the inflexibility to deal with the current memory-thirsty data-intensive applications. Emerging nonvolatile devices, such as resistive random-access memory (RRAM), can operate in a logic-in-memory way, i.e., they can act as both a nonvolatile memory element and a switch, and thus, have the potential to provide higher flexibility and data processing ability. We propose a field-programmable logic-in-memory architecture based on RRAM technology, which is a two-dimensional tile array, where each tile is an RRAM-based crossbar array and can be remolded into three basic modes including logic, interconnect and memory. We further develop a specific adaptive algorithm for placement and routing, which can well exploit the logic-in-memory architecture characteristics. Comparing with traditional FPGAs, our architecture shows 1.9x lower power consumption, 2.8x lower delay, and 5.6x higher performance.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Hardware Platform for Predictive Maintenance of Coal Mine Reducer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems in the operation and maintenance mode of coal mine reducer, such as poor real-time and flexibility, high cost, insufficient data collection. an embedded hardware platform is designed, and its working principle and hardware composition are introduced in detail. The platform collects the vibration acceleration, vibration velocity and temperature signals of coal mine decelerator, and conducts fast Fourier transform, envelope spectrum analysis and other processing to obtain the health status of each key part of coal mine decelerator. The practical application shows that the platform has stable performance, meets the requirements of field real-time analysis and flexible layout, and the prediction results have high reliability and small error.

articleTitle: Abnormal Detection of Track Fastener Based on Improved YOLOV3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the low efficiency and insufficient accuracy of manual inspections in traditional railway track maintenance, an improved YoloV3 (you only look once V3)algorithm is proposed to detect abnormalities of track fasteners. First, the K-means++ algorithm was used to make some clustering analysis of the data set from the rail fastener, and determine the height-width ratio and the number of prediction boxes. Then, according to the characteristics of the track fastener size, the network multi-scale recognition was improved to solve the problem that YoloV3 can not recognize when the target box size is too small. For the last, the loss function, using GIOU(Generalized Intersection over Union)loss instead of the MSE(the Mean Square Error)loss, prevents abnormal change of the scale. Meanwhile, the imbalance between positive and negative samples is also settled by using Focal Loss instead of the cross entropy loss. The results show that the high rate of data detection with Yolo V3 algorithm can reach a speed of 37 frame/s and the average precision is as high as 93.51 %, which is 10.64% higher than that of original network. The result indicates the accuracy and efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Exploration on Big Data Education for Computer majors in Applied Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the teaching process of computer major in applied colleges and universities, the full application of big data education can improve the overall education level of computer major. In the teaching process of computer major, big data thinking and big data application ability should be listed as the key teaching content. Therefore, it is necessary to study and analyze the big data education of computer major in applied colleges and universities, to discuss the main components and main points of learning of big data ability education, and to promote the innovation of teaching methods and teaching schemes of computer major in applied colleges and universities. Only in this way can we cultivate students' big data thinking and improve students' big data application ability.

articleTitle: Deep Residual Network Based Road Detection Algorithm for Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an important recognition target in remote sensing images, roads can be widely used in many fields and has great significance. However, there are still some difficulties in the accurate identification of roads. Firstly, remote sensing images have high-resolution features, which provide more detailed features but also generate more complex background interference; secondly, different spatial resolution leads to different morphology of roads in images, such as different sizes of rural and urban roads, different road materials. These cause great difficulties for the detection of road targets. At present, most of the methods are based on the classification of spectral features, while ignoring other high-dimensional features. In recent years, with the development of artificial intelligence, deep learning has played a unique and outstanding role in many fields, image target detection has become a hotspot field, and many outstanding technologies have emerged. In this paper, a deep residual network-based remote sensing image road detection model is adopted to address the above problems, and the model is finally trained on Massachusetts Roads Dataset to perform road detection. The experimental results show that the model is trained to effectively and accurately identify road targets in the remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Research on underwater fluidic thrust vectoring method based on active flow control technique
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new underwater thrust vectoring method based on active flow control technique is proposed and investigated experimentally. The main merits of this technique compared with traditional steering methods such as rudders and mechanically vectoring propellers are its high efficiency and low noise. The mechanism behind this technique is briefly introduced. A prototype and an experimental platform are designed and tested. The steering force measured using force sensor under different conditions is analyzed briefly. The flow field is also given which certificates the feasibility of flow vectoring using active flow control.

articleTitle: A Research on the Fruit Recognition Algorithm Based on the Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of recognizing fruits, this paper proposes a fruit recognition algorithm based on color features and shape features. Firstly, the fruit image is preprocessed to obtain the target area of the image. Then, the HSV color model is chosen to analyze its histogram and extract its color features. After this, the contour method is used to extract the shape features of the fruit. Finally, the victor of color features and one of shape features are optimized and combined, and the BP neural network is used to train and classify the test samples. After testing, comparing and analyzing the different features of the input layer respectively, the research result shows that the classification and recognition rate of this algorithm is above 95%, which is higher than that of the single feature algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Identification Method of Silkworm Cocoon Species Based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Silkworm cocoon species identification is a key technical link to realize the intelligent sorting of silkworm cocoons. In order to realize the rapid and accurate identification of some species of group cocoons, an improved YOLOv3 colony cocoon species detection model-CBL-YOLOv3 model is proposed. Taking macular cocoons, rotten cocoons and reelable cocoons as the research objects, the YOLOv3 model is improved: K-means clustering is adopted to obtain the aspect ratio of the prior frame of silkworm cocoons, the composition ratio in the loss function is designed, and the network structure of the model is also modified. The CBL-YOLOv3 model is tested from two aspects: visual effects and evaluation indicators. The test result shows that the detection effect of the CBL-YOLOv3 model is superior to the traditional YOLOv3 model in terms of accuracy and speed, which can meet the needs of real-time detection of group cocoons.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Research and Application of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, artificial intelligence, big data and other technologies are gradually integrated into daily production and life. The Internet of Things technology based on information technology has also received many new development opportunities, innovating people's production methods. This article summarizes the technical content of the Internet of Things based on previous work experience. The author discusses the application form of the Internet of Things based on information technology from six aspects: smart home and smart transportation, smart city, Internet of Things industry, Internet of Things security, communication transmission mode, and smart warehouse management system.

articleTitle: Research of Scratch Programming Recommendation System Based on MED and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, children's programming education and primary and secondary school programming education are gradually gaining importance. After the State Council issued relevant documents on the development of artificial intelligence, the status of programming education for primary and secondary schools has been improved. At the same time, in order to improve learning efficiency, it is especially important to build a personalized programming topic recommendation system that takes into account the differences in learning ability and learning characteristics of different learners. This paper introduces a knowledge graph based on the traditional recommendation method, divides a single program block in Scratch programming into several knowledge points that are related to each other, processes the strings and calculates the editing distances according to the topics, finds out the similarities between the topics, combines the difficulty of the topics and knowledge points, and then designs a personalized recommendation system for Scratch programming topics based on the editing distances and knowledge graphs based on the learners' historical answer data, which effectively improves the recommendation accuracy.

articleTitle: Diagnosis for transformer winding Looseness based on LMD- Hilbert marginal spectrum energy entropy and SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the vibration signals are nonlinear and time-varying since the no-load closing of a transformer, a fault feature extraction method that combines local mean decomposition (LMD) and Hilbert marginal spectrum energy entropy is proposed. Several product function (PF) components that reflect the mechanical state information of operating process are extracted by LMD. The top 6th order components that are selected based on the energy distribution and correlation coefficients, are transformed by Hilbert transform, and their marginal spectrum energy entropy are calculated as the feature quantities. Grid search algorithm is used to optimize the support vector machine classifier to identify the different states of transformer winding. The experimental results show that the features based on LMD-Hilbert marginal spectrum energy entropy extraction can accurately reflect the fault characteristics, and the SVM diagnosis method has a good effect on in the case of a small number of samples.

articleTitle: Electric lock screw tool sliding wire detection system and method based on motor characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Electric locking screw tools are often used in factory production. This tool uses a motor to drive the screwdriver head clamped by the fixture to rotate to achieve screw locking. Some of this electric locking screw tool looks like a thousand-hand drill, which is manually used by workers, and some is installed at the end of the manipulator as an automated tool. Whether it is manual or automated, companies have found a pain point in the process of using this tool to assemble screws, sometimes there will be slippage, and it is difficult to find such slippage during the installation process, if not handled in time, this slippage will cause poor assembly, which will seriously affect product quality. Therefore, this paper proposes a sliding wire detection system and method for electric lock screw tools based on the characteristics of the motor, which realizes the real-time detection and alarm of the sliding wire, and has the advantages of simplicity and low cost.

articleTitle: Image clearness method based on improved Retinex
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the visibility of the aerial image with low contrast and lJow brightness, a changing scale Retinex algorithm based on scene depth information is studied in this paper. Firstly, the original image is converted from RGB color space to HIS color space, which is more comfortable for human eye features. Then the H component is ensured invariantly while the S component is stretched linearly by an adaptive stretching algorithm; the I component is adjusted by an improved Retinex algorithm, the scale of Retinex is changing according to the scene depth information of the image, which can provide significant improvement in contrast and brightness and enrich the detail information. Experiment result shows that the proposed algorithm has good clearness effect and fast speed, especially for the aerial images with greatly difference in scene depth.

articleTitle: Development of mechanical part of traction reduction device for upper arm fracture
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on numerical control technology, a traction reduction and correction device for upper arm fracture is proposed and designed in this paper. Drawing lessons from numerical control technology, the device is equipped with four working platforms: X-axis, Y-axis, Z-axis and rotating axis. The rotating shaft adopts the structure of motor+rotating shaft to realize the rotation movement of bones. We can choose the model of the motor according to the tension provided by the screw; according to the lead, stroke and nominal diameter of the screw, the rated static load of the screw meets the requirements; calculate the allowable torque of the coupling according to the motor speed, and then query and select the model of the coupling according to the calculated allowable torque; check the torsional stiffness of the rotating shaft according to the diameter and length of each shaft section. This subject replaces manpower with machinery, which solves the problem that manual reduction cannot be reduced due to insufficient reduction force, and is an innovation of medical equipment in the treatment of upper arm fracture.

articleTitle: An Improved Off-Grid Algorithm Based on CoSaMP for ISAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the application of ISAR imaging based on compressed sensing recovery algorithm, due to the division of sparse basis discrete grids, off-grid phenomenon often occurs, which greatly reduces the imaging quality. This paper proposes an improved algorithm based on compressive sampling matching pursuit (CoSaMP) to solve the off-grid problem in CoSaMP by linearizing the model. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by the measured data of Mig-25.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Improving Methods of Image Transmission Quality in Power Field
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet technology, the types and number of terminals in substations have shown an explosive growth trend, which puts forward higher requirements for image compression and image processing capabilities. Therefore, this paper proposes a method to improve the quality of power image transmission. Firstly, the eigenvalues and special vectors of the image are obtained, and then the wavelet transform method is used to encode the image, and finally the compressed image after decoding is obtained. Based on a typical field case, the comparison of experimental data under various algorithms is carried out. The results show that the improved method proposed in this paper has better image compression quality and higher peak signal-to-noise ratio, and improves the transmission quality of substation field monitoring images. It provides new technical ideas for the development of big data processing of electric power images.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Matching Optimization of Human-machine Interface in the Cab
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, by understanding the development status of human-machine interface in today's automobile cab, a subjective and objective evaluation system for evaluating the optimization of human-machine interface matching in automobile cab was established. The man-machine interface of the car cab was divided into a hard interface and a soft interface. Objective evaluation method of software human factor analysis is used to evaluate the hard interface matching optimization; the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to establish the evaluation index system for the soft interface matching optimization, and the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to evaluate the soft interface matching optimization. This article takes Dongfeng Sokon (DFSK) C37 model automobile as an example. The evaluation method given in the paper is used to carry out relevant analysis and evaluation, and corresponding optimization suggestions are given, which have certain reference value for designers.

articleTitle: Application of particle swarm optimization in parameter identification of power electronic circuits
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Power electronic circuit parameter identification is the main means to judge the state of the circuit. Through identification, we can know whether there is a fault in the circuit, so the parameter identification of power electronic circuit is very important. However, there are some defects in the previous identification work, which can only work on part of the device, but it is difficult to identify the other part of the device, so the characteristic parameters of this kind of device can not be obtained, which shows that the previous power electronic circuit parameter identification methods need to be optimized. In view of this, the relevant fields put forward the optimization scheme of particle swarm optimization algorithm. It is believed that the algorithm can make up for the defects of previous power electronic circuit parameter identification. This paper will also study this problem, elaborate the specific application mode of the algorithm, and carry out simulation and physical experiments on the application results to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital Beam Forming Based On A Kind Of Multicarrier Wideband Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The waveform generation module is an important part of the beam forming of the digital array radar. In this paper, a kind of multi-carrier wideband waveforms is designed for the transmission beam forming. The waveforms are synthesized from the LFM waveforms, which combines the advantages of the LFM waveforms and the synthesized broadband waveforms. They have the characteristics of high range resolution, large bandwidth, and small instantaneous bandwidth. The multi-carrier wideband waveforms have a good synthesis direction of transmission beam and the beams can be flexibly controlled. There is no obvious distortion, and the method is simple to calculate because the hardware requirements are not high. So the multi-carrier wideband waveforms are suitable for digital beamforming.

articleTitle: Motion Measurement Method for Dual Magnetic Dipole of Different Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A real-time measurement method of the motion of a dual-alternating magnetic dipole radiation source with different frequencies is proposed in this paper. Based on the accurate estimation method of the parameters of the dual-frequency signal, the magnetic field intensity of each magnetic dipole is calculated. According to the linear relationship between the magnetic field of the magnetic dipole and its gradient tensor, the spatial coordinates of the magnetic dipole are calculated, so as to achieve continuous motion measurement. In this paper, the method is derived, and the motion measurement test is carried out by using the measured data. The results show that the method can get accurate measurement results under proper conditions. The calculation of the method is simple, the real-time performance is great, and it has a good engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on Application of University Student Behavior Model Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the collection and sorting of data on the study and life of college students, a student behavior model is constructed. The model covers several dimensions of data such as clothing, food, housing, transportation, and extracurricular entertainment during school. Heterogeneous and multidimensional data containing student behavior information is cleaned, integrated, mined and applied, and potentially, valuable, and potentially application-valued information is extracted from it for the school's teaching, research, logistics, catering, security, and enrollment provide scientific data support for various tasks, so as to serve the education, service and management of college students. In the process of building a big data analysis platform, firstly, effectively integrate the basic data of higher vocational colleges and build various standard databases, including the integration of basic data such as college information management system data, all-in-one card consumption data, and library borrowing data. Broken the information separation between the various functional departments in the school, establish a standardized data sharing and coordination mechanism, and optimize the transfer and sharing of resources between departments.

articleTitle: A Remote Monitoring System for Spanning Racks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the safety risk in the construction of spanning racks in the construction of new transmission lines or in the maintenance of transmission lines without power cut, a remote monitoring system of spanning racks is developed, in which the real-time monitoring and fault warning of various states in the construction of spanning racks are carried out. The data collected by sensors are transmitted to the monitoring center by Wireless Communication, and the system has the corresponding automatic control function to control the spanning racks with automatic lifting function. The monitoring system will provide safety guarantee for electric power safety construction.

articleTitle: Continuous Improvement of College English Teaching Based on Quantitative Analysis of Course Objective Achievement
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The introduction of Outcomes-based Education (OBE) in College English teaching can help to carry out student-oriented education. The OBE teaching method is guided by students' learning outcomes, and it can feedback the continuous improvement. Based on the OBE teaching concept, this paper presents a continuous improvement method for college English teaching based on quantitative analysis of course objective achievement. Based on this method, the teaching effect of College English can be evaluated quantitatively, and weaknesses in teaching can be found to implement a closed-loop of continuous improvement. The methods presented in this paper can improve the quantitative evaluation methods of College English teaching quality and provide strong support for the continuous improvement of College English teaching. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Laser thermal lens measurement based on Michelson interferometer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a laser thermal lens measuring device which is based on equal inclination interference fringes produced by Michelson interferometer is realized. In this experiment, the thermal effect of low power laser can be observed as the ink sample after dilution has good endothermic properties. The experimental results show that the number of bright and dark rings is 6 in the absence of medium. With the increase of the concentration of the ink sample, the number of dark rings is also changing, and the spacing is relatively larger. Therefore, the thermal lens effect of laser can be observed by adjusting device. The focal length of the thermal lens is also calculated. The device has high application value in the study of laser thermal lens effect and medium absorption.

articleTitle: Intelligent monitoring system for danger sources of infrastructure construction site based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To master the real-time security status of the infrastructure construction site, an intelligent monitoring system for the recognition of the danger sources at infrastructure construction site, which is based on the theory of depth learning, is proposed. The monitoring system mainly includes signal acquisition equipment, internal optical network, server control center and display terminal. The intelligent identification algorithm of the danger sources is the core of the entire system. The characteristics from the image signal are extracted by the sparse self-coding, which is used to train the neural network. Then, the convolution is proposed to reduce the dimensionality of the features. The experiments confirm that the identification algorithm based on deep learning illustrates high accuracy in hazard identification. In terms of feedback, the identification results will be transmitted to the display terminal, and the safety status of the entire infrastructure construction site can be fully controlled to ensure the safety of both the infrastructure site and the power system.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Innovation of College Chinese Teaching Model in the Internet Age
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology can change people's lives and working methods to a large extent, and the application of Internet technology in the field of education is of great help to the improvement of education level and quality. As a public basic course offered by many colleges and universities, college Chinese has more or less problems in the teaching process. These problems directly affect the overall teaching level of college Chinese. At present, the state has made clear arrangements for the construction of new liberal arts. Under the requirements of the new era, in the context of the development of the Internet, in order to enable college Chinese to keep up with the development of the times and germinate new vitality, we need to research and analyze the innovative mode of college Chinese teaching in the Internet era. At the same time, we must also propose effective innovative strategies for college Chinese teaching so as to promote the modern development of college Chinese. Keywords: Internet; College Chinese; Teaching Mode; Innovation Strategy.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-filament Spindle Entangling Control System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the low degree of automation, high manual inspection threshold, and no objective quantitative indicators for the detection standards of the Y731 cohesion machine currently used in fiber inspection, a fully automated raw silk cohesion inspection method using line array camera for raw silk image collection is proposed. The system is composed of a synchronous multi-filament entanglement inspection device, a photoelectric counting module, a tool holder control module, a camera moving module, and an image processing module. After the threading is completed, the original thread image is automatically collected and saved. At this time, the tool holder will reciprocate and rub the thread after reaching a predetermined number of times and stop. The line scan camera collects images again and processes them, marks the cracking points and decides how many times to rub again until half of the cracks are reached, and finally save all the images for subsequent query. The test results show that the system can automatically complete the enclosing inspection process and realize electronic inspection, which greatly improves inspection efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Review on the Research Progress of the Tidal Stream Turbines
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tidal current energy is a rich Marine resource. Compared with other energy sources, it is predictable and the flow rate is stable. For horizontal axis tidal turbine, this paper expounds the development of horizontal axis tidal turbine from scientific research institutions at home and abroad, and introduces the “windmill” type, dome type, “hollow” tubular trend to turbine blade design and hydraulic performance study. This study is of certain significance to the turbine performance optimization.

articleTitle: Gap Loss for Production Status Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to classify the monitoring model of the production state system more accurately and effectively, and accelerate the convergence speed of the model, a new loss function Gap Loss function is proposed. The image data and sensor data collected by the system in real time are used as feature data, the five self-defined states are the learning targets, and Gap Loss is used instead of the cross-entropy loss function for model training. Experimental verification shows that this method can more effectively classify production states compared with the cross entropy Loss function.

articleTitle: On Black-Hole Numbers of Iteration of Digital Biquadratic Sum in Base 7, 11, 13 or 14
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are different periodic and fixed points under the iteration of biquadratic sum of digits of positive integer in different carry systems. There are one fixed point, one 3-circle, one 4-circle, one 6-circle, one 8-circle and one 12-circle in base 7; three fixed points, one 2-circle, one 7-circle and one 18-circle in base 11; two fixed pointsk, two 2-circles, one 5-circle, one 7-circle and one 11-circle in base 13; one fixed point, one 2-circle and one 13-circle in base 14.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Mechanical Automation in the Field of Food Packaging
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At this stage, China has increased its research efforts in mechanical and electronic technology, which has also promoted the application advantages of mechanical automation in various industries, and the same is true in the food packaging industry. Based on previous work experience, the author summarizes the necessity of automatic control of food packaging machinery. This article discusses the application of mechanical automation in the field of food packaging from four aspects: automatic control form of food packaging machinery, automatic controller of food packaging machinery, application of drive and sensor technology, and application of automatic identification technology.

articleTitle: Group ID Authorized -Based Certificateless Encryption with Equality Test
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Ciphertext equivalence test can compare data encrypted by different public keys. In electronic medical applications, only users within the patient group are expected to be able to test the equivalence of ciphertext. Based on certificateless public key cryptosystem and group user authorization mechanism, this paper designs a ciphertext equivalence test encryption scheme with group user authorization. Firstly, the framework of group id authorized-based certificateless encryption with equality test (GACLEET) is proposed. Secondly, this paper proposes a specific GACLEET scheme and analyzes the correctness of the scheme. Finally, based on the random oracle model, it is proved that the scheme has OW-CCA and IND-CCA security. The scheme can not only solve the key escrow problem of group id-based encryption with equality test scheme, but also realize group granularity authorization and equivalent testing functions.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Distribution Transformer with Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Transformer is the most important component of power transmission and distribution system. An integrated distribution transformer is developed in this paper, which is suitable for harsh environments. Vacuum circuit breaker is adopted as the high-voltage switch of the transformer. In order to improve the protection ability and operation reliability of the transformer, vacuum circuit breaker and transformer body are encapsulated in the oil tank together. The transformer internal structure is optimized. The electric field and the temperature field inside the transformer are simulated and analyzed, so as to obtain the reasonable insulation and heat dissipation design.

articleTitle: Expression of Concern: A white-box cryptographic SM2 scheme based on space hardness
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The operating environments of a cryptographic algorithm have important impacts on its security. Traditional cryptographic algorithms need to run in a secure and trusted environment, in which case the internal state of these algorithms cannot be accessed by the outside. Namely, the cryptographic programs need to run under the black-box model. With the development of science and technology, the application scenarios of cryptographic algorithms are diversified, resulting in increasingly uncontrollable operating environments for cryptographic algorithms. White-box attack is a kind of terminal-based attack, which assumes that an adversary has complete control over the terminal. With this kind of attack, secret data can be easily exposed. In this paper, we propose a defense method based on strong (M,Z)- space hardness. The core idea is to put the secret value into the look-up table through some mathematical transformations. When the volume of the look-up table obtained by an adversary is limited, the secret value such as the private key cannot be recovered in polynomial time. Therefore, our proposed method is safe and efficient based on space hardness. We have designed a white-box implementation of SM2 digital signature algorithm to protect the private key under white-box attack. The main ideas presented in this paper can also be applied to constructing the white-box implementations of other asymmetric cryptographic algorithms.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Positioning and Support System for Field Operations based on Beidou
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper implements an adaptive field positioning support system based on Beidou navigation and positioning system design. The system designed in this paper makes full use of the positioning function and short message communication function of Beidou, achieves positioning and position reporting, and constructs a user-oriented adaptive function, which can effectively improve the efficiency of Beidou user terminal positioning, the efficiency of user terminal power management, and has the switching function of multiple working modes, so as to work in different field environments. The system designed and implemented in this paper can improve the application effect of Beidou in field operation positioning, and provide better decision support for personal safety and rescue of field workers.

articleTitle: Innovation and Development of Ideological and Political Work in the Context of Computer Technology and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The development of any subject can not be separated from effective research methods, ideological and political education is no exception. The technological advantages under the background of big data, the advantages of massive information storage and innovative thinking provide great convenience for the data collection and collation, analysis and screening of ideological and political education. As a research community of ideological and political work, when promoting the ideological and political education work of universities, enterprises or other organizations, we should meet the needs of the development of the times, set up big data thinking, master the analysis and storage technology of big data, so as to realize the accurate research of ideological and political work.

articleTitle: Method of Microservices Division for Complex Business Management System Based on Dual Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The collaborative development process of complex products has the characteristics of strong relevance, and this brings difficulties to the design of business management systems. To solve this problem, a microservices division method based on the business function hierarchy, which can solve the problem of strong business coupling, was proposed. Firstly, based on the concept of microservices, and according to the features of the business function hierarchy, the mapping relationship between business requirements and system services was established. Then, the business process was analyzed, input, output and functional elements of each business were clarified, and a task model was formed. With this model, a dual clustering method based on microtask data and operations to identify service boundaries was proposed, corresponding microservices were developed, and the relative independence of services was achieved. Finally, the configuration management business during the development of a ship enterprise was taken as an example to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: 5G Messaging Application Solutions for Business Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, especially information technology, Internet information technology in the communication field, the emergence and application of 5G technology has accelerated the development of the communication industry. At the same time, it can also serve information services in other industries, promote the construction and realization of industrial informatization, and provide technical support for the smooth development of various businesses. Based on this, this article will take the financial industry as an example to analyze how banks and other financial institutions use 5G technology to build a messaging application platform under the current business architecture, and use this platform to communicate with users. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of 5G messaging and the opportunities and challenges it brings, this article will explore the integration of 5G technology and bank messaging applications based on the current development of commercial bank messaging services. Sitting on the basis of the characteristics of the current business architecture to build a 5G message application program integrating message management, message application, message banking, and message ecological value output.

articleTitle: An Improved Image Entropy Algorithm Suitable for Digital Painting Style
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Traditional painting style classification method based on image entropy cannot be directly applied to the classification of digital painting style. After analyzing the similarities and differences between the two types of works in the existing literature, this paper sets additional saturation weighting to improve the previous color entropy calculation method and eliminates the contour entropy calculation to describe the digital painting image style better. The experimental results show that this method can classify the styles of digital paintings more accurately.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automatic Startup and Shutdown Control System for Large Condenser Units
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Combined with the double water inner cooled synchronous condenser that has been put into operation at the UHV converter station, this paper introduces the system structure and design ideas of the automatic startup and shutdown control system for the large condenser units, and analyzes the key technical points in the APS system. It has a certain reference significance for the optimization and promotion of the automation control system of the similar units.

articleTitle: Comprehensive financial analysis of a company relying on fuzzy c-mean (FCM) clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The highly competitive information age requires investors to quickly, accurately and comprehensively grasp the financial status, operating conditions and future development of listed companies. This paper relies on the fuzzy c-mean (FCM) clustering algorithm, establishes a financial analysis index system through cluster analysis, weight setting, membership calculation and consistency test, and evaluates the five capabilities of a listed company' s profitability and debt repayment. Empirical analysis aims to verify the practicality and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Oral English Learning System Based on Speech Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a universal language in the world, English plays an important role in information transmission in the global development of economy. However, due to the influence of language environment, learning mode and Chinese thinking, there are some problems in Chinese learners' oral expression, such as learning learners' oral expression. In order to improve the learning ability of oral English, this paper creatively designs a learning system to help learners gain more time, space advantages and multiple interactive experiences through speech recognition technology.

articleTitle: Preliminary Application Analysis of Mixed Teaching Mode in Colleges and Universities Based on MOOC Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information network technology, Internet technology has been widely used in teaching practice. Among them, MOOC is an open online teaching course for the general public. This new online teaching model not only breaks through the limitations of time and space, crosses the boundaries of disciplines, and meets the diverse learning needs of different students, but also changes the shortcomings of the traditional teaching model. Based on the related concepts of MOOC teaching, this article will construct a hybrid teaching mode that combines with classroom teaching. The author of this issue proposes a hybrid teaching implementation process suitable for college teaching. The author hopes that this model will be helpful for cultivating students' independent learning ability and cooperative innovation ability.

articleTitle: Design of General Data Acquisition System for MOS Gas Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A data acquisition system based on MOS gas sensors, in which the analog signal processing module, automatic range switching module, AD conversion module, MCU and serial communication was introduced. The acquisition system can collect the MOS gas sensors' signals. After the sensor signals were processed by the analog signal conditioning circuits, they were converted into digital signals through the MCU ATmega16 and transmitted to the host computer. The system realized realtime data collection, automatic switching of measurement ranges, and was featured by high sensitivity, fast response, and low cost.

articleTitle: Inpainting of Vintage Films Based on Variational Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are many existing video restoration frameworks, but there are no professional methods to deal with multiple degradation restorations of vintage films. With the help of the idea of mapping, this paper constructs a model with two variational autoencoders to repair the complex degradation problem. In addition, convolutional LSTM is used for video de-flicker processing to obtain smoother and natural results. The experimental results prove that this method can repair different damages in the vintage films screen at the same time, and achieve good results.

articleTitle: A Bayesian Network Incremental Algorithm for Public Safety Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Bayesian network learning is another research field of machine learning and data mining. In the research of Bayesian network learning algorithm, on the one hand we have to consider the issue of how to avoid the disclosure of data privacy. On the other hand, in the real world applications, data may be gradually available for Bayesian network, thus traditional Bayesian network learning algorithms can not be effectively applied. Therefore, this paper proposes a privacy-preserving Bayesian network incremental learning algorithm. We use sufficient statistical information in our incremental learning method, so we firstly proposed a formula for calculating the amount of sufficient statistics information. Then we improve the traditional K 2 algorithm, add the concept of sufficient statistical information in it, and then propose an incremental K 2 algorithm. At last, we proposed a privacy-preserving Bayesian network incremental learning algorithm. The algorithm only need to save the sufficient statistical information of each node and its possible parents in order to calculate score function value of each node and its parents, and then construct the Bayesian network structure. We can use the proposed approach to complete the public safety data analysis with a higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle Ownership and Load Forecasting Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved BASS model based on the number of electric vehicles and a load forecasting model based on Monte Carlo simulation. First, for the prediction of the number of electric vehicles, by improving the nonlinear least squares method, the model parameters are estimated and preliminary optimized, and a combination forecasting model that integrates multiple forecasting models is proposed to predict the number of traditional vehicles, and through the Delphi method based on analytic hierarchy process, to establish the connection between traditional cars and electric cars. Secondly, for electric vehicle load forecasting, the algorithm is based on Monte Carlo simulation to simulate electric vehicle battery characteristic parameters and user travel habits, and predict the disorderly charging behavior of electric vehicles to form a daily load curve of electric vehicles. Finally, a simulation model was established in matlab to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Error Orientation Analysis and Experimental Study on 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Printing accuracy is an important factor affecting the industrial application of 3D printing technology, usually characterized by dimensional error. In order to explore the mechanism of 3D printing errors, this paper firstly carries out the analysis of error type and contour element. The insight software is used to complete the comparison of the contour node information of different components. The error theory analysis is carried out and the design law of the workpiece is summarized. Finally, the delta3D printer is used to carry out the contour printing experiment of different element composition. Through the measured size of the printed sample, the relationship between the error orientation and the contour elements is summarized and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Detecting Approach for Misplaced Packages during Palletization Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this study, an inspection system is designed to detect the emergence of tilted placed titanium dioxide packages during palletization. An industrial color CCD camera over the production line helps to obtain the picture of layer of the stack in real time. The obtained image will then experience HSV picture segmentation to extract the standard titanium dioxide labels out for detection. Multiple morphological processes are applied to transform the labels into detectable rectangles. After that, the angle of inclination of each package would be detected and calculated through Hough transform. A tolerance range is set to distinguish qualified stacks and unqualified stacks by the difference between the detected angle and standard angle. This detection system could significantly improve the efficiency of production.

articleTitle: Research on the Reform of Multi-ecological English Curriculum in Higher Vocational Education under the Context of Information Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because English is a subject with strong application, this paper discusses the multi-ecological reform path of English curriculum teaching under the background of big data from the perspective of educational ecology. To realize the development and optimization of English teaching, on the one hand, to improve the quality of English professionals, on the other hand, to meet the employment needs of the English market, to achieve high-quality development of related industries.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Fish Swarm PID in Mold Level Control of Continuous Casting Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Continuous casting process is a very important process in iron and steel production, mold level control is a very important link in the process of continuous casting. In order to control the mold liquid level more effectively, the artificial fish swarm PID control algorithm is introduced to adjust the mold liquid level. The incremental PID control algorithm is used to obtain better control effect through weighted processing, and the artificial fish swarm optimization algorithm is used to adjust the incremental PID parameters. The simulation results show that the artificial fish swarm algorithm is more effective in the mold level control.
