articleTitle: Analysis of Network Security and Intelligence Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the process of rapid development of big data technology, its application in network security and intelligence analysis has certain significance. Because big data technology can greatly improve the efficiency of network security and intelligence analysis, it is important to ensure the overall security of the network. When applying big data technology, we need to explore the issues of network security and intelligence analysis technology based on big data. At the same time, we need to study network security and intelligence analysis methods based on big data to improve the security of the network operating environment as much as possible. We should prevent network security issues from causing economic losses to countries, enterprises, and individuals.

articleTitle: Construction of Network Marketing System for Wenzhou Manufacturing Enterprises Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on a comprehensive understanding of the current basic situation of Wenzhou Manufacturing e-marketing, this paper analyzes the E-marketing data and manufacturing related data, analyzes the contents of improving the E-marketing ability of enterprises, and puts forward suggestions for the construction of enterprise network marketing system to achieve big data system management and industrial chain collaboration.

articleTitle: On Black-Hole Numbers of Iteration of Digital Biquadratic Power Sum in the Ternary, Quinary or Quindenary System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are different periodic and fixed points under the iteration of biquadratic sum of digits of positive integer in different carry systems. There are one fixed point and two 2-circles in ternary; four fixed points and three 4-circles in quinary; seven fixed points, two 2-circles, one 3-circle, one 9-circle and one 63-circle in quindenary.

articleTitle: Application and Innovation of Informatization in Financial Economic Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At this stage, the influence of information technology is increasing, which can also be reflected in financial economic management. It can strengthen its management level and management efficiency, and then bring more promotion to the development of the entire financial industry. This article summarizes the application effects of informatization in financial economic management based on previous work experience. This article discusses the six aspects of informatization innovation in financial economic management, including the construction of informatization platform, the realization of informatization promotion and strengthening, the development of informatization talent training, the use of new information technology means, planning, and optimization of domestic capital control.

articleTitle: Research on the Value and Path of Innovative Research Methods of Ideological and Political Education in the Context of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, information management has been more and more applied in all aspects of production and life. Because of the complexity and universality of ideological and political education, it is very important to use science and technology and information management to relieve the pressure of research and improve the accuracy of data. Information technology infuses the power of science and technology into the research of ideological and political education, provides technical support, and plays an important role in the teaching mode of teachers. All levels of ideological and political education should start to set up information management thinking, so as to help the ideological and political research to get in-depth development. Researchers should quickly master the application of information technology and explore the path choice and value of ideological and political education research methods.

articleTitle: Research on the technology of fixed stroke lead screw transmission mechanism with self positioning function
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The traditional screw drive has the difficulty of precise position and complex program control, which increases the difficulty of technical personnel's development. Aiming at this pain point, this paper proposes a fixed stroke lead screw transmission mechanism with self positioning function. After the technical improvement, the lead screw no longer needs the travel switch and the corresponding switch state judgment circuit, which simplifies the circuit composition of the whole system. It simplifies the mechanical structure layout of the whole system, and does not need to reserve the installation position and wiring position of the travel switch, especially for the limited space environment. For the screw transmission structure which needs to be used in the sealed environment, the stroke distance in the closed cavity reserved due to the installation of the travel switch can be saved, and the length of the instrument can be shortened. In addition, it is no longer necessary to judge the status of the travel switch and issue control commands in the program. It only needs to reserve enough motor rotation time according to the motor speed, which simplifies the program structure. The starting and ending positions and travel distance of the whole travel are accurate and reliable, which can avoid the over travel, blocking and impact caused by the damage of the travel switch, and ensure the safety of the instrument, equipment and operators.

articleTitle: VTGeo: A Visualization Tool for Geospatial Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The visualization of geospatial data is vital to data analysis. The existing visualization methods have several limitations. Firstly, they focus on a certain data format for visualization, which lacks scalability. Secondly, they cannot provide diverse visualization of categories. To address these challenges, we develop a extensible tool VTGeo (Visualization Tool for Geospatial Data), which can visualize geospatial data. VTGeo automatically creates the corresponding table structure by identifying the data file uploaded by users and converting data sources into a visual representation. Users also can customize data types in an extensible spatio-temporal database SECONDO, which can store moving object data with time and location information. SECONDO makes VTGeo visualization with data type scalability. VTGeo provides five categories of visualization: Scatter Plots Maps, Area Maps, Road Maps, Dynamic Road Maps, and Heat Maps. Users can personalize the display style of graphics in the five categories. The demonstration is performed by using real trajectory datasets.

articleTitle: Key technologies of small multi azimuth directional drilling rig
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because of the problem that conventional directional drilling rigs are large in volume and small inclination angle of openings, which cannot meet the drilling requirements of narrow tunnels in small and medium coal mines, a small multi-directional directional drilling rig has been developed. Based on the development of the ZYWLD series of directional drilling rigs, through the optimization of the layout of the whole machine and the new rotary table design, the main machine is small in size and can be used for multi-directional drilling; by changing the linear type of the stator and rotor, the new structure of the ball One-way valve and improved string bearing materials and structure have realized the long life of the PDM (positive displacement motor) and small size; through the establishment of various error compensation mathematical models of the measuring system inclinometer, high-precision error compensation coefficients have been obtained, forming a set of underground coal mines Borehole inclinometer calibration method to improve the accuracy of the large inclination measurement system. The load performance test was carried out on the host, and the performance parameters of the host reached the design requirements.

articleTitle: Sustained Chaos State and Coexisting Attractors in a Memristive System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new memristive model is proposed and realized by Matlab software and Multisim software. Based the memristor, a memristive chaotic system is designed. The chaotic system has abundant dynamic characteristics, including coexisting attractors and sustained chaotic state. The coexisting bifurcation diagrams connected with coexisting attractors are discovered by varying the system parameters. The corresponding dynamic behaviors are analyzed by Lyapunov exponents, bifurcation diagrams and phase portraits. The chaotic circuit is realized by Multisim circuit simulations, and the simulation results are consistent with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Improved dynamic surface control for a class of higher order nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An improved dynamic surface control (IDSC) approach is presented for a class of higher order nonlinear systems. In this method, the virtual control signal is directly used to replace the signal generated by the first-order filter to construct the state error, so that the state error is not affected by the first-order filter, and the control design is simplified. The stability of the method is proved by Lyapunov stability theory, and the semi-global uniform ultimate boundedness of all signals in the closed-loop system is guaranteed. Simulation results demonstrate the IDSC method has better tracking performance and stability than traditional DSC method.

articleTitle: A design of infusion monitoring system based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper designs an infusion monitoring system based on STM32 microcontroller. The purpose is to solve some safety problems that exist in the hospital infusion hall. This design realizes the functions of information collection, liquid exhaust warning, screen display, and doctor-patient interaction. With this system, nurses at the nurse station can observe the liquid quality of each patient in the infusion hall in real time through the screen. When the liquid is about to run out, the system automatically warns nurses at the nurse station and the patient at the same time, reminding the patient and nurse to deal with it as soon as possible. The paper elaborated on the hardware design of the system in more detail, and explained the scheme design of the system.

articleTitle: The Higher-quality High-level Semantics based on Improved Visual Model for VQA
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Visual question answering is a new research direction that combines computer vision and natural language processing. Some recent research uses image interpretation to reason about answers. However, the accuracy of the answers is not satisfactory due to insufficient understanding of image content. This paper proposes an improved VQA method which applies higher-quality image high-level semantics based an improved visual model, thereby optimizing the performance of answer prediction. Firstly, we use the improved Faster-RCNN model to extract more precise attended objects from images. Then, the corresponding visual features are used to obtain high-level semantic knowledge (refined image captions and attended high-level attributes) in images. Finally, the reasoning module uses the joint features of two semantic knowledge and questions to predict the final answers. We conducted extensive experiments on the public datasets and the results of experiments were analyzed to illustrate effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Intelligent security system based on location information
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The current military management of important materials lacks real-time monitoring means. Once important materials are lost or stolen, they can only be analyzed and speculated through post-event investigations and evidence collection. People can'n immediately locate the real-time location of the item. Based on the above considerations, the NB-IoT communication module, Beidou positioning module, and buzzer are used to form a positioning device. When important materials are active outdoors, the NB-IoT SIM card on the device is activated, and the SIM card sends real-time location information of the materials to the cloud platform in real time to ensure that real-time trends are grasped, and the data will be sent to the computer terminal. The administrator operates the terminal and can monitor the entire process without blind spots. In the process of data transmission, AES encryption is used to ensure data security. Installed on important materials, the management software will display the location, movement track, environmental status and other information of the materials in real time, which solves the needs of real-time monitoring, status monitoring and anti-theft warning of important materials.

articleTitle: Snake Model Improvement Based on Bilateral Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the limitation of the extraction of the target object's edge contour by the classic Snake model, an improved algorithm of Snake model based on bilateral filter was proposed in this paper. This algorithm uses a bilateral filter instead of the Gaussian filter in the classic Snake model to preprocess the target image. Through comprehensive consideration of the spatial domain of the target image noise point and the gray value of adjacent pixels, the target image is more accurate and effective pretreatment, and then the target image obtained at this time after the pre-processing is finished, the subsequent edge contour extraction processing and operation are performed again, and the Matlab R2015b experimental platform and its own standard experimental image are used for experimental simulation. The experimental results show that the improved model in this paper is significantly better than classic Snake model in extracting the edge contour of the target object, which can not only better protect the edge of the target image, but also have a good optimization effect on the overall definition of the target image. During the experiment, the improved Snake model was used to observe and analyze the extraction effect of the edge contour of the same target object to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the improved model proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Quantitative Evaluation of Ergonomics for Equipment Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: It is an effective way to promote equipment maintainability on the basis of the evaluation of maintenance personnel comfort level. In order to address the problem that it is difficult to quantify the comfort level of maintenance personnel in equipment maintainability assessment, an 18-link virtual human kinematics model is established. According to the human kinematics model, a motion classification and modeling method based on human movement chain is proposed, and a quantitative evaluation mathematical model of human comfort level is presented in combination with fuzzy theory. Taking the maintenance activity as an example, the quantitative evaluation model is verified. The results show that the evaluation model can effectively and objectively reflect the comfort level of maintenance personnel and has guiding significance for the establishment of the maintenance process.

articleTitle: A Study on Training Strategies of College Students' Cooperative Learning Ability Based on Online Case Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The fundamental goal of higher vocational education lies in the cultivation of talents, and the key of talent training lies in the classroom. Cooperative learning, as a form of classroom organization that stimulates students' active inquiry and cooperation spirit, has been widely advocated in recent years, but it also has the problems of low implementation, difficult evaluation of learning effect and mere formality. Influenced by the development of computer and information technology, informatization has penetrated into the classroom of major colleges and universities, which has brought innovative ideas for the development of teaching. With the help of scientific and technological means, relying on the information platform and based on the angle of online case teaching, this paper puts forward the improvement ideas of college students' cooperative learning, so as to promote the cultivation of college students' learning initiative, consciousness and profundity.

articleTitle: Research on the application of Excel genetic algorithm in mathematical modeling of College Students
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Modern college students want students how to use Excel for mathematical modeling, in the operation process to use a variety of algorithms, including genetic algorithm. However, many college students have not yet mastered the specific application methods. Therefore, this paper will carry out research. Through the table function, function and mixed programming function of Excel, the dynamic changes of genetic algorithm optimization process in Excel are displayed, and simulation charts are generated. The visualization of genetic algorithm optimization process can be realized through the icon, which provides reference for college students. Through the research, college students will have a deeper understanding of the essence and optimization process of genetic algorithm, and can master the genetic algorithm in a short time. Then, the algorithm will be applied to the combination optimization, function optimization and other mathematical modeling optimization problems, and finally solve the problem.

articleTitle: Application and Development of Sensor Technology in Mechatronics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As the core technology of mechatronics, sensor can not only withstand the severe external environment test, but also obtain information accurately and quickly, which is an important guarantee for the rapid development of mechatronics. At present, 11 kinds of sensors, including force sensitivity, color sensitivity, biological sensitivity and voltage sensitivity, are produced in China. These sensors are being used by more and more industries. In order to accelerate the development of high quality in the field of mechatronics, this paper based on the current application of sensors, scientifically points out the development direction of sensor technology by analyzing the problems existing in practical operation.

articleTitle: Research on the drive control of the Disk Coreless BLDC motor based on the soft switching inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the problem of large torque ripple of the coreless disk BLDC motor, and considering the large switching loss under the operation of hard switching, it is proposed to add a resonant DC link to the front of the three-phase inverter, and analyze the resonant DC link Control the working process of the next switching cycle, and compare the electromagnetic torque before and after adding the resonant DC link through Simulink simulation analysis. The result shows that the electromagnetic torque ripple can be improved by adding resonant DC link to the conventional motor control, and the validity of this method is proved.

articleTitle: Defect detection method for solar cells based on human visual characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the defects of solar cells are diverse and difficult to detect, a detection method for surface defects of solar cells based on human visual characteristics was presented. Inspired by human visual characteristics, firstly, the line segment detector (LSD) was used to remove the grids that influence the defect detection, and then the Gabor filter texture suppression algorithm was proposed for texture suppression. Finally, a threshold segmentation based on the Chebyshev's theorem was proposed, and the control limit was set by the principle of statistical process control to divide the image pixels to realize the detection of surface defects of solar cells. Experimental results show that the proposed method is feasible in solar cells defect detection, it is effective and has a high detection rate.

articleTitle: A Fine-Grained Data Mining Model Based on Psychometric Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As social development and the pace of life gradually accelerates, psychological pressure and conflict become more and more prominent, and mental health becomes an issue of growing concern for the country and its people. In order to study the relationship between people's mental health problems and their own personal information factors, the authors use a fine-grained mining model of psychometric data. First, the model clusters the user groups by the k-means++ clustering algorithm, then uses C4.5 decision tree algorithm for classification and prediction in each group, and finally synthesizes the results of all the decision tree predictions to establish a highly accurate prediction model of mental health factors through a cyclic iterative approach.

articleTitle: Anti-skid control of four-wheel hub-driven electric vehicle based on energy method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aimingat the problem of driving slip resistance of four-wheel hub-driven electric vehicles, the energy method is used to control. Firstly, an electric vehicle model with four-wheel hub motors is built, including vehicle model, motor model and joint simulation model. Secondly, a driving anti-skid control strategy based on energy method is proposed, and an algorithm controller based on logic threshold is designed. At last, MATLAB/Simulink simulation proves that the designed controller has high reliability and realizes the goal of driving anti-skid.

articleTitle: The utility model relates to a cleaning mechanical arm applicable to a high voltage insulator cleaning robot
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The electric power industry is the basic industry of the national economy. As an insulating control to increase the creepage distance in the electric power link, insulators often reduce their electrical conductivity due to accumulation of surface dirt, resulting in pollution flasking accidents, which cause serious economic impact of electric power and social security impact. The project team designed a mechanical arm for insulator cleaning, which can be mounted on an overhead high voltage power line walking robot to complete the maintenance and cleaning of insulators. The cleaning arm is a separate mechanical cleaning arm, and is designed with an incomplete gear mechanism, which is used to drive both sides of the brush to rotate so as to clean the insulator surface at full Angle. Multi-closed-loop control and PID algorithm ensure attitude adjustment of the multi-degree-of freedom sweeping arm. In conclusion, this project solves the problem of insulator cleaning difficulty, greatly improves cleaning efficiency, and has great research significance and application prospect.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Intelligent Infusion Alarm Device Based on Weight Sensing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An intelligent infusion alarm device developed based on weight sensing is rising in response to the deficiencies and hazards of the current infusion device. This paper introduces the development of this alarm device in four aspects, including hardware design, software design, fixed end interface design and smartphone app interface design. This intelligent infusion alarm device is able to monitor the weight changes of infusion bottle constantly through a weight sensor and related mechanism, enabling real-time check on the circumstances of infusion. Thus, it assures patients safety in infusion while allowing their family members be off for medicine, medical report, etc. at the time the patients don't need to be taken care.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Grid Planning in Xinjiang Urban Core Area
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of traditional planning methods in modern urban distribution network planning in association with urban planning, a certain representative core area of a certain city in Xinjiang was selected to conduct a case analysis of distribution network planning. First, the power supply grid (unit) was differentiated through detailed, operable, closed-loop management of the power supply grid (unit) division method; then the construction process of the target grid of the distribution network was studied. The target grid and transition grid were determined according to the typical wiring mode, current situation, problem requirements and future development demand, and the target network structure, power supply grid (unit), and rationality were examined. Finally, the precise investment strategy of the project was studied to achieve the maximization of the investment benefit of the distribution network. Practice has proved that grid planning is more scientific and refined than traditional planning methods, and can be used as an effective means to improve modern distribution network planning and management.

articleTitle: Smoking target detection based on Yolo V3
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The current smoking recognition and detection system in my country is mainly based on an intelligent analysis of the video, that is, target detection and recognition of smoking behavior in the monitoring area, and early warning in the fastest way when abnormal conditions are found, therefore, the advantages and disadvantages of the detection algorithm directly affect the safety factor. The Yolo V3 model used in this article is based on DarkNet53 as the backbone. After the feature map is output, it is decoded by the Bounding Box, and finally the prediction result is obtained. The prediction results can be used as the evaluation results of the model. The prediction results show that the smoke detection effect based on Yolo v3 is good, reaching a mAP of 0.76.

articleTitle: Design of portable peanut planter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, manual sowing is still the main sowing method in Hilly and terraced fields. This operation mode has the problems of low efficiency and high labor intensity. Although the traditional mechanical traction large-scale peanut planter has complete functions and high efficiency, it is not suitable for the sowing of complex terrain and small area land such as hills and terraces. In order to solve the above problems, a portable peanut seeder is designed in this paper. It is composed of hoe shovel opener, seed metering device, seed box, scraper type soil covering device and other parts. The operation efficiency can reach 4-5acres/h, and the missing sowing rate is less than 6%. The sowing effect is good, which can meet the technical requirements of peanut planting in Hilly and terrace areas.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Design and Manufacturing of Rationalization of Machining Manufacturing Process
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rationalization of mechanical manufacturing processing technology can make the development of mechanical manufacturing more scientific and reasonable. In the process of promoting the development of mechanical manufacturing and processing, a good mechanical design and manufacturing is the key. Solving the problems in mechanical design and manufacturing can improve the efficiency of mechanical manufacturing and processing. At the same time, ensuring the quality of machinery manufacturing is to promote the steady development of China's machinery manufacturing industry. In the new era, as people's requirements for mechanical products increase, we must continuously optimize the rationality of the mechanical manufacturing process, which is an important task for the entire mechanical manufacturing and processing industry. We need to innovate and optimize the mechanical manufacturing process from multiple angles in the actual design and production process, and solve the problems in the mechanical manufacturing process in time. We can also optimize the machining technology and methods of machinery manufacturing, choose a processing mode that is more in line with the development of modern machinery manufacturing, choose a reasonable mechanical design plan, and then optimize the processing procedures and processes. Thereby, it not only can improve the quality of mechanical product production, but also it can provide conditions for promoting the sustainable development of China's major mechanical manufacturing and processing enterprises. Furthermore, it also can promote the development of the domestic mechanical manufacturing and processing industry.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Scheme of Digital Motor Vehicle Certification Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The motor vehicle certificate is a certification document printed by the motor vehicle manufacturer and distributed with the vehicle that contains the key information of the vehicle and anti-counterfeiting information. At present, some car dealers obtain loans from commercial banks to expand their operations by pledge of new car vehicle certificates. However, the publicity of the whole process is not strong, the degree of mutual trust is not high, and there is a risk of damage to one or more parties in the information mismatch between car dealers, commercial banks, and consumers. This article attempts to solve related puzzles and promote the orderly development of auto finance by introducing blockchain technologies that are “unforgeable”, “all traces”, “open and transparent” and “collective maintenance”.

articleTitle: Research on the development and construction of English teaching resources system against the background of "The Belt and Road initiative"
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of the process of global integration, China's development situation has also changed greatly. Against this background, "The Belt and Road initiative" has been implemented in China, which has played an important role in promoting its own development and enhancing international influence. Under the new background, it is urgent for the society to cultivate and export English talents with more solid language skills, higher sensitivity to foreign cultures, more communication awareness and audio-visual communication skills. Under the background of "The Belt and Road initiative", this paper analyzes the necessity of English teaching resources construction, and summarizes the problems of the development of English teaching resources in the past, and puts forward suggestions for teaching resources development from the aspects of development strategy, development process, resource evaluation and auxiliary resources development.

articleTitle: Design of vegetable planter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the fact that traditional vegetable planting process is still dominated by manual labor, there are problems such as high labor intensity, high labor cost and high rate of missed sowing, This paper designs a vegetable planter, which is composed of seed metering device, ditching device, soil covering device, seed box, transmission system and other components. It can complete the ditching, sowing, covering soil, pressing and other sowing operations once entering the field. The operation efficiency can reach 0.133 hectare/h, and the missing sowing rate is less than 5%. It can effectively reduce the labor intensity of farmers and save the production cost Prospects.

articleTitle: Research on the Emotion Recognition based on ReliefF Matching Feature Selection Method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: ReliefF Matching Feature Selection (RMFS) is proposed in the paper, which can solve the problem of individual specificity and global threshold mismatch of emotion recognition. EMD was employed for extracting the 10 categories of features of wavelet coefficient and IMF component of the reconstructed signal by ReliefF, which were the global optimal matching feature group and the corresponding matching channel. Then, SVM was employed to identify the test feature group data to obtain emotional recognition results. The experimental results show that the average correct rates of RMFS for two-category of the valence and the arousal are 93.28% and 93.32%, and the four-categories are higher than 83%. The efficiency of the single subject using RMFS is improved by 42.65%, which is better than the traditional ReliefF algorithm.

articleTitle: Target Extraction Method Based on Improved Saliency Algorithm and Sobel Edge
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we add the LBP texture feature of the image to the ITTI algorithm. It is used to supplement the edge information that is lost due to interpolation. Because of the size change, maybe it will cause errors in a certain sailency map. We can judge whether to discard it by calculating the proportion of the salient areas on the saliency map. Then we use Sobel operator to check the edge of the image. But before that, we use median filtering to enhance edges and filter noise.

articleTitle: The Influence of Short Video on College Students' Values from the Perspective of New Media
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: new media has promoted many short network videos, which are often produced and published by self-media. Short video has won the love of many young people because of the length of time and the amount of information. They like to imitate the popular cultural elements created in short video. These popular elements have a great influence on human values, especially on the values of contemporary college students. Some short videos cause positive social energy effect, but a considerable number of short videos advocate entertainment too much, resulting in misinterpretation of mainstream values and hindering college students from shaping correct values. Relevant institutions should reasonably monitor and control the negative effects caused by short video, so as to carry forward the mainstream values among college students, avoid negative public opinion affecting their observation of society, and finally cause their personality defects.

articleTitle: The Numerical Simulation of Horizontal Well Completion Tool Based on Fluent
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the pressure and velocity impact problems in the compaction packing process of horizontal well casing, numerical simulation of flow field and structural optimization of gravel pack completion tool were conducted based on Fluent software. The flow field in the gravel pack completion tool was numerically simulated using the k-ε turbulence model, and the impact and wear of the tool were analyzed from the velocity, pressure and turbulence intensity distributions. The velocity, pressure and turbulence intensity of the internal flow field at 20mm and 45mm were calculated. The simulation results are in agreement with the impact wear condition of field test. The results show that the position of blasting holes formed the complex vortex, the casing wall and the blasting hole wall to form the impact.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Database Technology in Marketing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's quality of life, China's major enterprises are facing severe challenges, of course, there are certain opportunities, so domestic and foreign enterprises began to use computer database technology to help enterprises promote marketing. At present, computer database technology has been widely used in marketing in China. This paper briefly summarizes the computer database technology and marketing, analyzes the importance of computer database technology in marketing, and studies the role of computer database technology in marketing. Finally, the application of computer database technology in marketing is analyzed.

articleTitle: Development and experimental study of multi-motion model robot with wheel-track compound structure
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to make the robot adapt to various complex working conditions and weather conditions, and expand its application scope and scenarios, a new type of wheel-track compound structure robot is proposed, which has multi-motion mode and can realize the free switching between wheeled movement and wheel-track movement. Sprocket chain is used to drive the rotary movement of both sides of wheels of the robot, and the combination of dynamic and static seals is adopted to achieve the protection level of the robot IP65. In this article.the robot's movement patterns are analyzed, the mechanical analysis of the most representative function of climbing stairs under the wheel-track movement mode is carried out, the traction and supporting force of the robot in each stage of climbing stairs is obtained, the theoretical basis for the stability discrimination of robot is provided when the robot is in contact with stairs, and the design of robot structure and control system driving device is optimized. The results show that the robot can climb stairs, surmount obstacles, climb slopes and walk upright, which proves the rationality of the structure design and the stability of the robot under various complex working conditions.

articleTitle: Research on stealth route planning based on improved RRT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of stealth penetration route planning, this article establishes the constraints of route planning firstly, including the maximum turning angle and climbing angle. The objective function is established with the constraints of navigation and radar detection probability. Then the improved RRT algorithm is used to search for way points in 3D space and the route search model can be established. Under the given condition, the simulation analysis is carried out to verify the feasibility to the model.

articleTitle: Weight Kullback-Leibler Average Interactive multiple model Probabilistic Data Association Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of maneuvering target tracking in clutter, a weight Kullback-Leibler average based interactive multi-model probabilistic data association filter (WKLA-IMM-PDAF) is proposed. Compared with the traditional interactive multi-model probabilistic data association filter (IMM-PDAF), the WKLA-IMM-PDAF has been changed in the steps of state interaction, state fusion output and associated event weights allocation by using the WKLA, and these changes can effectively improve the computational efficiency of the filter. The simulation results show that the proposed filter has better estimation performance and lower computational time than the IMM-PDAF and interactive multi-model distance weighted probabilistic data association filter.

articleTitle: Design of Driving Assistance System for Racing Car Applied in Electric Baja SAE China
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an all-terrain racing car, electric Baja racing involves more complicated working conditions than ordinary roads. However, the speed control of the car mainly depends on the driver's judgment and perception, which will increase the safety hazards during the race. The existing driving assistance system seldom involves all-terrain racing. Based on the actual situation of electric Baja racing in Wuhan University of Technology, this paper designed and developed a driving assistance system. Data acquisition and processing were realized by various sensors, single chip microcomputer and chip, broadcasted in the form of voice. The accuracy of the system was proved by theory and experiment. The research can effectively give early warning judgment to the driver, improve the off-road performance and obstacle avoidance ability of electric Baja racing car, and improve the energy efficiency of the car.

articleTitle: On Black-Hole Numbers of Iteration of Digital Biquadratic Power Sum in Senary, Novenary or Duodecimal System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are different periodic and fixed points under the iteration of biquadratic sum of digits of positive integer in different carry systems. There are one fixed point, one 3-circle, one 9-circle and one 11-circle in senary; three fixed point, one 9-circle and one 22-circle in novenary; one fixed points, one 3-circle, one 8-circle and one 14-circle in duodecimal system.

articleTitle: Local Adjustment Block Net for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Recently, object detectors based on Receptive Fields (RFs) in human visual systems have stronger feature extraction capabilities and have achieved great detection performance, such as Inception, ASPP and RFBNet. However, while having capabilities to extract more contextual information, these detectors also capture redundant information, which will reduce the precision of detection. In this paper, we propose a novel and lightweight block based on spatial attention mechanism to solve this problem effectively. Compared with RFB, it can better capture effective contextual information in the feature map and suppress redundant information. Moreover, we propose a local enhancement strategy, which can sparsely locate regions that contains rich feature information and enhance them locally. Experimental results show that our proposed method gains 0.6% mAP improvement on the PSACAL VOC dataset and 0.5% mAP improvement on the COC02019 test-dev set. Keywords: Local Adjustment Block; Receptive Field; Spatial attention mechanism.

articleTitle: Minimum-time trajectory planning for a 4-dof manipulator considering motion stability and obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The trajectory planning with obstacle avoidance is a critical task for redundant manipulators in the complex operating environment. This paper proposes a time-minimum trajectory optimization technique to obtain a collision-free and jerk-continuous trajectory for a 4-dof redundant manipulator considering both kinematic and spatial constraints. In the optimization, the whole trajectory is divided into several sub-trajectories to ensure the reliability of the technique. The screw-based inverse kinematics (IK) model is used to obtain the angular displacements of joints corresponding to the end-effector final positions in each sub-trajectory. The spatial constraint is determined by assuming robotic links using cylinders with different bottom radius, and enveloping obstacles using spheres under different sizes. The quintic polynomial curve is utilized to interpolate in joint space to guarantee the continuous of the angular jerk of each joint. Finally, PSO algorithm is used to search for the optimal trajectory of the robot by taking the whole motion time as the optimization objective. Two cases are taken to validate the effectiveness of the proposed technique. The simulation results in MATLAB show that the robotic motion based on the optimal trajectory are safe, stable and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Ideological and Political Education System in Higher Vocational Education from the Perspective of Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the high quality development of information industry, the Internet has been integrated into the development of market economy in China. With the help of the platform and technical advantages of the Internet, the ideological and political education of colleges and universities in China has also made remarkable development. Ideological and political education, as the basic education of colleges and universities, is the fundamental to cultivate students to form a correct view of learning, life and values. However, under the background of the Internet, the reform and development of ideological and political education in colleges and universities also exposed many problems. This paper takes the problem as the guidance, deeply discusses the innovation mode of ideological and political education in colleges and universities under the background of the Internet, in order to form the organic unity of ideological and political curriculum and curriculum, and finally promote the comprehensive and sustainable development of students.

articleTitle: An intelligent online monitoring system for vibrating screen working status
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: During the operation of the vibrating screen, failures will inevitably occur, affecting production efficiency. This paper designs an intelligent monitoring system for the vibrating screen. It collects the vibrating screen's vibration data by using six-axis sensors at different measuring points, analyzes the signals collected by the sensors to extract features, accumulate historical data and upload it to the cloud server. Through the cloud's big data and expert system, the operation status of the vibrating screen will be evaluated and predicted. If the vibrating screen fails, it will promptly alarm and shut down. The research and promotion of this system is of great significance to the construction of smart factories and the improvement of the industrial management level.

articleTitle: Vibration Mode Analysis of Casting Flash Cutting Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In allusion to the complex nonlinear vibration characteristics of the casting flash cutting machine, this paper was to analyze the vibration mode of the whole machine in the working process with the finite element software-ANSYS Workbench. It was found that the machine tool was severely deformed at the first, second and fifth frequencies. The excitation frequency of the machine tool had a certain difference from the 6th-order natural frequency value obtained from the modal analysis. It provided an effective theoretical basis for the vibration reduction control of the whole machine. At the same time, the deficiencies of the machine tool in the testing process were improved, and the machining accuracy, running stability and production efficiency of the casting flash cutting machine were achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Rationalized Mechanical Design in Mechanical Manufacturing Process
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This article mainly briefly introduces the related concepts and characteristics of the mechanical manufacturing process, and expounds the mechanical manufacturing process flow. This paper analyzes the measures and principles of rationalized mechanical design in mechanical manufacturing process, and discusses the effective application of rationalized mechanical design in mechanical manufacturing process. The author's purpose is to strengthen the research on the rationalization of mechanical design in the mechanical manufacturing process, clarify the important role of the mechanical manufacturing process, and transform the traditional mechanical design mode. The author also proposes to quote advanced scientific concepts and give full play to the role of modern science and technology to improve the level of mechanical manufacturing technology and ensure the rationality of mechanical design.

articleTitle: Constructing a New Display Laboratory Management Model Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, display experiments seem to be gradually replaced by virtual experiments. However, in the actual teaching, it is found that the display experiment plays an irreplaceable role in cultivating ability of student to maintain and innovate. A new idea of management of display laboratory starting from the relationship between entity model and virtual model based on internet of things technology was presented in this paper, in order to solve the difficult problems that have long puzzled the development of laboratory. It lays a foundation for the establishment of a “student-centered” basic teaching environment.

Author Keywords: display laboratory management model internet of things technology virtual model

articleTitle: An Optimization Model Based on Gradient Projection Method to Minimize Generation Cost in a Given Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In systems of power grid, controlling the supply from generators to match the demand is crucial. An Economic dispatch problem then aims to optimize the cost of power generation while producing enough power to supply into power grid. Non-Linear Programming (NLP) is utilized for optimizing such problems under constraints. However, current algorithms with high time complexity and less accuracy can result in unnecessary expenses and energy waste. This paper proposed an optimization model algorithm utilizing the Gradient Projection Method, which can be used to calculate real-time optimized results for each generator. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed algorithm achieved superior performance in distributing precise amounts of power generation to various generators while maintaining a relatively short cost of time. The same algorithm can also provide results adapting to different power grid setup with high precision.

articleTitle: Improved NSGA-II with Hierarchical Retention and Interval Population Expansion
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of the classical fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm with elitist strategy (NSGA-II), such as the uneven pareto front distribution and poor distribution in local congested areas, an improved NSGA-II algorithm based on adaptive hierarchical retention and interval population expansion strategies is proposed. At the early stage of the population evolution, an adaptive hierarchical retention strategy is applied to replace the exclusion mechanism to get an expanded range of individuals selection and improve the diversity of the population. At the last stage of the population evolution, an interval population expansion strategy is provided to expand the contemporary optimal frontier individuals to reduce the sparsity of the swarm distribution aiming to improve the comprehensive performance of the population. The experiment results based on six selected benchmark functions show that the proposed algorithm gets a better convergence and is superior to the compared algorithms in the terms of comprehensive and distribution values.

articleTitle: Design of Control System of Vacuum Lyophilizer Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive energy consumption of vacuum lyophilizer on the market, a control system of vacuum lyophilizer based on S7-1200 PLC is designed. In this paper, the composition of the control system and the design of software and hardware are introduced in detail. Based on the problem of high energy consumption, the reasons are analyzed, and the effective control strategy is put forward. And the whole process is monitored and controlled by the upper computer in real time. The experimental results show that the control method can reduce the overall energy consumption of vacuum lyophilizer to about 50%.

articleTitle: DSN: A Fast Stereo Disparity Estimation Network based on Deformable Convolution
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, the stereo matching method based on the convolutional neural network has been greatly developed and achieved accurate disparity estimation results. However, the high precision stereo disparity estimation method is often slow in reasoning, so it cannot meet the requirements of real-time scene. Moreover, this type of method has a large number of parameters and is therefore not friendly to resource-constrained embedded devices. In this paper, a novel 2D cost aggregation module based on deformable convolution is constructed based on AnyNet, and a lightweight stereo matching network named DSN is constructed accordingly. We measured performance on SceneFlow and KTTTI2015 dataset. Experiments show that our method achieves the approximate inference time and parameter quantity of AnyNet, and the accuracy of disparity estimation is much better than AnyNet, achieving a better tradeoff between performance and time.

articleTitle: The Practice of Teacher Space Design in the Cloud Platform of Ideological and Political Curriculum in Colleges and Universities Based on Information Construction
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Under the background of promoting the educational reform in colleges and universities and advocating the construction of educational informatization in our country, the ideological and political curriculum should make full use of network technology to carry out educational reform, innovation and curriculum construction. Ideological and political teachers should also combine modern information network technology with ideological and political theory to enrich ideological and political classroom content and promote the development of ideological and political teaching. The purpose of this paper is to introduce the design principles and strategies of teachers' space products in the cloud platform of ideological and political courses, in order to find out the lack of design of teachers' space products and to provide experience reference for other studies.

Author Keywords: Cloud Platform of Ideological and Political Course

articleTitle: A New Visualization for Many-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The visualization of the approximations in high-dimensional space is a critical issue in many-objective optimization. As a popular visualization method, the parallel coordinates plots (PCPs) have been widely used in displaying the high-dimensional approximations. However, it is not as straightforward as the classic scatter plot for well-presenting the information contained in an approximation. One observation for PCPs is that their presented information changes when the axes order changes. In this paper, we propose a kernel-based visualization (KBV) method for many-objective optimization, in terms of comparing the quality of approximations, understanding the distribution of a solution set, and reflecting the relationship between different objectives. In KBV, the kernel feature map is combined with a re-order method for improving the effectiveness of the PCPs and providing more insightful information among different objectives, which is clearly beneficial for decision makers. The experimental analysis of KBV is also given in this paper. Finally, we introduce KBV to visualize the approximation on water resource problem (WRP).

articleTitle: Path Analysis of Using Big Data to Build Engineering Cost Database under the Background of Information Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of construction industry in China, engineering cost is facing massive data management. How to integrate the relevant information of engineering cost in various industries and fields in order to realize information management plays an important role in accelerating the development of construction industry, so it is imperative to establish engineering cost database. Through analyzing the relevant factors of engineering cost database and summing up the management experience, this paper puts forward some ideas for the construction of engineering cost database, and forms a unified information management in the industry. In order to promote cost management and construction industry benign development.

articleTitle: A low power test vector seed generation algorithm for SoC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of system integration and processing technology, especially the emergence of system chip, integrated circuit has entered a new period of development. As the increasing scale of SOC integration and the limited number of pins, it is necessary to build testability design logic to improve its controllability and observability. However, it will lead to the problem of high test power consumption, which will cause great harm to the circuit under test. In this paper, a new test vector seed generation algorithm is proposed. Based on the traditional LFSR reseeding technology, we introduce the low-power test vector reordering algorithm into the test vector coding technology. Because of the different order of the coded test vector seeds applied to the circuit under test, the number of hops in the circuit under test is reduced, and the goal of low-power test is achieved. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme for power reduction, we apply it to ISCAS85 partial reference circuit, and the average power consumption reduction is 25.16%. The experimental results show that the algorithm has a good effect on reducing test power consumption.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Machining on the Machining Accuracy of Metal Parts
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the process of rapid social and economic development, the mechanical processing industry is an important part of industrial development and plays a vital role in promoting the further development of the Chinese economy. In the process of mechanical processing, its processing effect and benefits will have a great impact on the sustainable development of the country's economy, and it is also the main content of showing the comprehensive capabilities of China. In recent years, the development speed of the machining manufacturing industry has become faster and faster. At the same time, people have higher and higher requirements for the processing accuracy of metal parts during the use of different types of precision instruments. If the size or position of the metal parts is deviated, it will adversely affect the normal operation of the entire equipment. Therefore, we must pay attention to the relevant requirements of the accuracy of metal parts in machining, and study the various effects of machining processes on the machining accuracy of metal parts. Otherwise, we are supposed to take effective measures to reasonably control the influencing factors, so as to improve the machining accuracy of metal parts.

articleTitle: Local occluded face recognition based on 2D-DWT and sparse representation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because most of the current face recognition systems do not consider the possible occlusion in the real environment, the traditional face recognition algorithm has poor recognition results. This paper proposes a face recognition method based on sparse representation of two-dimensional discrete wavelet transform in feature subspace for the presence of facial occlusion. Through two-dimensional discrete wavelet decomposition of the training samples, the high-frequency signals are filtered and the low-frequency signals are retained. The low-frequency signals are constructed by PCA, and then the test samples are sparse decomposed on the occlusion dictionary, and finally classified. Compared with other traditional face recognition methods, the proposed algorithm has better recognition results.

articleTitle: Context based multi-source feature aware event recommendation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the research, EBSN event recommendation algorithm is usually based on the user's simple relationship or social relationship. However, there are many factors that affect users' choice in EBSN, such as group based social information in EBSN context information and event text information, location information, time information, tag information. In order to enhance the effect of recommendation, fundamentally solve the problem of data sparsity and cold start of recommendation, this paper proposes an event recommendation algorithm based on context multi-source feature perception, establishes the scoring model of multi-source features, applies Random Forest algorithm to realize the weight calculation and extraction of multi-source features, and finally generates the event recommendation list. The experimental results are compared with other three ranking based recommendation algorithms. In the standard of NDCG@10, the MFA-RF algorithm proposed in this paper has obvious advantages, and solves the problems of data sparsity and cold start in the recommendation.

articleTitle: Multi-functional intelligent bathing machine for the elderly
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: China has the largest aging population in the world, and the degree of aging is increasing year by year. Through the investigation with the elderly, it is found that the elderly's bathing problems are still plaguing families. Therefore, based on the ergonomics, we use three-dimensional virtual design, static and dynamic simulation analysis and other technical methods to innovate mechanism and cooperate with intelligent control to design this multi-functional intelligent bathing machine for the elderly which combines automatic water temperature control system, automatic pressure control system, and real-time heart rate monitoring system. They can coordinate with the intelligent voice assistant, solve the bathing problem of the elderly who live alone efficiently.

articleTitle: Camellia Oleifera Fresh Fruit Harvesting in China
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The trends of extracting camellia oil directly from Camellia oleifera fresh fruit seeds, peeled off green husk and shell, need many more advanced mechanical harvesters to promote economic profit for camellia industry. The latest studying and developments of harvesting equipment are reported in this paper, especially focusing the overview of manually auxiliary harvester, working principle of vibrating harvester, combing-style rubber roller and vibrating-teeth harvester. A comprehensive review and analysis about their advantages and disadvantages are also discussed from the parameter system of harvesting efficiency, picking-off ratio, and consuming duration time for per action, and so on. Finally, the future mechanized trend and technical suggestions are put forwarded for Camellia oleifera fresh fruit harvesting equipment design and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research and Application of the Key Technology of Cloud Platform in Various Fields of Computer Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the current rapid development of Internet technology, the application of various new technologies and new concepts are more common. The effective connection of different types of technologies and the integration of technologies can form a unified whole and promote the close integration between people and things. The current Internet of Things technology has a wide range of applications. In order to be able to research and analyze the actual application of the Internet of Things technology in various fields, we need to explore the specific applications of the Internet of Things in various fields and the key technologies of the Internet of Things. This is of positive significance to promote the further development of the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Design Of Anti-steam Scald Alarm System For Electric Rice Cooker
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of our country, people's living standard is improving day by day. While pursuing food and clothing, we also have higher requirements for quality. Food is the most important thing for us, and rice is our main food. Compared with the past, people should pursue eating well on the basis of satiety. In the process of cooking, the steam generated by the electric cooker can easily scald the elderly and children without paying attention. Human heat energy Infrared sensor In this case, The cooker is in working condition, by using BISS0001 heat processor in the single chip computer C52. When the human is too close to the steam emitted by the electric cooker cooking, the alarm will be sent out and the warning light will be on.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of dynamic risk assessment in whole process of mega city power grid
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the large number of equipment, complex random factors affecting the risk, and the coupling effect of different equipment combination faults on power grid, it is very difficult to conduct online risk assessment of power grid operation. The challenges and opportunities faced by the whole process dynamic risk assessment of power grid in super large cities are pointed out. This paper first introduces the concept of power grid dynamic risk assessment and the main problems of current risk assessment. Secondly, the risk assessment methods such as state duration sampling method, entropy weight method and risk scenario screening based on fault influence scope are analyzed, and the overall design scheme of urban power grid operation risk assessment system is proposed. Finally, on the basis of the above theoretical research, combined with the engineering application requirements, the design and development of relevant software module program is completed, and the correctness of the software design and theoretical method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: A Collective Entity Linking Method Based on Graph Embedding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the poor effect of traditional entity linking method combining context co-occurrence and objective knowledge, this paper proposes a collective entity linking framework based on graph embedding algorithm Node2vec. The framework first uses BiLSTM and CRF to do named entity recognition over a text, aiming to obtain entities related to mention in the text. Then, the Node2vec is used on the sub-graph of the knowledge graph for all entities corresponding to the candidate entity sets and the recognized entities to obtain the vector representation between different entities. The similarity between each entity and the text within a certain range is calculated, and the degree between each pair of entity elements is obtained. The most similar pair is selected as the target entity of the link. Experimental verification shows that F1 in this framework reaches 85.96% on NLPCC2014 data set, and the improved Node2vec algorithm performs better than some other graph embedding algorithms in this framework.

articleTitle: Pulse Compression Radar Ship Detection Method Based on Improved SSD
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Radar ship target detection plays an important role in ship navigation and collision avoidance. The ship target detection for synthetic aperture radar has been relatively mature, while pulse compression radar has relatively poor imaging effect and more noise interference, so there are few related studies. Aiming at the problem of poor detection of small target ships in pulse compression radar images, an improved SSD-based radar ship target detection method is proposed in this paper. Based on the Single Shot MultiBox Detector, we improved the network model. Resnet50 is used to replace the backbone network to effectively extract the feature information of small targets. Feature fusion module which contains deconvolution and group convolution is added to combine low-level features and deep features. Spatial attention module is used to suppress background and increase detection accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model performs better than the benchmark model.

articleTitle: Design of Oil and Gas Recovery Control System Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the process of loading and unloading of refined oil, the volatilization of oil and gas not only causes energy waste and environmental damage, but also raises serious hidden danger. Today, more and more attention is being paid to the issue of environmental protection, the country has already issued a variety of laws and standards to restrict oil and gas emissions. In this paper, according to control requirements, “condensation-adsorption” oil and gas recovery scheme determined, the control logic of the system is clarified, and hardware and software design of the control system are completed. Automatic control, manual control, refrigeration, defrosting, adsorption, desorption, oil recovery, alarm and other functions are realized through PLC. The control panel interface is developed with Wincc Flexible software and tested by simulation. The results show that the control system can operate safely and stably and the recovery efficiency is greater than 95%.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Ways of Mental Health Education for Vocational Students under the Internet Background
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the context of the Internet, on the one hand, many new resources and new possibilities have been improved for students' mental health education, and the use of Internet technology can improve the efficiency of mental health education. However, if teachers cannot accurately grasp the laws of students' psychological development, fail to connect with students' reality, and educators have insufficient capabilities, they cannot make good use of information technology to carry out flexible and diverse mental health education activities. This will affect the overall level of mental health education, and cannot truly play the role of mental health education in promoting the overall development of students. To this end, it is necessary for us to explore the psychological level of students in the context of the Internet, as well as the opportunities and challenges encountered by educators, and on this basis to explore innovative mental health education models and methods.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Computer Science and Technology in Economic Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the vigorous development of computer technology, it also promotes the renewal and development of various industries. Computer science and technology play a great role in all industries of our country, which can help people to lighten the burden to a certain extent. When processing huge and complicated data, computers can accurately calculate, analyze and save data. This is a height that ordinary employees can not reach. Therefore, computer science and technology can play its great value in the field of economic management. There are huge data to be processed and analyzed in economic management. If all these data are counted by employees, it will be an extremely huge project. Therefore, computer science and technology in this field can play its value, for enterprises to bring great convenience. This paper analyzes various problems in enterprise economic management, shows the importance of computer science and technology in economic management, and studies the application of computer science and technology in economic management.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Shared Bicycle Data Based on User's Spatiotemporal Behavior Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of shared bicycles, large-scale spatiotemporal trajectory data has been generated and stored. Visual research and analysis of these data provide guidance and reference for bicycle scheduling, station planning, urban road planning. Moreover, what kind of visualization technology can efficiently mine the hidden information in data, which has attracted people's attention. Based on this research motivation, a visual analysis system of shared bicycle user's behavior was constructed, which started from time and space to construct spatiotemporal trajectory data and high-dimensional multivariate data visualization. Via the analysis of cycling routes and stations, the purpose is to use collaborative interaction between views to realize visual analysis of users' cycling activity patterns and influencing factors.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Pulse Reflection Method of Thickness Measurement System based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper describes the principle of measuring the thickness of a pulse reflection method, in accordance with the principle of thickness measurement of the pulse reflection method, we proposed a new method of extraction and analysis of the echo signal. The thickness measurement ultrasonic pulse reflection control system is designed. The differential detection circuit and the zero-crossing comparator form the peak detection circuit. The pulse echo signal is processed to improve the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the drying technology of workpieces in the field of machining
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The machining of mechanical parts needs to go through cutting, grinding and other processes, but it is often necessary to spray anti rust paint after forming to achieve the anti rust effect. However, it takes a long time for mechanical parts to dry naturally after painting, which affects the production efficiency. In order to accelerate the drying process of antirust paint and shorten the processing cycle of mechanical parts, it is necessary to dry the mechanical parts with the help of drying device. In the existing technology, the drying device mostly places the mechanical parts with drying on the conveyor belt or drying table, and then uses the heating device to dry them. This mode can only dry one side of the mechanical parts each time, and can not dry the mechanical parts in three dimensions, so the drying efficiency is low. Therefore, we provide a drying device for machining parts. Keywords machining; Mechanical structure; Workpiece drying; Optimizing structure; Increase efficiency.

articleTitle: Vibration Motor Fault Diagnosis System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Vibration motor is a key component in the operation of vibration machinery.
