If the fault of vibration motor is not found in the early stage., the motor fault will gradually increase to the extent of damage, resulting in the shutdown of vibration machinery and even the occurrence of accidents. The vibration motor is subjected to periodic vibration force during operation. The fault signals of the vibration motor will be different from those of the ordinary motor. In this paper, LabView software is used to build a system for real-time monitoring of vibration motor bearing fault state. The vibration motor state monitoring and fault diagnosis system monitors the stator current signal, displays the waveform in real time and analyzes the frequency spectrum of FFT, so as to monitor the operation of the vibration motor, judge the vibration motor in the early stage timely, and avoid the serious and complex failure. The system includes such functions as data acquisition, signal processing, fault judgment and fault data recording, which can effectively evaluate the working state of vibration motor and provide effective suggestions for motor maintenance.

articleTitle: Construction of Center-Coincident Deployable Mechanisms Based on Cyclic and Circumscribed Polygon
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A generalized method of cyclic and circumscribed deployable mechanism composed of multiple generalized angulated elements with the same deployable center is proposed. The construction conditions of N two Type I generalized angulated elements ( N-TGAE I) and N two Type II generalized angulated elements ( N-TGAE II) with the same deployable center are analyzed, respectively. By analyzing the constraint conditions, the distances from the intermediate hinge points of all angulated elements to the deployable center are the same. These constraint conditions are used to construct center-coincident deployable mechanisms based on the cyclic and circumscribed polygon. The construction methods of cyclic polygon and circumscribed polygon center-coincident deployable mechanisms based on N-TGAE I and N-TGAE I are presented.

articleTitle: The Research of Nonlinear Characteristics of High Intensity Focused Ultrasound in Biological Tissue
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Nonlinear propagation of high intensity focused ultrasound(HIFU) at high power can easily lead to waveform distortion and generate high order harmonic. This paper is based on the finite element method to establish the propagation model of high intensity focused ultrasound in biological tissues. Firstly, analyzing the nonlinear characteristic of HIFU propagation in biological tissue. Then, making quantitative comparisons with the nonlinear model in water to obtain the nonlinear characteristics of the focal area. At last, explaining the propagation characteristics of nonlinear ultrasound in biological tissue, and establishing a simulation basis for HIFU in the field treatment for future use.

articleTitle: Based on Multiple Attention and User Preferences for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Recently, deep learning has been widely used in the field of recommendation systems. Sequence recommendation is an important direction of the current recommendation system, which uses the user's behavior sequence information to calculate the possibility of the user interacting with the target item. Recent work embeds the original features into low-dimensional vectors, then uses RNN or Transformer to extract behavior sequence information, and finally inputs to the MLP layer to get the recommended results. These methods do not consider that the items of different positions have different effects on the next item, and the recent item in the real world often have a greater impact on the target item than the previous ones. So we propose MAUPRec models to solve such problems. Each user's historical behavior learns its corresponding weight through attention mechanism, which better reflects the interest of users at different times. In addition, we find that feedback information means user's preference to some extent, so we also introduce feedback information as user's preference representation in the model. We conducted detailed comparison experiments with the very popular models in the industry on different public data sets, and the r showed that our model MAUPRec has good performance.

articleTitle: Trajectory Optimization and Tracking Control of a Morphing Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The morphing aircraft can change wing shapes or geometries to achieve optimal flight performance according to various mission scenarios. In previous studies, a variable-sweep-wing morphing aircraft is proposed based on the “Firebee” unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). From perspectives of the entire mission profile, a coordinated trajectory optimization and tracking control method is proposed in this paper for this morphing aircraft. This trajectory optimization method provides results of both morphing strategy and state variables regarding aerodynamic advantages of different aircraft geometries. And a traditional controller is designed to track the optimized trajectory during the entire morphing process. The overall performance of the morphing aircraft is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Data mining technology based on the visualization of enterprise human resources information data research
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis and research on the visualization of enterprise human resource information through data mining technology, and conduct research and analysis on the data of enterprise human resource information. Combining the integration idea with the open-source Weka interface, a combined classifier model based on multiple decision tree algorithms is proposed. The data mining model based on rule-based classification and ant colony algorithm is improved and successfully applied to the data mining of the HR management system, and the ideal classification effect and effective decision support are obtained. After simulating the data in the HRMS, it is found that the classification accuracy obtained by the combined classifier is better than the results of the individual classifier. In this paper, the deterministic selection probabilities and volatility coefficients in the algorithm are designed dynamically and adaptively, and the effectiveness of the improved algorithm is verified using the dataset in the UCI public database. Also, the algorithm obtained effective classification rules in the HRMS.

articleTitle: Customer Purchase Behavior Prediction and Analysis based on CRM Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since e-commerce began to be widely used in many industries in China, the traditional methods of customers' purchasing behavior prediction in enterprises cannot meet the current intelligent forecasting with different network characteristics. Therefore, the CRM customer relationship management system based on artificial neural network algorithm is gradually applied to the network business of many enterprises in our country. This paper studies the application of artificial neural network algorithm in the data analysis of CRM system, and has proposed the data analysis technology based on CRM system. This technology can be used to predict and analyze the customer's purchasing behavior through the management of customer's relevant information. Finally, the experimental results show that the CRM system based on artificial neural network algorithm can efficiently predict the customers with purchasing demand through intelligent data analysis technology. Intelligent multiple prediction and analysis are carried out to achieve a new breakthrough in the technology of customers' purchasing behavior prediction in China.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Monitoring System for Oil-immersed Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Transformer plays an important role in the whole power system. To ensure the long-term reliability, the real-time monitoring system is designed in this paper. The software and hardware of the monitoring system have been introduced. With the help of this system, the status of the transformer can be monitored in real time, so that the fault of the transformer can be found and eliminated in time. The reliability of the transformer can be improved with the monitoring system.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of the influence of loading center angle on the determination of rock tensile strength
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the Brazilian split test, under the loading condition of arc loading, there is no strict regulation on the range of the loading center angle of the weakly cemented soft rock sample, which has a significant impact on the results of the sample measurement. According to theoretical analysis, as the loading center angle increases, the tensile strength of the rock shows a decreasing trend. Using FLAC3D numerical analysis software, the arc loading Brazilian splitting numerical simulation test was carried out on different loading center angles, and the influence of loading angle on the measurement of the stress distribution and tensile strength of the disc specimen axis was studied, indicating that appropriately increasing the loading angle can be effective It reduces the stress concentration near the loading point of the Brazilian disc. If the loading angle is too large, it will cause fracturing failure and test failure. According to the Griffith strength criterion, the maximum equivalent stress is located at the center point of the end face of the disc specimen, and the initiation point of the disc split is judged to be the center point of the end face of the disc specimen. As the loading angle increases, the magnitude of the reduction of the equivalent stress at the center point of the end face of the disc also decreases. Finally, through analysis, the reasonable loading angle value for weakly cemented soft rock should between 20 and 25°.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of RTS Smoothing on the Data Post-processing of BDS/INS Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the data post-processing of BDS/INS integrated navigation, the high precision smoothing algorithm is researched aimed at solving the problem of precision degradation caused by the loss of lock of the BDS receiver for a long time. The RTS smoothing algorithm is analyzed when the BDS signal is interrupted, and the equations are given at the same time experimental program are designed. The results show that RTS is not only able to have a smoothing effect on the navigation solution results, but also can significantly weaken the influence of BDS loss of lock to the integrated navigation system.

articleTitle: Research for Development of Interface between SmartPlant P&ID and INPower Software
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the design efficiency of SmartPlant P&ID (SP P&ID for short), the data interface between SP P&ID and INPower software is developed, which overcomes the problem of low efficiency and inconvenient input of I&C equipment related attributes in SP P&ID, and significantly improves the efficiency of SP P&ID design, reduces the error of traditional manual input data, and establishes the solid basis for fine engineering design and digital transfer.

articleTitle: Analysis for Polarization Angle Deviation of Shipborne Satellite Communication Station Based on Three-axis Stability
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the description of the commonly used coordinate systems for shipborne satellite antennas, this paper calculates the conversion matrices between the geographic coordinate system and the deck coordinate system, and the deck coordinate system and the antenna coordinate system, and establishes the AEC three-axis mount model. Based on the geometric derivation calculation of the polarization angle, the polarization angle deviation formula is derived using the antenna three-axis model, and the numerical simulation is performed using MATLAB to analyze the influence of the different angles of the C-axis deviation on the polarization angle under different elevation angles, and further verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis on the Dynamic of a Missile Launch Canister
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The vibration response of the launcher is one of the important sources of the initial disturbance of the missile launch. Based on the theory of multi-body dynamics and finite element analysis, a rigid-flexible coupling model of a vehicle-mounted missile launcher is established, and the vibration response of the launching tube is simulated. Using the method of replacing the rigid and flexible body models of the key components, the order of the main factors affecting the subsidence of the launch tube is obtained, and the conclusion that the subsidence can be reduced by increasing the rigidity of the frame and chassis is proposed.

articleTitle: Secondary development of Solidworks based parts
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The content of this paper is based on SolidWorks secondary development and VB programming to generate 3d standard part library. Then create a 3d standard parts library and the SolidWorks application menu. Select a part according to the needs of different people, select or modify the specific parameters of the standard, and directly generate the required standard parts, which can be used in the assembly environment after completion.

articleTitle: A New Probe for Electromagnetic Compatibility and Electromagnetic Interference Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new probe for electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic interference detection is proposed, designed, and simulated. ANSYS HFSS software is used to design a 3D model and simulate the probe. The simulation result shows that the working frequency band is up to 3 GHz and spatial resolution is less than 4 mm for magnetic and electric field detection. These parameters show a good ability for locating the interference source. The new structure is able to measure the electric and magnetic field simultaneously, improve the efficiency of the near field detection greatly.

articleTitle: A Method for Extracting Cracks in Complex Pavements Based on Probability Statistics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of extracting cracks on highway pavement under complex backgrounds such as water stains and rutting marks, the global image processing method is difficult to separate the foreground and the background, and the cracks cannot be extracted correctly. For this situation, this paper proposes a method based on probability statistics. The original image is divided into blocks, and then statistics and comparisons are performed on each image to complete the preliminary positioning of the crack area, and then perform the traditional image on the crack area. After treatment, the crack was finally extracted successfully. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has a good effect and high accuracy for the extraction of pavement cracks with complex backgrounds.

articleTitle: Research on muzzle response characteristics of small-caliber automatic gun on launching based on rigid-flexible coupling dynamics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The dynamic response characteristic of the muzzle is the main factor affecting the firing accuracy of artillery. To analyze this dynamic response characteristic of a certain type of small-caliber artillery, this paper adopted the multi-body dynamics method and the modal integration method to establish the rigid-flexible coupling dynamics model of this artillery. The dynamic characteristics of the muzzle during firing were simulated, and the firing density calculation model was established. The firing density of the automatic gun's 200-meter vertical target was solved. The simulation results have certain reference value for studying the dynamic characteristics of muzzle and optimization of gun structure.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Financial Management Technology in Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's information technology, China has gradually entered the information age. In the context of this era, Chinese government departments are actively advocating the informatization reform of organizations at all levels of society and commercial enterprises. In this way, computer technology based on information technology can be gradually integrated into the enterprise management system, so as to improve the efficiency of enterprise management and development, and then promote the overall social and economic development. In the corporate management system, financial management is an extremely important part. At the same time, it is also a key management item that affects the company's earnings. In response to this situation, relevant business managers must pay attention to the research on financial management information reform during their practical work, and effectively apply computer financial management technology to financial management. This can not only greatly improve the effectiveness and timeliness of current corporate financial management, but also effectively improve the accuracy of financial management and reduce the complexity of financial management. This study mainly took Wenzhou Wangyi Network Company as an example to make a brief analysis on the application of computer financial management technology in financial management. The purpose of this article is to further improve the application of computer financial management technology and the quality of corporate financial management.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration of Computer Basic Courses into EQ Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This article analyzes the basic content and application value of EQ teaching, and integrates EQ content into basic computer courses based on the concept of “curriculum ideology” in the public basic courses. The content of this article includes that the main body of education is students, following the idea of teaching students in accordance with their aptitude, and infiltrating integrated teaching ideas. The author discusses how to establish a new teaching classroom, build a harmonious relationship between teachers and students, highlight teacher emotional intelligence, help students understand themselves, strengthen student emotional management, and enhance student confidence management to optimize computer-based teaching classrooms. This article aims to help improve the teaching quality of the basic computer courses “Curriculum Ideology”.

articleTitle: New Media Art Communication from the Perspective of Media Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of society, modern science and technology are also developing, the dissemination of new media art is also manifested in different development models. The developed news media bring different visual experience to the public. The new media art communication has independent influence under the media environment and the development of science and technology. Recently, the rapid development has brought important and far-reaching influence to people's work and life. Therefore, the research of new media art communication from the perspective of media environment is particularly important.

articleTitle: Flexible pan tilt control method for substation intelligent indoor inspection robot
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to better improve the operation effect of substation intelligent indoor inspection robot the flexible pan tilt control method of substation intelligent indoor inspection robot is proposed in view of the fact that the existing inspection robot products can not meet the needs of on-site inspection tasks. The overall design scheme and characteristics of the system are introduced by optimizing the core component structure of intelligent inspection robot in Yuntai substation On this basis, the software and hardware of the control system are designed, the functional characteristics and operation standard parameters of the flexible pan tilt control module of the substation intelligent indoor inspection robot are standardized, and the control algorithm and control steps are optimized. The experimental results show that the flexible pan tilt control method of substation intelligent indoor inspection robot has good positioning and control accuracy, and can meet the control requirements of inspection tasks.

articleTitle: The bathroom System for College Students Improving Practice
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the problem that contemporary residential students can't enjoy bathing anytime and anywhere, we use raspberry pie and sensor to simulate the bathroom environment to obtain real-time data of bathroom, and calculate the specific time of bathing through algorithm. In addition, we use HTML5, CSS, JavaScript to realize the remote reservation function, so that users can remotely turn on or off the water heater switch. The power consumption and usage times of the water heater will be recorded in the database, and an electronic report will be generated for one month. Keywords-Interactivity; energy conservation; communities.

articleTitle: The Self-labeling of Unsupervised Polycrystalline Solar Cell Micro-crack Images
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Nowadays the photoelectric system that relies on solar energy is widely used. Solar cells are an important part of this system, and micro-cracks on the solar cells can reduce the overall efficiency. At present micro-cracks are detected manually by examining the electroluminescence (EL) images, which costs much manpower. To achieve the automatic detection of micro-cracks, a new self-labeling method is adopted which can label the image data automatically via simultaneous representation learning and clustering in the paper. Firstly, we build a model for representation learning by selecting ResNet-50 as the base architecture. Then the datasets are labeled automatically by adopting an algorithm that can obtain the optimal transmission of the image. At last, experiments are performed to verify the validity and the robustness of our method. The results show that the newly adopted method is more accurate than the classical clustering methods in the solar cell micro-crack data.

articleTitle: Research and development of an ultrasonic equipment output parameter measurement system based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to test that the ultrasonic therapeutic instrument produced can meet the medical industry standards and avoid the adverse impact of cavitation effect on human tissues, a labview-based ultrasonic equipment output parameter measurement system was designed. This paper first briefly introduces the working principle of ultrasonic therapy equipment and the harm of air chemical effect on human body, then introduces the hardware composition of the system, then designs the software based on virtual instrument measurement system, and finally, in order to verify the practicability and effectiveness of the system, the therapeutic instrument measurement in the market. The system can effectively measure the acoustic output parameter requirements of ultrasonic processing equipment stipulated in the national medical industry standard, and the measurement results can be used as a reference to check whether the equipment is qualified.

articleTitle: Research on Dedicated Data Set for Deep Learning Processor Precision Verification
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rise of the artificial intelligence wave, deep learning processors have received extensive attention from academia and industry due to their strong computing power, low power consumption, small area and other architectural advantages. In order to ensure algorithm compatibility, deep learning processors include many precision designs, its verification space is huge. For this reason, based on the traditional hierarchical verification, in the system-level precision verification, a dedicated data set is proposed. The experiment shows that compared with the traditional random data set, dedicated data set can greatly reduce the simulation time while ensuring the completeness of the verification.

articleTitle: Research and application of related technologies of new generation network communication protocol IPv6
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper expounds the key technologies in the construction of the new generation network under the rapid development of the Internet, and puts forward the design concept based on IPv6 protocol as the main communication protocol. And through tunnel technology, IPv4 / IPv6 dual stack technology, 6LoWPAN and other related technologies to solve the key problems in the process of computer network communication. It lays an important foundation for the realization of more digital and intelligent applications of Internet of things.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Consistency of Multi-Agent Systems with Different Topologies and Time-Delay
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the characteristics of autonomy, coordination, reactivity, adaptability, and robustness, multi-agent systems have been paid more and more attention and widely used in various fields. In multi-agent systems, the consensus convergence processes are highly dependent on the information interaction among agents through the network, and the connectivity of the network topology and the time delay would affect the performance of system consensus convergence. In order to investigate the effect of topology and time delay on the consistency of multi-agent systems, the simulation studies are implemented and the effects of topology and the time-delay on the consensus convergence are analysed, some valuable conclusions are obtained, which provides a reference for the research of consistency in multi-agent systems.

articleTitle: A New Active RFID Tag Based on Three-axis Acceleration Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposed a new active RFID tag based on three-axis acceleration sensor. This device can not only store ID and other information, but also process the three-axis acceleration data and extract feature information of moving objects. After being analyzing and processing by the NRF24LE1E chip with RF module, the acceleration data collected by the LIS3DH three-axis acceleration sensor in the three-dimensional space can be sent to the related devices though the antenna module to complete the data collection and feature extraction. This new active RFID tag can be used in the falling detection system, especially in large application places such as nursing homes.

articleTitle: Classification and inventory control of spare parts based on compound Poisson Demand
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In continuous production enterprises, spare parts are the guarantee for the production and operation. However, the distribution of spare parts demand is uncertain due to the nature of spare parts demand, which is usually intermittent, slow-moving and erratic. This paper proposes a spare parts scheme based on probability distribution by combining spare parts distributional assumptions with spare parts classification, and uses the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) goodness-of-fit test to verify the validity of the scheme. After that, on the basis of classification and adopting the order-up-to-level policy, a cost-oriented inventory model with random lead time was constructed for spare parts based on different compound Poisson distributions. And through examples, the effectiveness of the spare parts classification scheme based on probability distribution in reducing costs is further verified.

articleTitle: Research and application of image compression algorithm suitable for on-site image transmission of infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, massive amounts of image data have been generated at the power construction site. Due to the limitation of power communication transmission bandwidth, it is necessary to improve the low bit rate, high compression ratio, and anti-interference of the image, which is very necessary for on-site management personnel under the premise of ensuring efficient information transmission. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes an improved algorithm based on Set Partitioning in Hierarchical Trees (SPIHT). Firstly, the feature value of the image is extracted, and then the wavelet encoding is performed to obtain the compressed image. Compared with the traditional multi-level tree ensemble splitting algorithm, experimental data show that the image compressed by this algorithm has better visual effects and higher peak signal-to-noise ratio. Therefore, the method can effectively improve the transmission performance of the on-site image of the infrastructure construction, and ultimately improve the efficiency of the on-site inspection for violations.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Main Threats and Key Preventive Measures of Computer Network Information Security Based on Prison Institutions
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, with the continuous development of network technology and information technology, digital management of prisons has become an inevitable trend. At the same time, this is also an important direction for the development of prison management, and relevant managers need to pay more attention to it. Based on previous work experience, this article summarizes the main threats to prison computer network information security. In addition, the author also discusses the prison computer network information security maintenance measures through the combination of the application of VLAN technology, the application of firewall technology, IP address management and virus prevention, system backup and network security management measures, access control, the establishment of corresponding security organizations, and the improvement of management systems.

articleTitle: Environmental Control Decision Method for Livestock and Poultry House Based on Neural Networks and Improved D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of environmental control decision in livestock and poultry breeding, an environmental control decision method was designed, based on neural network and improved Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory. Firstly, the outlier data, collected by sensor, was detected and repaired using box chart method and mean substitution method. Secondly, the first-level decision classification of the data was carried out by using the neural network SoftMax multi-classification method. Finally, the improved D-S evidence theory algorithm was used to implement the final decision of the environmental control system of livestock and poultry house. Taking the environmental control system of chicken house as an example, the simulation experiment verifies the proposed method. The experimental results show that the method can make decision accurately on the environmental control system of chicken house. The proposed method has certain promotion and application value.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Computer Information Processing Technology in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, social development has fully entered a highly informatized state. The application of information technology in various fields of life and production provides a lot of convenience for people's life and work. However, in the big data environment, how to dig out valuable information from massive data while ensuring the safety and reliability of the information storage, transmission and use process is a key issue that needs to be considered in the information age. This article will combine the characteristics of the big data technology environment to analyze the development status of computer information processing technology. The author conducts research and discussion on the specific application of computer information processing technology under the big data environment.

articleTitle: A task life cycle management method to ensure the safe use of resources
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This article introduces a method for handling exceptions during the life cycle of a task. Using quartz and redis technology to design a set of task life cycle management methods, so that tasks can be accurately controlled and ensure the integrity of the task life cycle process.

articleTitle: Optimization of Gear Shaper Cutting Parameters Based on BP Neural Network and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Abaqus finite element simulation technology and BP neural network and genetic algorithm are applied to the study on the optimization of the cutting parameters of the thin-walled ring gear. A simulation model of ring gear shaping was established by Abaqus finite element analysis software, a cutting force prediction model was built using BP neural network. With the help of the BP neural network and genetic algorithm function extreme value optimization feature, the gear ring gear shaping parameter optimization model was established, and the Abaqus simulation model was used to test it. The relevant slotting parameters, namely the slotting speed, the amount of back-cutting and the circumferential feed speed have been successfully optimized, and the slotting force has been reduced. The experimental results show that the parameter optimization model of ring gear shaping based on BP neural network and genetic algorithm can effectively realize the optimization of slotting parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration and Noise of SUV Chassis Suspension System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the chassis system of modern automobiles, the suspension is used as the connecting medium between the wheels and the body, which can produce relative elastic motion between the two, and transmit the force and moment between the two, and alleviate the impact transmitted from the road Load to ensure smooth and stable driving of the car. Automotive NVH technology is one of the important performance indicators for Hyundai Motor's research and development, and vibration and noise are the two most important indicators in NVH performance research. When the car is driving, the road surface excitation is transmitted through the suspension system and acts on the body system to generate noise. The inherent characteristics of the chassis suspension system have an important influence on the vehicle vibration and noise problems. In this paper, the vehicle's vibration and noise research is carried out on the chassis suspension system of a certain SUV, the finite element modeling of the suspension system's shock absorber is carried out, and the finite element modal analysis is carried out.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Test Technology Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Fuzzy testing technology has a good effect in discovering web vulnerabilities, which is incomparable with other security testing technologies. Because of the randomness and unpredictability of its test cases, it can dig out the relevant vulnerabilities comprehensively and systematically. Before that, some researchers proposed to use genetic algorithm to generate test cases to solve the problem of single test cases. However, the test cases generated by genetic algorithm are often of high randomness, and the proportion of effective test cases is relatively low. According to this problem, I proposed to generate test cases based on generative countermeasure network. On the basis of ensuring its randomness, the relevant test cases are generated pertinently. Through relevant experiments, it is proved that the generated confrontation network can generate effective test cases. Compared with the test cases generated by genetic algorithm, its effectiveness is better and more web vulnerabilities can be found.

articleTitle: Research on Arm of an Improved Palletizing Robot with Parallel Four-bar Linkage
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Objective: to study the mechanical properties of the arm structure of palletizing robot with parallel four-bar linkage, and whether it can meet the requirements of higher and higher load and motion speed of palletizing robot in automatic packaging production line. Methods: in this paper, the arm structure of parallel four-bar palletizing robot is analyzed, and its strength is simulated by ANSYS finite element analysis software. Results: the stress nephogram of forearm and rear arm was obtained, the maximum stress value of forearm was 38.4mpa, the maximum displacement was 0.9mm, the maximum stress value of rear arm was 10.7Mpa, the maximum displacement was 0.02mm. Conclusion: the maximum deformation and maximum stress of the forearm and the rear boom can meet the design requirements through the cloud image analysis, which proves that the parallel four-bar arm structure can meet the large bearing capacity, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of the arm structure of the palletizing robot.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform and Practice of Comprehensive Design of Mechanical Course
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The comprehensive design of mechanical course is a practical training to entirely examine students' mechanical knowledge. With the wide application of computer and Internet technology, this paper puts forward the teaching reform measures of mechanical course design to adapt to the new situation. In the teaching, we should strengthen the teaching implementation, introduce the computer-aided software course design, establish the “Yuketang” real-time discussion and question answering, and update the performance evaluation mode, which has a good effect.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Group Drug-related Incident Evolution
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Group drug-related incidents occur frequently in the current society, and it is necessary to study the transmission mechanism of drug-related behavior. By studying the social network of drug-related groups, it is found that the initial number of drug-related behaviors, people's immunity to drug-related behaviors, and the ability to spread drug-related behaviors all affect the evolution of group drug-related incidents. Based on the Agent modeling theory and the NetLogo simulation platform, the propagation model of individual drug-related behavior in social networks is established on the basis of the SIR model to simulate the evolution process of group drug-related behavior. Simulation results show that the larger the initial number of drug-related behaviors, the lower the immunity of people to drug-related behaviors, and the more infectious the behaviors of drug-related behaviors, the faster and larger the scale of the evolution from individual drug-related behaviors to group drug-related behaviors. By studying the evolution mechanism of group drug-related incidents, it is helpful for public security organs to prevent group drug-related incidents from occurring.

articleTitle: Facial expression recognition in VGG network based on LBP feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: LBP (Local binary mode) is a local spatial structure that describes an image. It has gray invariance and good robustness against background noise and visible light. In this paper, after image processing with LBP and VGG network, face facial expression recognition was studied. Experiments were carried out in CK+ data set, and the accuracy reached 96%. The experimental results show that this method is more advanced and effective than VGG network and traditional methods.

articleTitle: Shift Quality Analysis of Power Reversing Tractor
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the shift quality of the power reversing tractor, the parameter configuration of the gearbox wet clutch was studied in this paper. Firstly, the transmission principle of the power reversing tractor was introduced; then, the mathematical model of the key parts such as wet clutch, proportional pressure reducing valve and the whole tractor were constructed; thirdly, four clutch control parameters affecting the shift quality were determined, namely, the instruction time <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t_{1}$</tex>∼<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t_{3}$</tex> and the instruction voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{1}$</tex> of the proportional pressure reducing valve, and the shift quality evaluation index used in this study was determined. Finally, based on four factors and three levels orthogonal test method, the clutch control parameters under different conditions were optimized. The results show that: with the increase of gear, the values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t_{2}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{1}$</tex> should be moderately increased; <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t_{1}$</tex> should be larger under any working conditions; <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t_{3}$</tex> should be smaller in high or low gear, otherwise the value level should be increased moderately; the driver should try to use power shift at lower gear and engine speed.

articleTitle: Reliability prediction of CNC machine tools based on GM(1,1)-SVM combined model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of low cost and complex influencing factors of CNC machine tool failure data sample collection, a combination prediction model based on gray prediction and support vector machine is proposed, use Python and MATLAB software to predict the time between failures of CNC machine tools in the SVM model and the GM(1,1) model, respectively, and obtain the predicted time between failures, use the standard deviation method to determine the weight of the combined model, and establish GM(1,1)-SVM combined prediction model, the accuracy and practicability of the combined forecasting model are verified through examples. The results show that the prediction of the combined model is higher than that of the single model and the results are reliable, the combined model provides a theoretical basis for the CNC machine tool users and maintenance personnel to maintain it in advance, and has guiding value for the reliability prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Metering Management System of Water-Supply Network Based on LBS
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of social economy and the acceleration of urbanization, the demand of water-supply in China is increasing. The normal operation of urban water supply network is of great significance to the full utilization and sustainable development of water resources. However, the leakage problem of water supply pipe network is still serious in our country, which not only causes the waste of water resources, affects the economic benefits of water-supply enterprises, but also endangers the safety of urban construction, in this paper, the LBS service is fully integrated into the metering management system of the water-supply network, so that the management of the water-supply network is not limited by the region, and the self-positioning technology of the mobile client is used in combination with the visual geographic information system, a more convenient metering management system is developed to realize the real-time monitoring of water-supply network.

articleTitle: STGCN For Modeling Vehicle Trajectory in Highway Scenario
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposed a method based on STGCN (Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network) for predicting vehicles trajectories on highway. This method takes interaction between vehicles and lane information into consideration. In this work, TCN (Temporal Convolutional Network) is used for extracting spatial features, which performs better in long term forecasting than RNN. And this model reduces the amount of input from the perception module, it only requires lane information and vehicles' real-time coordinates, which means it has a low-level demand for computing power.

articleTitle: Research on Security Management Technology of Computer Network Database
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, computer networks have been widely used and have become an indispensable and important part of people's lives and work. Especially in the computer network database, a lot of personal and organizational information is stored. Based on previous work experience, this article summarizes the common security problems of computer network databases. The author also discusses the security management technology strategy of computer network databases from six aspects: security management mode, virus killing technology, encryption technology, storage management technology, backup technology, and identity authentication technology.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Technology of Large-capacity Capacitor Based on PD of Oscillatory Wave
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: High-voltage large-capacity capacitors, as an indispensable important electrical equipment in the power grid system, have important applications in many scenarios such as transmission lines, substations, and the end of distribution lines. In the course of use, if problems such as insulation aging occur, it may threaten the personal safety of the people and staff and cause huge economic losses. The purpose of partial discharge detection of high-voltage large-capacity capacitors is to detect the internal defects of the capacitor before the capacitor fails, to understand the insulation state of the equipment in time, to better monitor the deterioration process of the equipment, and to effectively understand the current reality of the equipment health status. At present, capacitor partial discharge detection methods include power frequency withstand voltage method, DC partial discharge detection method and ultrasonic detection method. Each method has some unavoidable defects. The research in this paper intends to use the partial discharge detection technology based on oscillating wave to carry out the insulation fault detection of high-voltage large-capacity capacitors. The monitoring and early warning of early capacitor failures have been realized, and the hidden faults and defects of the capacitors can be found in advance, and the safety and reliability of the equipment can be improved.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Ideological and Political Education and Employment Direction Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the complexity of college students, we apply it to the ideological and political education and employment guidance with the help of two attributes of the core idea of particle swarm optimization. In order to adapt to the development of the situation and cultivate high-quality talents to meet the needs of the society, according to the characteristics of College Students' employment and the new employment environment, colleges and universities should further strengthen the ideological and political education of college students in employment guidance, so as to guide them to establish a correct outlook on employment, values and life, so as to ensure the harmony and development of talent cultivation in Colleges and universities. In the research of the ideological and political education and employment guidance of college students, we can use the particle swarm optimization principle to model the individual and group consciousness behavior of the educated, so as to help the ideological and political education educators optimize and improve the traditional working methods according to different situations. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the employment status of college students, this paper attempts to establish the mode of integration of the whole process employment guidance and ideological and political education in Colleges and universities, so as to expand the path of employment work and ideological and political education in Colleges and universities, and further improve the working skills, employment quality and ideological and political quality of college students.

articleTitle: Failure analysis on the bolt fracture of pressure control valve in power plant
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A bolt of an intermediate pressure stream control valve in a power plant was broken. Through macro inspection, chemical composition analysis, mechanical analysis and metallographic analysis of the broken bolt, it is shown that the microstructure and grains of the bolt have been deteriorated during long-term high temperature operation, which results in the degradation of the mechanical properties of the material, and finally brittle fracture occurred.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of License Plate Recognition in Regional Vehicle Circulation Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The goal is to solve the problem of vehicle circulation without a visual system in the traditional community. This system helps the community's traffic managers handle various vehicles' circulation and parking, making the area more orderly and circulate. First, the function of license plate recognition needs to be mastered, and then the license plate recognition will be used as the core of the vehicle circulation management system. Finally, the system's various functional parts are completed according to the functional requirements proposed by the community traffic manager. The system will generate work logs at regular intervals when it starts to work. It is convenient to analyze the system or work in the future. The entire system is tested, and the system's reliability and the functions that need to be improved are comprehensively analyzed. Traffic managers cooperate with the system, the phenomenon of incorrect parking vehicles in the community, and the circulation of vehicles in the area has been reduced and improved. System generated log can also help to check the errors in the work, to a certain extent, optimize the existing vehicle circulation management problems.

articleTitle: Competition Neural Network Model Application in the Bilingual Teaching Quality Evaluation of Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Combined with the general principle of teaching evaluation and the characteristics of bilingual teaching, a more scientific and reasonable evaluation index system of bilingual teaching quality in colleges and universities is constructed. Based on the advantages of competitive neural network in adaptive learning of pattern classification, this paper presents an evaluation method of bilingual teaching quality in colleges and universities based on competitive network, and takes the bilingual course “Port Planning and Layout” as an example to analyze and calculate, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the application of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Application of Computer-Aided Design Rhino in Ceramic Art Design Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Firstly, this paper briefly introduces computer-aided Rhino software. Then it expounds the application of Rhino software in ceramic art design teaching, including the application of 3D printing in ceramics, 3 D modeling in ceramics and 2 D plane graphics in ceramics. Finally, it elaborates the advantages of Rhino in ceramic art teaching, including developing ceramic art design thinking, combining theory with practice, improving ceramic art teaching effect and enhancing students' interest in learning, in order to make ceramic art design related personnel pay attention to Rhino in ceramic art design process, which is conducive to improving ceramic art design teaching effect.

articleTitle: Characters Recognition of Korean Historical Document Base on Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Character recognition of historical document is one of the most important basic tasks in the digitization of historical document. This paper is aimed at the few-shot learning problem of Korean ancient character recognition, a data enhancement method that combines traditional data and a conditional deep convolution generation confrontation network is proposed to obtain expanded samples. Then analyzed the performance of the Lenet@5 and Lenet@8 network models in Korean ancient character recognition. The experimental results show that the expanded sample significantly enriches the experimental data, and the improved Lenet@8 network model is better than Lenet@5, which can better acquire image features and greatly improve the classification accuracy. The proposed method can solve the problem of Recognition of Text-Image Characters of Korean Historical Document. Keywords-Character recognition of Korean historical document; Few-shot learning; Data augmentation; Generative Adversarial Networks; Convolutional neural network.

Author Keywords: Character recognition of Korean historical document

articleTitle: Research on Fatigue Failure of Damping Valve Based on Water Hammer Pressure
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Regarding to the phenomenon that the throttle valve plate was impacted and failed during the test of the damping valve, the reason was analyzed through the water hammer theory, and the physical model of damping valve was built. On this basis, the equation of valve opening varying with time was derived, and the mathematical model of damping valve non-transient opening and closing water hammer was created through feature line method. The influence of the structural parameters of the orifice at the throttle plate on the transient impact on the damper valve was analyzed by programming, and it was concluded that increasing the area of the orifice can reduce the impact of the valve. The conclusions can be used as design reference for damping valves, so as to avoid the recurrence of valve fracture.

articleTitle: Tensile property analysis of 20A-2 escalator drive chain
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The 20A-2 drive chain is one of the commonly used drive chain models for escalators. In this paper, the tensile properties of a 5-year-old drive chain were tested. The tensile properties and microstructure were analyzed. The tensile test results show that the tensile strength meets the requirements of relevant standards. The results of microstructure analysis show that there are poor and decarburized phenomena on the surface of outer chain plate and intermediate chain plate.

articleTitle: A nonlinear micro-current measurement circuit applied in Langmuir probe
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A nonlinear micro-current measurement circuit suitable for Langmuir probe, capable of operating over a wide range of temperatures is presented. It measures bipolar currents from -100nA to 100μA on a nonlinear scale with a current resolution less than 1pA. This circuit is designed for the diagnosis of ionospheric plasma, which can meet the needs of ionospheric detection in different altitudes and latitudes. The experimental results in the space simulation environment also verify the circuit's excellent ability to collect micro current.

articleTitle: Application and research status of hybrid technology in vehicle engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since China began to implement reform and opening-up policy, our economy, technology, culture and education have been comprehensively developed, but they have caused serious pollution and damage to the environment. “With a long-term vision, President Xi Jinping put forward a strategy of sustainable development in 2011 in order to enable our country's long-term development and not to develop our economy at the cost of destroying the environment. As soon as this strategy was launched, it received positive domestic response and hybrid power technology has also entered the public view since 2011. “Hybrid power technology is a kind of vehicle driving technology. It can achieve the purpose of energy saving and emission reduction through reasonable control of vehicle power, gas and oil. It will not only not affect the overall vehicle power, but also reduce the running cost of the vehicle and seek more benefits for the owner.

articleTitle: Comparison of three denoising methods for cardiac diffusion tensor imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Cardiac diffusion tensor imaging (CDTI) provides unique information on the structure, organization, and integrity of the myocardium. However, the inherently low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) limits the accuracy in parameter estimations. Recently, several post-processing algorithms have been proposed to improve image quality in brain DTI, but their performance is unknown in CDTI. This paper evaluates three different denoising algorithms (ANLM, LPCA, and MPPCA) in CDTI regarding image quality and accuracy of parameters with simulation and ex-vivo experiments. We add white Gaussian noise to the simulated DWI images and average ex-vivo data with various repetitions to imitate CDTI images with different SNRs. Then, denoising methods are applied, and the performance is evaluated by SNR and RMSE. The results show that the SNR is improved by 72.38%, 127.01%, 0.6% in simulation, and 327.38%, 474.56%, 173.19% in ex-vivo experiments by the three methods, respectively. The uncertainty of parameters is reduced by all three algorithms in the ex-vivo experiment.

articleTitle: An MQTT-based Scalable Remote Control Framework with NodeMCU and Cloud platfrom
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wi-Fi(IEEE802.11x) has an unshakable position in the field of wireless communication technology due to its low-cost, high-speed characteristics with wide coverage and large data transmission volume. In the Internet of Things(IoT) fields such as smart home, smart medical care and smart transportation, applications for remote control via easy-peasy Wi-Fi modules are in abundance. The development of cloud platform enables devices scattered in different areas to access the Internet for centralized control and breaks geographical restrictions. In the communication process, choosing an appropriate, reliable and lightweight application layer protocol with less load can better guarantee the quality of data transmission and so improve efficiency. In this paper, we proposed an scalable remote control framework based on MQTT application protocol. We utilize the simple-to-deploy, easy-to-develop NodeMCU board as edge wireless Wi-Fi nodes called SA, LK and SS NMN. Combined with a single-chip microcomputer deployed with MQTT application layer protocol through TCP transparent transmission, the control system will be connected into cloud platform with proper burned SDK. In this way, people can control devices remotely, and cooperate with RocketMQ messages for message flow. We deployed a relatively complete experimental system, and verified the feasibility and reliability of the framework by testing the message delivery time and efficiency of pub/sub scenarios. The experimental results show that the speed of uplink and downline of this framework is within and above reason, and the efficiency is still high in the QoS2 state.

articleTitle: Boosting Black-box Adversarial Attack with a Better Convergence
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: While the neural network plays a significant role in image recognition, it's vulnerable to the adversarial examples, which is a potential threat to the deep learning systems. However, the adversarial examples can also be used to validate the effectiveness of the networks. And the transferability of the adversarial examples needed to be improved. Learning rate decay is a trick that is often used in the model training, and we apply this method into the generation of the adversarial examples. The Step Size Decay Iterative Fast Gradient Sign Method and Step Size Decay Momentum Iterative Fast Gradient Sign Method are proposed in this paper, which lead to better convergence and improve the attack performance of the adversarial examples on black-box models. Extensive experiments on ImageNet have validated the effectiveness of our methods.

articleTitle: 3D reconstruction of human denture based on line laser
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the improvement of living standards, foods with high sugar content will bring oral health problems, so the problem of 3D reconstruction of teeth is derived. Human denture has the characteristics of complex curved surface, high manufacturing accuracy and complex measurement. Alginate materials are widely used in mainstream dental clinics to act on patients' oral cavity. The denture models are obtained by multiple occlusions of the upper and lower jaw of the patients, and then sent to the processing plant for manufacturing, and finally polished, which takes about 3 to 7 days. The abovementioned processing plants often use the method of impression filling, which will produce great error during the processing, and even in the later stage of model dressing, it can not achieve high precision. Therefore, accurate measurement of human denture is the key factor of tooth preparation.

articleTitle: Temporal action proposal generation Based on Boundary Probability
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Temporal action proposal generation is widely used in video processing, action recognition and other fields. Aiming at the problems of the existing methods of temporal action proposal generation that fail to effectively use the Temporal information of video frames and the blurring of action boundaries, this paper proposes a method of time-series action proposal based on boundary probability, and the existing method based on slider and action score temporal action proposal generation method is different. In this paper, a time series boundary probability generation network is generated to generate the boundary sequence in order to optimize the time series boundary fuzzy problem; at the same time, the proposal evaluation network is constructed to optimize the time series proposal segment; in addition, the improved Maximum value suppression algorithm--DTS-NMS to further improve the temporal action proposal generation results. The experimental results show that the constructed model has achieved competitive effects on the two public datasets of ActivityNet-1.3 and THUMO14 (represented as large datasets and small and medium datasets, respectively).

articleTitle: Research and application of permanent magnet power generation control
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of electrical equipment of different power levels on vehicles, improve the efficiency of electrical equipment, this article uses a permanent magnet synchronous motor to construct a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{DC} \pm 28\mathrm{V}$</tex> power supply network, to meet the power demand of DC 28V and 56V electrical equipment, realize the high-power output of the power supply electrical system under the engine idling condition

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling Based on Three-point Shooting
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the popularity of basketball, the tense, fierce atmosphere and more aggressive defense in basketball games have caused the shooting percentage to be greatly reduced. According to research, there are two key shooting models that affect the shooting rate. Starting from the shooting angle of the ball when shooting, the shooting speed, the horizontal distance between the center of the basketball and the center of the basket, as well as the relationship between the basketball incident angle, various factors are analyzed. The author analyzed impact on the shooting percentage, and made appropriate assumptions, in the case of a reasonable estimate of the distance between the shooting point and the center of the basket and maintaining a stable shooting speed, determined the best shooting angle and best shooting speed for shooting, and obtained a capable. Through this paper, it can be concluded that the shooting angle can improve the shooting rate without using too much physical energy when shooting. In addition, it is hoped that the model can be applied to other fields in the future.

articleTitle: Mining Deep Part Features for Pedestrian Search
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of pedestrian's side or occlusions in pedestrian search task, which leads to that neural network can't learn some local features and slow search speed. BatchDrop module for pedestrian re-identification is proposed, which is applied to re-identification stage of two-stage pedestrian search. In the detection stage, faster R-CNN uses ASPP to detect targets. The pedestrian re-identification network is composed of two branches. The global branch extracts the significant global characteristics of pedestrians. Local branch uses BatchDrop module, which randomly discards the same semantically similar part of the feature to enhance the learning of the rest of the features in a training batch. Finally, the feature vectors of the two branches are fused as the final feature vector. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high search accuracy and the search speed is 6-25 times faster than other similar accuracy algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Scaffolding Theory in Computer Professional Courses-Take the data structure as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Data structure is one of the important courses of basic education for computer students. In this study, aiming at the disadvantages of traditional data structure teaching, we try to apply scaffolding theory to teaching to improve the whole teaching mode and effect to a great extent.

articleTitle: Health Status Recognition of Coal Shearer Based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm Optimized Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems that the current shearer health status recognition method requires repeated collection of expert comments and the low recognition rate of the shallow neural network, a shearer health status recognition algorithm based on the Artificial Bee Colony algorithm(ABC) to optimize the Deep Belief Network(DBN) is proposed. First, the state index parameters that affect the health status of the shearer are selected according to the evaluation index selection principle, and the parameters are used for the input of the status recognition model; second, the health status of the shearer is identified based on DBN recognition model, at the same time, in order to optimize the DBN network structure and improve the model recognition rate, Artificial Bee Colony algorithm is introduced to optimize the key parameters of the DBN model. Finally, the feasibility of the optimized identification method is demonstrated through comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of supercontinuum based on microstructure fiber
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the supercontinuum (SC) based on microstructure fiber is studied numerically. The propagation equation of pulse in optical fiber which is nonlinear Schrodinger equation (NLSE) is proposed, and the numerical simulation of SC is carried out. The influence of these factors on SC generation will be studied by changing the parameters of pump pulse, fiber length and dispersion. The effects of pump pulse power, pulse width, fiber length and dispersion on SC are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Lighting Control System Based on Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This novel intelligent lighting control system is designed for the smart lights on the car at night, using computer vision to collect road information in the night and give the fruits to the controller to control the car's lights. Thus, the night lights can be controlled intelligently. The system consists of a night road detection and image acquisition module, image feature extraction and object detection module, and light status control module. Firstly, the road information is obtained from a camera, and then the image is processed and detected. According to vehicles' characteristics at night, the feature vectors of a headlight, taillight, street lights, and other bright spots are extracted. The extracted feature vectors are imported into a convolution neural network for training and verification of the training set and test set. After obtaining the pavement information results, the light status control module determines the intelligent light's strategy. The performance of the intelligent lighting control system is verified.

articleTitle: Key Technology Research on the Inspection Robot for High-Voltage Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The main methods used to inspect high-voltage transmission lines at present are ground-based manual visual observation method and helicopter/unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-aided aerial surveying method, which, however, are of high potential safety hazards, low precision, large intensity and high cost. Given this, a new-type inspection robot for high-voltage transmission lines was designed. First, the background, operating environment and domestic (Chinese) and foreign research status were investigated, the complete machine structure of the new-type inspection robot was designed and analyzed in details, the feasibility of the physical prototype obstacle-surmounting plan was experimentally verified, and it was finally proved that the proposed design scheme of the complete machine structure was practical.

articleTitle: Design of on-board gateway based on Open CPU
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Traditional on-board gateways have many shortcomings, such as response speed, transmission bandwidth, data processing performance, and software portability. In view of these shortcomings, this paper proposes an on-board gateway design method based on Open CPU. The business logic is transferred from MCU to Open CPU, and the collection of body data information is isolated from the gateway function, so as to realize a new on-board gateway system. In this paper, Open CPU is used to design the on-board gateway system, which has the advantages of fast response speed, high transmission bandwidth, good data processing performance and strong software portability. The test table shows that the system has a good realtime performance and improves the response speed and transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Equivalence Discrimination of Social Security Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Problem equivalence discrimination aims to compare two problems and determine whether they are semantically equivalent, it is a binary classification problem. This is a crucial task for QA. This paper studies the problem equivalence discrimination in the field of Chinese social security, proposes a question equivalence discrimination system based on Bert + Focal-Loss, and constructs the question data set in the field of social security. It solves the problem of imbalance between positive and negative samples, so as to input more negative samples for pre training, improve the accuracy of the system, construct the question data set of social security field according to a certain annotation proportion, fill in the lack of data set in professional field, and expand the data set according to the users' wishes.

articleTitle: Research on automatic heart sound segmentation algorithm based on feature fusion envelope
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of effective segmentation of heart sounds, a heart sound segmentation algorithm based on multi envelope feature fusion was proposed in this paper, which used interval search combined with threshold judgment to locate S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>and S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Firstly, the PCG signal was denoised by multi-scale wavelet soft threshold. Then the normalized Shannon energy envelope and the Viola integral envelope were extracted for the denoised signal. The Pearson correlation coefficients between the two and the original signal were calculated respectively. And then the fusion was carried out according to the correlation. Next, the envelope peak points were searched in large interval and between minizones by interval search. After that, the variance of search results was compared and the result with smaller variance was used to compensate for the peak value. Finally, the pseudo peak was removed according to the maximum duration of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.
