Through the evaluation of PhysioNet-2016 data set, the F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> score was 0.9015, which proved that this method can effectively supplement the current heart sound segmentation algorithm.

articleTitle: An empirical Study on Industrial Agglomeration in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area based on Location Quotient
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has become a national regional development strategy. From the perspective of the development of the world's famous Bay Area, as an economic community, cities in the Bay Area should conduct industrial division and cooperation according to their own industrial advantages, so as to achieve mutual industrial development. By measuring the location quotient index of the manufacturing and service industrial structure in the Greater Bay Area of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao, this paper analyzes the industrial agglomeration advantages of the “nine cities and two districts” in the Greater Bay Area, so as to provides the basis for the follow-up study on the division of labor and cooperation among cities in the Bay Area, especially the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry.

Author Keywords: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
Transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry

articleTitle: Monitoring of Transformer Winding Looseness Based on Chaos and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to monitor the mechanical state of transformer winding more accurately and effectively, a new method based on phase space reconstruction and gray wolf optimization K-means (GWO-Kmeans) clustering algorithm is proposed. Firstly, according to the chaotic characteristics of transformer vibration signals, considering the visibility of reconstruction space, the embedding dimension is chosen to be 3. Secondly, the mutual information method is used to calculate the optimal delay time τ for phase space reconstruction of transformer vibration signal. Then, the gray wolf algorithm is used to optimize the K-means algorithm to select more reasonable initial cluster center, and then GWO-Kmeans algorithm is used to find the cluster center of reconstructed signal phase trajectory. Finally, according to the change of distance from the center displacement vector sum of cluster to the origin, the loose state of transformer winding is monitored. The results show that the GWO-Kmeans clustering algorithm effectively improves the accuracy of clustering results. The change of the center displacement vector and the distance between the coordinate and the origin of the phase trace cluster of the transformer vibration signal can reflect the loose state of the winding, thus providing a theoretical basis for the maintenance of the loose state of the transformer winding.

articleTitle: A Method of Real listing stratified psychiatry for Multidimensional Signatures and Trajectories on Big Data Platform & Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because of schizophrenia hard recovery, sub-health which traditional medicine is empirical method is clinical medical treatment, however, medicine itself is difficult to solve mental illness, combined with modern artificial intelligence (AI )and big data characteristics analysis. This article starts from the four research questions of schizophrenia and analyzes need to be stored in clinical trials and scientific research data types, including basic information, case report form data, neuropsychological and cognitive function evaluation, magnetic resonance data, Data modeling for brain science, neuroscience data and intestinal flora data. Through Big Data statistics machine learning characteristics, and cloud computing platform analysis, prevention and mental health guidance is ideal. The experimental results show that the family relationship between parents and grandparents is good, and it is easier to treat mental schizophrenia than divorce and single.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Based on Sparse Enhancement and Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of compressed sensing theory, a large number of image denoising, image fusion, image super-resolution and collaborative filtering algorithms based on sparse enhancement have been proposed, and they have been widely used. However, the current research on sparse enhancement and collaborative filtering algorithms that have been applied to various image recognition fields still needs improvement. In this regard, the purpose of this article is to study image recognition based on sparse enhancement and collaborative filtering algorithms. In this paper, the score prediction value of the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm is affected by the number of common items. It starts by reducing the sparsity of common scoring items in the closest neighbors, and includes the closest neighbor users who are similar to the target user but have not yet scored the target item. Finally, the global and local features of the image are extracted to construct global and local feature dictionaries. The feature vectors of the image are jointly coded on the corresponding feature dictionaries. In addition, the size of the contribution of different features is reflected in the coding domain through adaptive weighting. The classification of the image will be recognized, which is determined by the overall coding error. The experimental results prove that the sparse representation and collaborative filtering algorithms are highly feasible. Both occluded and unoccluded image recognition experiments performed very well, and the recognition rate reached more than 90%. It is very helpful for the development of image recognition system in actual industrial production.

articleTitle: Innovative Ideas for Promoting Information Management in E-Commerce Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The development of Internet technology has promoted the rapid pout of e-commerce industry, and its market turnover is increasing year by year. In the course of decades of development, the e-commerce industry has experienced a transformation from extensive management mode to refinement. Unlike other industries, e-commerce is a marketing model based on network and online platforms, so the data sources, types and quantities of mobile users and consumers are very large. In this environment, how to accurately judge the information of mobile users and network consumers is very important. Based on the theory of market concentration, this paper analyzes the influence of information management on all aspects of e-commerce industry, and puts forward the development countermeasures and methods of information management according to the characteristics of information platform, in order to further achieve the high-quality development of e-commerce industry in China.

articleTitle: Management Innovation of Party Building Work in Higher Vocational Colleges under the Background of "Internet +" and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the process of increasing the level of informatization technology, the development speed of Internet technology is also getting faster and faster. Big data technology and Internet technology have become important types of technology used in various industries. In the context of "Internet +" and big data, innovative management of the current party building work in higher vocational colleges can improve the efficiency and quality of party building work. In the management of party building in higher vocational colleges, we need to study the actual application of network technology and the actual requirements of party building work. The author of this article puts forward the key points of the application of Internet + and big data technology in campus party building innovation management.

articleTitle: Quality Analysis and Evaluation Method for Multisource Aggregation Data based on Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the era of big data, how to evaluate the data quality of multi-source aggregation data is very important. The reason is that uneven data quality will directly lead to inaccurate or ambiguous data in the database, and indirectly lead to the deviation of subsequent data mining and decision-making. In this paper, structural equation model(SEM) is introduced to explore the effectiveness of various data quality evaluation indicators in data aggregation and finding out internal relationship between them. A new quality evaluation method of multi-source aggregation data is proposed, based on the regression's significance analysis and factor loads of each observation index in the SEM model. The case analysis shows that the proposed method is feasible and can be used to evaluate the quality of multi-source aggregation data adaptively for a long time.

articleTitle: Research on computer network reliability optimization method based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The reliability of computer network refers to the availability of the network at the user level. The higher the degree, the more reliable the network is. However, the higher the reliability is, the higher the cost in the network will be. At this time, it is necessary to reduce the network cost as far as possible on the basis of reliability standard. This is the real purpose of reliability optimization of computer network. However, it is not easy to optimize the reliability of computer network. Many factors need to be considered and relevant algorithm can be used to realize it. In this paper, based on genetic algorithm, the specific method of computer network reliability optimization based on genetic algorithm is analyzed.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of escalator drive chain plate used for 5 years
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the performance analysis of the drive chain plate of escalator 16A-2, which has been used for 5 years, is carried out. The results of chemical analysis show that the materials of outer chain plate and intermediate chain plate are equal to 45Mn. According to the tensile test results, the tensile strength of the chain meets the requirements of relevant standards. The results of metallographic analysis show that poor and decarburization can be seen on the surface of outer chain plate and intermediate chain plate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Computer Graphic Image Design and Visual Communication Design
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the progress of the times and the development of society, big data technology has initially covered all areas of society, which has brought great help to people's lives and enterprise innovation. In the era of big data, computer technology is one of the simplest, most widely used and most frequently used technologies. With the improvement of people's quality of life and aesthetic standards, traditional image design and visual communication can no longer meet people's aesthetic standards. Therefore, relevant design enterprises have introduced computer technology into the system of graphic image design and visual communication design, in order to innovate image design and improve visual communication quality. According to the quality and aesthetic problems existing in current graphic image design and visual communication design, this paper analyzes the concepts and functions of computer graphic image design and visual communication design, and then summarizes the system composition of computer graphic image design and visual communication design, so as to reflect the powerful functions of computer graphic image design and visual communication design system. Keywords-analysis computer;

articleTitle: Design and Study of a Self-powered Double-layer Parking Device
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The paper puts forward a self-powered double-layer parking device, aimed at solving the problem of a serious shortage of parking space and transformational difficulty in older urban communities. The parking device was driven by the power of the car and driver, which can be accessed to cars independently. The detailed force analysis of the device was carried out thoroughly, which is combined with the structure and the driving principle of the device. Based on the parameters, the structure of the device was determined and the self-powered systems, satisfying the requirements, were designed. Taking the height of the column and the force point of wire, the analysis and research of dynamic simulation was accomplished, based on the ADAMS accomplished. The dynamic performance optimization design was obtained and the rationality and feasibility of the device were verified, too.

articleTitle: Gesture recognition for sign language Video Stream Translation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Due to the complexity of camera viewing angle, background and different execution speed, the difference between hand movements is low, which makes it difficult to extract features in the process of sign language recognition. In order to solve this problem, we propose a sign language recognition framework based on attention mechanism, which enables the network to pay attention to the areas that contain objects related to the activities under consideration. We use Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping in the pre-trained CNN for general image recognition to learn the attention map of each frame, and use convolutional LSTM to encode the video in time and space. In view of the fact that the convolution structure in LSTM has no obvious contribution to spatio-temporal feature fusion, the LSTM is adjusted to make it possible to effectively fuse spatiotemporal features with less parameters and computation.

articleTitle: “Internet +” Art Teaching Practice of Tao Xingzhi
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: “Internet +” era, the society needs innovative talents, but the traditional teaching mode is difficult to cultivate innovative thinking talent. With the change of times, we need innovative thinking to contrast and modify the traditional teaching mode, as well as art teaching. The probability of using fixed thinking art teaching to cultivate innovative talents is very low, so the teaching mode of art should be combined with Tao Xingzhi's ideological theory to teach students better. As a great thinker and educator of our country, Tao Xingzhi, the core of his ideological theory is to cultivate students' creativity, and also plays an important role in contemporary art education. This paper mainly expounds the significance and practice of Tao Xingzhi's educational thought in art education.

articleTitle: Online process optimization system and method of cutting chip
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, more and more enterprises engaged in NC machining have invested a lot of money to optimize product processing technology, due to the optimization of processing technology that it can reduce costs can greatly reduce enterprise cost, improve processing efficiency, reduce material loss, and improve operation safety and controllability. However, process optimization is a very complex problem. Many factors such as environment, equipment and operators have an impact on process optimization. A little change of one of these factors will lead to different parameters obtained from process optimization. Although it has been many years, there is still no universal process optimization method. In this paper, we developed an online process optimization system and method of cutting chip which can effectively improve processing efficiency and reduce processing costs.

articleTitle: Dynamic En-route Speed Profile Adjustment Strategy Design for Continuous Descend Operations Based on 4D Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming to reduce the uncertainty of the trajectory of Continuous Descend Operations (CDO) in high-density airspace, it is necessary to design a constrained speed profile during the CDO procedures, and use 4-Dimensional (4D) trajectory prediction and flight speed adjustment technology to meet the constraints on both space and time. This paper presents a large aircraft real-time flight trajectory management strategy based on 4D trajectory under multi-constraint conditions. To improve the prediction accuracy of the feasible Controlled Time of Arrival (CTA) window, a calculation method based on aircraft performance data and aircraft intention model is proposed. Finally, a dynamic en-route speed adjustment strategy based on the aircraft kinematics model is proposed, and the optimal flight profile and the required time of arrival objectives of the CDO are achieved with the performance-based airspace and CTA procedures. To demonstrate the validation of the algorithms given in the paper, the fast-time simulation based on a type of domestically-made aircraft is operated by the MATLAB platform. The simulation results verified that the real-time trajectory management algorithms and dynamic en-route speed profile adjustment strategy proposed in this paper could provide a precise flight speed control capability oriented to timing arrival for airlines.

articleTitle: Methods of Identifying Cell Type from Single Cell RNA-seq Data and the Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The ability to profile expression data in single cells (scRNA-Seq) has led to several important studies along with several new computational challenges, including questions about how to identify unique group of cells based on the expression profile. Different types of cells will have different gene expression profiles, thus they can be identified by these profiles. Predicting the cell type through expression profiles is of great practical significance. Previous application includes classifying cancers to specific diagnostic categories based on their gene expression, demonstrating the potential applications of these methods for tumor diagnosis and the identification of candidate targets for therapy. In this work, this task of cell type identification is pursued by implementing and comparing multiple machine learning methods. The neural network model can reach an accuracy of 59 percent when predicting 21 cell types. This work also interprets the neural network model by finding out the most important genes for classification through different methods that verify each other. Explanation and analysis based on prior biological knowledge are also included in this work.

articleTitle: Research on the Effectiveness of Students' Ideological and Political Education Based on Internet Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet information technology has pushed human society into a new era and a new space, profoundly affecting people's way of thinking and behavior; it has also changed the time and space for the development of ideological and political education itself, and changed the educational objects to which ideological and political education is directed. The integration of ideological and political education with information technology is the need for the innovative development of ideological and political education and the need for the healthy development of information technology, which is the general trend. With the rapid development of Internet information technology, the environment of ideological and political education in colleges and universities has changed greatly, and the influence of information technology on the development of ideological and political education in colleges and universities has become more and more obvious, so the integration between the two has become an inevitable way to achieve ideal results in ideological and political education. The necessity of the integration of ideological and political education and Internet information technology in colleges and universities is analyzed, the important significance of the integration of ideological and political education and Internet information technology in colleges and universities is summarized, and the countermeasures and suggestions to promote the integration of ideological and political education and Internet information technology in colleges and universities are proposed, hoping to provide some help to the smooth development of ideological and political education in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Frame Synchronization of Navigation Message Based on Cumulative Sum Method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a frame synchronization algorithm based on the cumulative sum is proposed in order to solve the frame synchronization problem of navigation messages. First, it is concluded that the synchronization code appears periodically on the basis of the analysis of the inherent structural characteristics of navigation messages. Second, on the basis of the above conclusion, the sequence to be synchronized is divided according to a fixed length, and the cumulative sum processing is carried out to obtain the cumulative sequence. Last, by observing the periodic distribution of the cumulative sequence, the correct synchronization of navigation messages is achieved. The simulation experiments have verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm that shows certain practical engineering values.

articleTitle: WeChat Forensics Method of Android Smart Phone Based on Improved NBC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, in the investigation stage, public security organs, procuratorial organs and people's courts often need to conduct electronic data forensics analysis on criminals' WeChat and other social software to obtain sensitive information. This paper proposes a forensic analysis method based on chat history data of Wechat on Android smart phone. By using an Improved Naive Bayes Algorithm with redefinable the weights of the feature words, an improved Naive Bayes Classifier (NBC) model is established. The classifier is used to classify the chatting texts in WeChat, in order to find the sensitive information in the chatting texts efficiently. Experiments show that this model can improve the efficiency of acquiring sensitive information in WeChat, and has obvious effects on saving evidence collection time and improving the efficiency of criminal detection.

articleTitle: Universal Nonlocal Fuzzy C-means for Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an active tool for image segmentation, the classical fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering algorithm is sensitive to noises. To overcome the weakness, several improved versions of FCM have been developed. Compared with the original one, these methods are more robust to noises. However, they are still not suitable for complex noises. To get better image segmentation results, especially in complex noisy scenarios, we provide a universal nonlocal FCM algorithm (UNFCM) by regularizing the objection function with a universal nonlocal spatial term. The experimental results on synthetic and real images suggest that the proposed UNFCM can yield higher quality segmentation results both in classification accuracy and visual effects.

articleTitle: Research on Calibration Technology of SF6 Gas Density Relay at Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The study of the low temperature through using the temperature compensation and the actual software SF6 gas temperature compensation technology, realizing that sulfur hexafluoride is density relay check under the low temperature. By improving the pure SF6 gas pressure by experimental data and mathematical model of the relationship between temperature and draw the curve of the sulfur hexafluoride gas pressure and temperature, then determine the compensation mode. Theoretical analysis to improve the performance of the ways of testing, perfect craft application conditions, fill the blank of the low temperature calibration technology.

articleTitle: On Computer Science and Modern Educational Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of economy and society, computer science and technology are constantly updating and developing, which has brought a qualitative leap to various fields, and the field of education is no exception. Computer science and technology plays an important role in modern educational technology with its high efficiency and fast characteristics, and brings technological innovation and support to modern educational technology. The purpose of this paper is to introduce the internal relationship between computer science and modern educational technology, to expound the profound influence of computer science and technology on modern educational technology, and to reveal the important significance between them.

articleTitle: Path Disappearance Dection for Millimeter Wave MIMO Channel With Low Time Delay And Little Overhead
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the millimeter wave multi-antenna MIMO system, when the traditional method is used to perform channel measurement before the communication process officially starts, problems such as excessive channel measurement overhead will be faced. The main purpose of this research is to design a new algorithm to solve the problem. In this research, the characteristics such as few millimeter wave paths, the much longer channel angle coherence time, combined with theories such as beamforming, change point detection and others, are exploited to design the effective algorithm. By using the designed algorithm, if the angle of the signal scattering path is unchanged, only a small number of samples will be used to estimate the channel coefficient. In addition, if the angle disappears, the change will be captured with just a small delay. Meanwhile, the relationship between false alarm probability and detection change are also found. Ultimately, the time overhead required for channel measurement is reduced. Through the simulation of the designed algorithm, the correctness and validity of the obtained results are proved.

articleTitle: Topology optimization design of trussed bracket of thruster on satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the requirements of satellite structure lightweight design, a thruster bracket is chosen as the research object. A topology optimization model of bracket is established, and the fundamental frequency is the constraint condition, the design scheme of minimum quality is obtained. A bracket model of rod structure is established through 3D print method. Some mechanical performances such as fundamental frequency, intensity and drawing force are analyzed in detail through multiple iterations, so as to realize the trussed bracket design of lightweight high-performance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamics in a 6:5 Internal Resonances Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Mean motion resonance (i.e., MMR) is a common phenomenon in our solar system and some exoplanetary systems. MMR refers to that the orbital frequencies or periods of two (or more) celestial bodies, such as satellites, comets, planets, represent a commensurability. MMRs play an important role in maintaining the stability of solar system and exoplanetary systems. MMRs also significantly affect the orbital characteristics and distribution of planets and asteroids in these systems. This paper focus on a 6:5 internal three body MMRs model formed by two massive bodies (i.e., planet and star) and one test massless particle. In order to understand the dynamical effect of eccentricity, initial semimajor axis and initial phase of the massless particle, a detailed analysis of the phase space structure by compute the Poincaré surfaces of section in the planar circular restricted three body model is presented. The eccentricity, initial semimajor axis, and initial phase are found to be three important parameters affecting the topological structure and steady state of the resonant orbits. The stable and chaotic regime of the resonant orbits is observed. Some typical resonant orbits are obtained.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for an Unmanned Mini Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive sliding mode controller with PID tuning method is presented for an unmanned mini vehicle. Moreover, in order to achieve system robustness against parameter variations and external disturbances, suitable PID control gain parameters can be systematically on-line computed based on the proposed adaptive law. The boundary layer condition is adopted to reduce the high frequency chattering in the switching part of the sliding mode controller. The asymptotic stability property can be guaranteed according to the Lyapunov stability theorem. Numerical simulation results illustrate that satisfactory trajectory tracking performance is achieved effectively and the input chattering is attenuated dramatically.

articleTitle: Application of Computational Simulation and Modeling: Optimizing the Control System of High-pressure Fuel Pump
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of computer technology and the improvement of information technology, computer-aided is widely used in many fields such as machinery manufacturing to improve the efficiency of skilled workers and the quality of machinery manufacturing. In this paper, the specific application of computational simulation in the design and optimization of fuel engine high-pressure fuel pump is used to simulate the workflow of high-pressure fuel pump by using programming technology to derive the optimal injection time under the condition of maintaining stable pressure. Through practical applications, this paper analyzes the advantages of computer-aided technology and explores new ways of integration with other traditional technologies to improve the informationization of traditional manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: Application of Autonomous Learning Strategy in Computer Teaching of Vocational and Technical Schools
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to cultivate practical and innovative talents, many computer majors in vocational and technical schools have increased their efforts in teaching innovation reform in recent years, and have also increased their investment in professional practice places and laboratories. But in fact, the students' learning results and employment path are not very ideal, the main reason is that the school only pays attention to the cultivation of students' professionalism, but neglects the cultivation of students' interest and autonomy. Therefore, from the perspective of autonomous learning, this paper discusses the teaching strategies suitable for computer majors in vocational and technical schools.

articleTitle: Research on Testability Allocation of Mechanical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The testability of mechanical equipment is an design property that can be test quantitative in time and accurate. The allocation and intending about testability indexes is the important composing part. The testability indexes were expounded in this paper. The paper presents three testability allocation methods that are applied to different conditions. And the same time, the examples were illuminated.

articleTitle: Attention-Based Convolutional Neural Network and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit for Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Using the data collected by the sensors embedded in smartphones for human activity recognition has become an important research direction. In order to overcome the problem of handcrafted feature extraction in traditional machine learning, we propose an attention-based model which combines convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) for human activity recognition. This model can extract local features of the original data by CNN, and construct the extracted features into a time series as the input of BiGRU, the BiGRU can capture the temporal dependencies and extract the features from the input, by introducing the attention mechanism, the influence of key input can be strengthened. The features are classified by the Softmax function. The recognition accuracy rate on the Wireless Sensor Data Mining (WISDM) dataset reaches 98.5%, which is improved compared with the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Cooling Method Based on Thermoelectric Effect-Peltier Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Energy consumption throughout the world has been increasing in recent years and is a major concern due to its effect on climate change. According to NASA, climate change has led to stronger hurricanes, more droughts and heat waves, sea level rise, and a prediction that the arctic will be ice-free by mid-century. One of the most notable energy consumption methods, which negatively affect the climate, is the heating and cooling of buildings. As a result, minimizing the need for energy use in buildings for heating and cooling application is a widely explored field of research. While energy efficiency has drastically improved in recent years, the use of harmful refrigerants, such as R-410a, has already taken a huge toll on the environment. This presented a need for the cooling and heating of buildings without the use of harmful refrigerants. An alternative method of refrigeration is the use of Thermoelectric Modules (TEMs) due to their nature of having no mechanical moving parts, being highly reliable, compact in size, light in weight, requiring no working fluid, and most importantly: require no use of refrigerants. Our project aims to design and create a fully functioning system which uses TEMs as an alternative for cooling and heating of common spaces.

articleTitle: Computation offloading Optimization in Edge Computing based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: By considering an MEC system consisting of multiple mobile devices with stochastic task arrivals, a computational offloading and resource allocation strategy based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is proposed. Specifically, a continuous action space based DRL approach named deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) is adopted to learn efficient computation offloading policies independently at each mobile user. Thus, powers of both local execution and task offloading can be adaptively allocated by the learned policies from each user's local observation of the MEC system. Through simulation, it can be verified that efficient policies can be learned at each mobile device, and the performance of the DDPG-based strategy is better than the traditional deep Q network (DQN) -based discrete power control strategy, which reduces the computation cost.

articleTitle: A Study on the Reader Reception of English Translations of The Analects-Data Analysis with Python
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on Python data processing technology, this study collects reader comments on the English translations of The Analects on the mainstream western social book platforms to construct a review database so as to analyze readers' emotional attitudes, recognition of the works' ideological values, focal dimensions of translation quality, gains and losses of word translation, and the reflected image of China. The quantitative and qualitative analyses find that the overall reader acceptance of the English translations of The Analects is good and that China, with its philosophy and culture, is attractive and brilliant, which also arise their interest and enthusiasm in getting to know Chinese culture and elements. Hopefully, this study will provide insight for relevant research on the positioning and influence of foreign translation of Chinese classics.

articleTitle: A Sparse Local Preserving Projection Method Based On Graph Embedding
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Dimensionality reduction plays an important role in pattern classification. In this paper, a robust unsupervised dimensionality reduction method termed robust sparse locality preserving projection with adaptive graph embedding is proposed. Specifically, the proposed method integrates the adaptive graph learning and projection learning into a framework, which can capture the intrinsic locality structure of data and in turn promotes the method to achieve the global optimal projection. To capture the global information of data, a variant PCA term is introduced, which can decrease the information loss during dimensionality reduction. Importantly, a row-sparsity constraint is imposed on the projection to select the most important features for dimensionality reduction, so as to improve the robustness of the proposed method to noises. Extensive experiments are performed on three representative face databases and an object database, which sufficiently validates the superiority of the proposed method in comparison with some state-of-the-art-methods.

articleTitle: Trajectory Optimization of Aircraft Vertical Flight Profile Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Considering Pollutant Emission Cost
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To improve flight economy and environmental friendliness, a vertical flight profile optimization method considering the cost of pollutant emissions (SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, CO, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and HC) cost is studied. Firstly, in this paper, a pollutant emission price weight, emission factor and a comprehensive cost index are proposed to establish a direct operating costs calculation model considering the pollutant emissions cost based on the ICAO baseline emission data. Secondly, based on the energy state method and the mass-point dynamics, a mass-point dynamic model of the vertical flight profile is established. Thirdly, the objective function and constraint conditions of trajectory optimization in each flight phase are derived based on the minimum principle of Pontryagin. Finally, taking B737-800 as an example, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the objective functions as well as fight parameters under a proper comprehensive cost index, and through simulation to realize the trajectory optimization with the optimal cost as the goal. Under the same conditions, compared the optimization result with the traditional cost index of 30, the fuel cost is reduced by 4.2%, total emissions of pollutants decreased by 4.3%, flight time increased by 7.9%, but the total cost of flight decreased by 2.1%. The simulation results show that the vertical profile trajectory optimization method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the emissions of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, HC, CO, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and the direct operating costs, improving the flight economic efficiency for airlines.

articleTitle: Visualization Mapping Analysis of Emergency Management Scientific Research Big Data during COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Objective: To better understand the research status of emergency management during the outbreak of COVID-19 in China, and further improve the level of China's emergency management. Method: In this paper, the big data of emergency management research during COVID-19 was visualized and analyzed, and the visual knowledge map was drawn to study the big data of China's emergency management literature. Conclusion: This paper reveals the current situation and characteristics of China's emergency management during COVID-19 by using the visual knowledge map, summarizes the research trend in the future, and points out the new ways to improve China's emergency management ability in the period after the COVID-19.

articleTitle: Object detection method based on dense connection and feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Object detection is a basic task in the field of computer vision and is widely used in various fields. However, there is also low detection performance caused by object scale changes and low feature extraction capabilities of the network, which makes the utilization of multi-scale features low. Therefore, this paper proposes a method based on dense connection and feature fusion. In this method, a dense connection module is designed to improve the ability of the network to extract features and improve the utilization of multi-scale features; a feature fusion module is designed to integrate feature information. In addition, The loss function uses Focal loss as classification loss and GIoU as positioning loss. The Tensorflow deep learning framework is used to deploy the network, and experiments are conducted on the VOC2007 and 2012 data sets to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method and compare it with the current method.

articleTitle: Procedure2Command: an AI-based Nuclear Power Plant Control Command Code Generation Prototype System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Nuclear power plant control systems are complex and require extremely high safety. Safety operation procedure flowcharts drawn by experts with many pages are often used as the guidebooks to help human operators avoid improper operations. To help operators better use these flowcharts and reduce their mental burden, here we propose a control command code generation prototype system, which involves artificial intelligence technologies, especially natural language processing, to automatically translate the nuclear power plant safety operation procedure flowcharts into executable codes. The proposed system includes three components: a flowchart decomposition tool, a text-code translation dataset, and a deep-learning based code generation model. Experimental results show that our proposed method can generate command codes with comparable accuracy as manual translation in a much higher inference speed.

articleTitle: Triangle Search Optimization Algorithm for Single-Objective Bound-Constrained Numerical Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Real-parameter optimization has been a focus of the last decade. An inspired algorithm, triangle search optimization (TSO), is proposed for the Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC) 2020 competition. In this paper, the TSO algorithm is divided into two phases: the triangle vertex searching (TVS) and triangle edge searching (TES) phases. In the TVS phase, the population is divided into two subpopulations, which can be enhanced by vertex searching operators and the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) for exploitation. In the TES phase, the differential evolution vector between superior and inferior solutions is employed to improve the exploration ability. The TSO algorithm is evaluated on the CEC 2020 benchmark problems and compared with the winners of the CEC competition and novel competitors. The experimental results show that TSO outperforms the compared algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and application of computer data mining technology in energy saving and emission reduction of thermal power plant
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Over the past few years, the shortage of coal supply leads to higher coal price, majority of power plants burned blended coal instead of designed coal as the main energy source, which leads to a significant decrease in boiler efficiency and combustion performance. Improving boiler efficiency, reducing coal consumption and energy conservation are critical tasks for power plant. Boiler operating at the optimal combustion stage can increase the economic efficiency of combustion and reduce NOx emission. Optimization can be achieved through adjustment made by manual and automatic control system with accurate real-time relevant combustion data. Due to technology restriction, system can not obtain accurate measurements such as coal ash content and air content in the furnace and without accurate information the system can not operate. This paper focuses on the calculation model run by powerful data mining computer to find the optimal operation stage through inputting parameters such as low calorific value of coal, oxygen content of flue gas, mixed air volume of mill inlet and carbon content of fly ash of thermal system of thermal power unit into DCS system. Throughout a two years test and trial, the system has achieved remarkable results, it can obtain a more accurate measurement than the existing equipment. Finally, it is officially implemented to AGC, Rb, coordination, analog control system and consumption difference analysis system and successfully achieve the purpose of energy conservation and emission reduction.

Author Keywords: mixed air volume of mill inlet and carbon content of fly ash

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Similarity of Entities with the Case of Event Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Evaluating entity similarity is a common problem in recommendation systems. In the business field, entity similarity generally uses a collaborative recommendation calculation method to recommend object features and user features. However, in the military field, especially for the recommendation of military knowledge graph entities, more consideration needs to be given to the information implicit in the association between entities. Therefore, the existing similarity calculation model needs to be supplemented and improved. Knowledge graphs have important practical significance in the management, visualization, analysis and reasoning of military data. On the basis of the knowledge graph, we propose a framework for calculating the asymmetric similarity of the domain knowledge graph, using as much as possible the attribute constraints of the ontology design and the convenience of long-distance reasoning of knowledge graph. War consists of various campaign events and this article takes the war knowledge graph as an experiment example. This model WKGSM that has been proposed draws on the traditional entity similarity calculation framework, considering the attribute value of the entity, the relationship between the entities, and the number of sub-entities. The framework adopts a three-layer structure to decompose big problems into small ones. Finally, the three-layer scores are merged through the AHP. The parameters of the fusion function and the coefficients of the similarity matrix can be modified according to the needs of the actual problem. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the method. In addition, this article also discusses the use environment and limitations of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Refrigerant Flow Noise under Sudden Stop of Automobile Air Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper studies the Mid-low frequency refrigerant flow noise generated by the automobile air conditioning system when the automobile is idling and stalling. Combining bench test and fluid simulation, the principle analysis is carried out and then optimized by expansion valve and its inlet high-pressure pipeline. A scheme for applying pipeline muffler to solve this kind of noise is proposed, and combined with the existing experience to improve the scheme, the final scheme is obtained without affecting the original performance requirements of automobile air conditioners. For this kind of unsteady noise, a new sound quality evaluation parameter SQM is proposed to predict the subjective performance of its sound quality, which has better prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Integrity Measurement Based on TEE Virtualization Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) is a safe area on the processor of all kinds of mobile smart devices. With the continuous development of TEE, attack methods against it have gradually appeared. Existing research has proposed existing attack methods that are solved by the security enhancement solution of the TEEv virtualization architecture, but it still cannot solve the problems that will affect other TEEs after being attacked, and the monitor cannot understand the overall security status of the equipment, which makes it impossible to completely solve the hidden dangers. In order to solve these problems in the TEEv virtualization architecture, a dynamic integrity measurement system is introduced to monitor the operating status of the system in real time, and through experiments, the accuracy of kernel attack detection and the impact of the dynamic measurement system on system performance are obtained. Experimental results show that the introduced dynamic integrity measurement system can effectively detect kernel attacks and feed back to the monitor, making the TEEv virtualization architecture more secure.

articleTitle: Unknown wireless network protocol feature extraction method based on sequence association
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy and long time consumption of feature extraction in the process of unknown protocol identification, a feature extraction method based on sequence association is proposed. By analyzing the extracted feature sequences and their positional relationships, this method can obtain the connection between feature sequences, which can be used as protocol features. At the same time, aiming at the problem of high time consumption of existing feature extraction methods, extra rules are made for the above analysis process, and the feature extraction process is divided into two parts: intra-frame feature extraction and inter-frame feature extraction. By analyzing the position constraints in the process, we can reduce the time consumption and improve the accuracy of feature extraction. Simulation results show that this method can reduce time consumption and improve the accuracy of unknown wireless network protocol feature extraction.

articleTitle: GPU-Accelerated Computations for Supersonic Flow Modeling on Hybrid Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With its strong floating-point operation capability and high memory bandwidth in data parallelism, the graphics processing unit (GPU) has been widely used in general-purpose computing. GPU-based computations have been extensively applied in the field of computational fluid dynamics (CFD). This paper aims to design an extremely efficient double-precision GPU-accelerated parallel algorithm for supersonic flow computations on hybrid grids. Compute unified device architecture (CUDA) is used as a general-purpose parallel computing platform and programming model to perform parallel computing codes on GPUs. The cell-centered finite volume method based on unstructured grids is used in the spatial discretization of governing equations, whereas the three-stage explicit Runge-Kutta scheme with second-order accuracy is used for temporal discretization. The turbulence is solved by using the K-ω SST two-equation model. Three test cases are studied to validate the computational accuracy of the proposed algorithm. The numerical results agree well with the experiment data, thereby suggesting that the GPU-accelerated parallel algorithm has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Opportunistic Spectrum Access Strategy In Time-Slot Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of secondary user energy restriction in cognitive radio Ad Hoc networks, a opportunistic spectrum access strategy based on energy efficiency is proposed. Considering both the time-varying channel state and the accuracy of secondary user spectrum perception, an analysis framework to maximize energy efficiency is established based on partially observable Markov decision-making process, which guides secondary users to select the most energy-efficient channel, and adaptively controls transmission power according to belief state, channel gain and detection probability. The simulation results show that this strategy can improve the energy efficiency of secondary user transmission, and achieve an effective compromise between transmission rate and energy overhead by effectively controlling transmission power.

articleTitle: Double Closed-loop Control with Input Saturation for DP Vessels based on Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To control the operating vessel by the dynamic positioning (DP) system with input saturation, a sliding mode control strategy, based on the double closed-loop controller and disturbance observer (DDSMC) for the DP vessel is proposed. The trajectory tracking of DP vessel is controlled by the position and velocity loop controller, and the integrated disturbance caused by environment and the saturated input is estimated by the disturbance observer. Based on the established three-degree-of-freedom kinematics and dynamic model of DP vessel in horizontal, the controller of position loop and loop is designed based on the integral sliding mode surface, and the stability of position loop is achieved through the fast convergence of velocity error. The observer is designed based on the fast terminal sliding surface, and the system is stabilized through compensation. The stability of the system is analyzed with Lyapunov principle, and the proposed control strategy is verified by digital simulation. The results show that the designed disturbance observer can realize the observation of the integrated disturbance, and the DDSMC control strategy can improve the dynamic performance of the system and reduce the workload of the propeller.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Embedded Single Chip Computer Intelligent Control
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Single-chip microcomputers have been widely used in various fields of life and production. Almost all devices with digital interfaces include the application of single-chip microcomputers. Especially in the field of automation control, single-chip microcomputers are applied to robots and smart meters. It can be said that the emergence and wide application of single-chip computers have changed people's life and production and promoted the development of society. In the information age, with the development of computer network technology, the combination of single-chip technology and electronic engineering technology has promoted the development of industrial automation. The use of embedded single-chip microcomputer is conducive to the design and application of industrial production intelligent control systems. At the same time, this can also further promote the development of industrial automation, digitization and intelligence, and improve the safety and stability of the entire control system. This also meets the requirements of industrial development for the automatic operation and control of high-efficiency, low-error machines. Based on this, this article will briefly analyze the application of embedded single-chip microcomputer in the field of industrial intelligent control on the basis of an overview of the embedded system and the concept of single-chip microcomputer.

articleTitle: Performance Degradation Assessment of Rolling Bearings Based on OLPP and SVDD
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An approach based on orthogonal locality preserving projection (OLPP) and support vector data description (SVDD) is proposed for the performance degradation assessment of rolling bearings. Firstly, the extracted features are selected according to the correlation with root mean square of vibration signals. Secondly, dimension reduction is performed on the selected features with OLPP and principal components are obtained. In the following, the performance degradation indicator (PDI) is constructed with the principal components fused by SVDD. Finally, the proposed approach is verified with the lifecycle data of two rolling bearings. The results show that the PDI has good monotonicity and is sensitive to the initial fault. Besides, the noise in the PDI could be efficiently suppressed.

articleTitle: Constructing the New Media Ideological and Political Evaluation System in Colleges and Universities Integrating Grey Relational Theory Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The teaching of ideological and political theory courses is based on the characteristics of the values and political quality of cultivating talents, and has the dual nature of theoretical teaching and social practice. This paper integrates the gray relational theory model, and constructs an evaluation system for the new media ideological and political education in colleges and universities. The three dimensions of traditional culture, teacher-student relationship, and after-class practice discussed the specific practical application of the construction of the “micro-ideological and political” new media ideological and political evaluation system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experimental Study on Continuous Leakage of Oxygen Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The oxygen system is an important part of the aircraft life support system. Several continuous leakage faults occurred in a certain type of onboard oxygen system during the ground tests. In this paper, the cause of the faults was investigated and analyzed according to experiment results, and faulty components were identified. The fault phenomenon was repeated through experiments. Corresponding improvement suggestions were put forward on the basis of analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Library Big Data Service Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economic construction, various new technologies have been created in this new era, and the operation methods of all sectors of society have also undergone earth-shaking changes on the original basis. At the same time, staff in each field need to think from multiple angles when performing work tasks, and actively use more innovative science and technology to fundamentally improve the original work efficiency. Among them, the library can provide everyone with an environment for learning cultural knowledge and effectively increase the cultural literacy of all citizens. This is extremely important for promoting social development. However, there are a large number of books in the library, and a large number of readers visit the library every day. This has also led to the decline of service effectiveness if the work in the library field continues to use the past work methods. The use of blockchain technology can solve various work problems that existed in the past, so that all work can provide readers with a better reading experience in the process of execution, so that readers can find their favorite content in many books. To this end, the relevant staff should be deeply aware of the important responsibilities they shoulder, innovate their work methods in a timely manner, and organically integrate their valuable work experience and brand-new blockchain technology. In this way, data information can be used to provide staff with more valuable information and make library services more humane.

articleTitle: Detection of DDoS based on Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix theory and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There have been researches on Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack detection based on deep learning, but most of them use the feature data processed by data mining for feature learning and classification. Based on the original data flow, this paper combines the method of Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM), which not only retains the original data but also can further extract the potential relationship between the original data. The original data matrix and the reconstructed matrix were taken as the input of the model, and the Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) was used for feature learning. Finally, the classifier model was trained for detection. The experimental part is divided into two parts: comparing the detection effect of different data processing methods and different deep learning algorithms; the effectiveness and objectivity of the proposed method are verified by comparing the detection effect of the deep learning algorithm with that of the statistical analysis feature algorithm.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Radiation Dosimetric Model during Lift-Off
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Space rays can cause serious damage to the vital organs of astronauts. To assess the radiation safety of astronauts in the space environment, the most direct and effective way is to send radiation equivalent phantoms equipped with various radiation sensors into space through the spacecraft, and collect relevant radiation data. The phantom will be subjected to a large impact load during the lift-off of spacecraft, leading the various layers of the phantom to be dislocated or crushed, which will affect the collection of radiation data. Based on the Chengdu Dosimetric Phantom (CDP) and according to the distribution and installation requirements of radiation sensors, the phantom is sliced in multiple layers and connected by a center rod to obtain a model for space radiation dose collection, called Radiation Dosimetric Model (RDM). According to the mechanical parameters of the spacecraft during lift-off, we use Ansys Workbench Software to conduct Statics, Modal and Response Spectrum analysis of the RDM. Under a static load of 6.5g, we calculate the stress and deformation of the layers and the center rod of the RDM, as well as their size and distribution, carry out modal analysis, and calculate the maximum response of the RDM under a given acceleration spectrum with a load peak value of 6.5g. The result shows that under the dynamic and static load of 6.5g, the layers and the center rod will not be dislocated, crushed, etc. This ensures the safety of Radiation Dosimetric Model during the lift-off process, and has important theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: The establishment of power communication network monitoring system based on computer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Nowadays with the development of science and technology, computer network has been widely used to the life of people, the popularity of the network technology convenience to people's lives, and at the same time, many industries and industry at present is the application of computer network communication technology, convenient for supervision and inspection of the scene situations, oil and gas is in the energy industry, the application of the computer is more common, such as in power system, the network technology has become the inevitable trend of electric power industry development, various complicated power system, has been inseparable from the electric power communication network of the implementation of the supervision and feedback.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm For Robot Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, first an improved repulsive potential field function is proposed to make the path smoother and to solve the global minimum problem. Then a hybrid algorithm is proposed which improves the defects of A* algorithm and the artificial potential field method and has high successful probability in experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experimental Research on International Mechanical Seal Standards
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Many countries have established standards for the testing of mechanical seals. This paper systematically analyzed the similarities and differences in the sample size, pretreatment and test conditions of sealing test standards such as GB/T 12385, GB/T 20671.4, ASTM F37, ASME B16.20, DIN 3535-4, DIN 3535-6, JIS B2490, and carried out experimental research on some related factors that affect the sealing performance. The results show that the influence of the internal pressure of the medium and the load of the gasket on the sealing performance is closely related to the performance of the gasket itself. Surface treatments such as applying film and glue on the gasket surface can reduce the leakage between the interfaces. For gasket size, the wider the gasket width, the smaller the total leakage. The research results have a certain guiding role in understanding the nature and laws of gasket leakage and formulating reasonable gasket leakage test standards.

articleTitle: Multiple secrets sharing scheme based on Eigenvalue
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Currently, relevant secret sharing schemes are mainly extended based on Shamir's threshold secret sharing scheme and Blakley's vector scheme. In this paper, we extend the threshold secret sharing scheme based on the eigenvalue proposed by Zhang Yanshuo et al, use the diagonalized matrix with different invertible matrices, distribute the square matrices similar to the diagonal matrix to different participants as their sub-secret shares. In this scheme, multiple secrets can be shared in each secret sharing process. The analysis results show that the scheme is correct.

articleTitle: VSLAM based on instance segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, visual SLAM algorithms have achieved impressive results, but most visual SLAM algorithms still operate based on the assumption that the observed environment is static. When facing a moving object, it may affect the robustness of the entire system. This paper proposes a method that combines visual SLAM with deep learning-based instance segmentation. To run stably, vSLAM only needs to extract feature points on static objects. In traditional vSLAM, random sample consistency (RANSAC) is used to select the corresponding feature points. However, if the main part of the view is occupied by moving objects, many feature points become inappropriate, and RANSAC cannot perform well. According to our empirical research, the feature points of people in indoor environments usually cause errors in vSLAM. We add a separate thread based on ORB-SLAM2 and use the mask generated by instance segmentation to exclude the wrong feature points so that vSLAM can estimate the camera motion stably. In our experiment, we use the COCO dataset trained the instance segmentation network model, and the TUM RGB-D dataset is used to evaluate the method in this paper. Compared with the ORB-SLAM2 algorithm, our method can obtain higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Transfer Law of Spacecraft Shock Response
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to study the transfer law of spacecraft pyrotechnic shock response, taking communication satellite as an example, the shock acceleration data of satellite deck with different distance from the pressing point and from decks to units are statistically analyzed during the process of satellite solar array electric unlocking. The shock response transfer law is summarized. This study is based on the real pyrotechnics shock test of telecommunication satellites. This article carries out data statistics and summarizes the transmission law of shock response, which can provide reference for the unit anti-shock design and layout, and effectively make up for the limitations of the finite element method in response prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Variable Pressure Control of Aircraft Hydraulic System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The variable pressure hydraulic systems can automatically adjust the output pressure according to the load demand to reduce energy consumption, reduce the heat generated by the hydraulic systems, has a good application prospect. At present, the dual pressure hydraulic systems have been used in foreign military and civil aircraft, but domestic aircraft are less used. In order to solve the problems faced by engineering application of variable pressure hydraulic systems, the control logic, control mode, switching frequency, status monitoring and other aspects in engineering application of hydraulic variable pressure control function are designed and analyzed in this paper. The related content can provide reference for the engineering design of the aircraft variable pressure hydraulic systems in China and promote the engineering application of the hydraulic variable pressure control function to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Structure Analysis with 3D Hexahedral Meshes Generated by a Label - Driven Subdivision
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For structure analysis with the finite element method (FEM), the hexahedral element is preferable to the tetrahedral one from the viewpoint of accuracy. Previously, we had introduced a label-driven subdivision method for a two-dimensional mesh and showed that the meshes generated by our method were useful for structural analyses. In this study, we extend our two-dimensional algorithm to three-dimensions and verify that the meshes generated by the proposed mesh-subdivision algorithm are useful for structural analyses.

articleTitle: Information Management and Evaluation of Physical Education in Colleges and Universities Integrating KCF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and network communication technology, college physical education is transforming from the traditional manual operation management to the centered college teaching management model. This paper integrates the KCF algorithm, through the online and offline teaching mode, aims to improve the interest of college students in learning sports and the main role of students in teaching, And in the teaching reform to meet the requirements of quality education, for the university sports teaching reform innovation new mode.

articleTitle: Design and experimental study of a heat sink temperature regulating system
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Environmental simulation test in near space is an important means to verify the reliability of near space vehicle. According to the different test temperature area, different temperature regulation methods are adopted. Compared with the heat source and cold source confrontation mode, the temperature regulation of the carrier refrigerant heat sink in the variable temperature zone has the advantages of good economy, simple equipment structure and excellent performance. In this paper, a temperature regulating system of expansion plate heat sink with heat conduction bath oil as medium is designed, and the equipment performance is verified by simulation and debugging test.

articleTitle: Multifunctional intelligent robot system for processing dynamic passenger service demand information
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous increase of passenger flow in railway stations in modern life, the service needs of passengers tend to be informatized. Traditional service methods such as meal delivery and ticket checking in the railway station cannot meet the needs of passengers. In order to diversify the service content of the railway station, to improve the management efficiency of train station attendant services, a multifunctional intelligent car system applied to trains was designed. The system is divided into two parts: the service platform and the smart car. The service platform can provide passengers with service content information and collect passenger service demand information; wheeled service vehicles equipped with multiple sensor modules implement corresponding service tasks. In addition, algorithms such as path planning, machine vision, and face recognition are designed to enhance the self-decision-making ability of the system. The system combines embedded development and web development, expands many hardware and software functions, and forms a controllable system that combines intelligent algorithms and manual management, which can be well applied to train service systems.

articleTitle: Causes and Countermeasures of Frequent Action of Gas Relay with on-load Tap Switch
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The configuration of domestic on-load tap switch gas relay is introduced, the causes and rules of frequent action of light gas signal of gas relay are analyzed. The corresponding countermeasures are seeked to make the on-load tap switch run safely and reduce the number of maintenance.

articleTitle: Spoken Keyword Detection Based on Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial neural networks, it's applied to all areas of computer technologies. This paper combines deep neural network and keyword detection technology to propose a Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network-based spoken keyword detection which is widely different from the existing methods. With the ability of Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN) to generates data autonomously, new sequences are generated, through which it analyzes whether keywords presence and where the keywords appear. In this method, the generator in WGAN fits the observation data to generate new data, and the discriminator classifies the generated data and the labels. The generator and discriminator are trained by combating learning. The method we propose is simple, does not require complex acoustic models, and does not need to be transcribed into text. It is also applicable to such languages without words. The TIMIT corpus and self-recorded Chinese corpus has been used for conducting experiments. Our method is compared with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN) and shows significant improvement over other techniques.

articleTitle: Design and experimental study on the test bench for suspension velocity of municipal waste
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In pneumatic conveying, the material aerodynamic characteristics are the decisive basis, and its suspension speed is an important parameter in equipment design.
