Under the background of promoting waste classification in China, the introduction of wind power separation has great prospects and research potential. According to the theoretical levitation velocity, a blowing type test device is designed, which can measure the actual suspension velocity of typical domestic waste samples and obtain the reference characteristic value.

articleTitle: Distinguish Method for Electromagnetic Reflection of Ferromagnetic and Non-ferromagnetic Metal
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of different types of target metal materials for underwater active electromagnetic detection, according to the different electromagnetic scattering characteristics of ferromagnetic and non-ferromagnetic metals, this paper proposes a method for determining the metal material based on the change of the equivalent inductive reactance of active electromagnetic emitting coils. Then active electromagnetic detection coil is designed to detect the iron and aluminum metal objects. The test verified the relationship between the equivalent inductance of the transmitting coil and the metal material. The test results show the effectiveness of the method in distinguishing the metal material types.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation of Thangka Images
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Thangka is one of the important artistic works in Chinese culture. In order to better promote the understanding and research of digital thangka images, this article explores the semantic segmentation of the headdress of the main statue of thangka. In this article, we use FCN as the benchmark model, and choose PSPNet, Deeplab V3+, Mask R-CNN, DANet, Cascade Mask R-CNN and other five mainstream semantic segmentation models based on deep learning. Then carry out experimental research separately. We explore a more suitable deep subdivision research model for Thangka image semantics. The construction of Thangka image semantic segmentation model provides experimental and theoretical basis for the next step. In this paper, using the same parameters and not using the pre-training model, the conventional training experiments and comparative training experiments under different backbone networks were carried out. Experiments show that using FCN as the baseline model, cascaded Mask R-CNN has the best segmentation effect in headwear segmentation. Its mIoU is 62.59%. In different backbone networks, PSPNet segmentation effect is significantly different.

articleTitle: Transmit digital multi-beam forming based on hyperbolic fractional delay filter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a transmit digital multi-beam forming method based on hyperbolic fractional delay filter is presented, which provides effective time delay compensation and can reduce the consumption of hardware resources. In the proposed method,firstly, the hyperbolic function is expanded in the way of infinite product, and only two sub-filters are included in the expansion. Then, the hyperbolic fractional delay filter is obtained by using the solved sub-filter, so as to realize the clock fractional delay compensation. Then, the transmit digital multibeam forming is realized by using the designed fractional delay filter based on hyperbolic structure. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed design method are verified by experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Gas Turbine Using Compressor Extraction in Compressed Air System of Station
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the problems of high energy consumption and low utilization rate of electric drive air compressor in industrial compressed air system, taking the compressor station of centrifugal compressor driven by PGT25+ gas turbine in long-distance natural gas pipeline as an example, the PGT25+ gas turbine simulation model was established by using three-dimensional CFD numerical simulation software, and the performance changes of gas turbine caused by compressor extraction were analyzed. Through calculation and analysis, it is found that the use rate of the existing station air compressor can be reduced by using gas turbine for compressed air in station, but the performance of gas turbine will be affected to a certain extent. Compared with the existing air compressor energy consumption, it does not have an advantage in economy. However, the influence of the maintenance, spare parts procurement, power supply and technical blockade of the existing electric drive air compressor in the existing station can be comprehensively considered, and the technical transformation can be carried out according to the situation.

articleTitle: Output consensus based model predictive control for general discrete-time linear multi-agent systems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a control protocol based on model predictive control scheme was proposed to solve the output consensus problem of general linear discrete multi-agent systems with fixed topology. First, using partial stability theory, the necessary and sufficient conditions for the consensus of discrete-time multi-agent systems were derived. Then, the consensualising controller was designed by using model predictive control (MPC) theory. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was shown by a numerical example.

articleTitle: The Structure Design And Experimental Study Of The Gas-Liquid Separation Cyclone
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A new model of gas-liquid separation hydrocyclone is proposed in this paper, and the paper describes its structure characteristics and operating principle.By the experimental study on the new structure of the gas-liquid separation hydrocyclone, the effects of flow rate, split ratio and pressure on the separation efficiency were researched.When the rate of flow changes from 8m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h to 8.5m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h,the split ratio is tantamount to 7% and gas-liquid ratio is less than 65%, we found that there is almost no gas in the underflow.Under the best working condition, the gas-liquid separation hydrocyclone achieves optimum separation effect. The gas-liquid separation cyclone had a small volume but a big handling ability,can separated effectively and quickly with a stable separation effect and so on.So the gas-liquid separation hydrocyclone has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: RANSAC Optimization for Category-level 6D Object Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The performance of category-level 6D object pose estimation is insufficient although the RANSAC algorithm has been adopted to remove outliers from the 3D-3D correspondence. In this paper, we optimize the Preemptive RANSAC algorithm to progressively find an inlier subset that has the smallest reprojection error. Experiments demonstrate that the optimized algorithm gets a more precise 6D pose in which hypotheses can be measured against each other and be revised to estimate a more precise pose. For the 10° &10cm metric on the REAL275 dataset, it achieves 43.8% and exceeds 64.0% of the NOCS method. On the Context-Aware MixEd ReAlity(CAMERA25) dataset it achieves 63.2% which exceeds 1.6% of NOCS.

articleTitle: Development and experimental study on transfusion device
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Malignant tumor, as one of the globally major problems in public health is damaging health of human beings to a great extent. CIK cellular immunotherapy has been widely applied to clinical treatment linked to tumor disease as CIK cellular immunotherapy conspicuously performed extraordinary superiority to adoptive cellular immunotherapy in clinical treatment. The cellular viability is affected as the infusion tube can be blocked by the deposition happening in the CIK transfusion process. Clinically, liquor blending process still needs to be practiced manually by medical personnel, consequently the defect of manual blending has conspicuously emerged. Within the blending process, heavy labor and other resources are consumed to a tremendous extent. To solve the problem mentioned above, the pendulum transfusion device is needed to be researched. This article proposes a portable liquid medicine shaker and heat preservation device, and conducts research on the activity of CIK cells

articleTitle: Research on the Upgrading Path of Xinjiang Urban Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of Xinjiang urban power grid, sorted out the current situation and existing problems of the power grid, and puts forward the path to improve the distribution network in combination with the development goal of the power grid, including comprehensively strengthening the grid construction, improving the level of intelligent interaction, improving the level of lean operation and maintenance, carrying out the construction of power grid standardization engineering, and further improving the comprehensive service capacity of the power grid in the new format and new scenario to meet the new requirements The demand for stable economic growth in Xinjiang provides safe, reliable, green and efficient power grid support for local economic and social development.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation for A Class of Descriptor Systems - An Adaptive Robust Extended Kalman Filter Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive Robust Extended Klaman filter for a class of non-linear descriptor systems with unknown system noise. Firstly, a robust bound is given to decrease the influence of the linearization error on the estimation accuracy; an adaptive algorithm is introduced to implement an unbiased estimation of the noise, then; an numeral example is given to show the effectiveness of the method at last.

articleTitle: Improved hopper for construction machinery engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the construction engineering, it is necessary to pour the prepared concrete. The existing concrete manufacturing methods are mostly made of sand and stone with cement mixing, and the hopper is often used as the mixing equipment. Due to the limitation of construction conditions, it is not convenient to mix the concrete on the building. The mechanical hopper of existing buildings is usually difficult to discharge intermittently in the process of use, and the existing hopper is not good at blanking. Therefore, a kind of mechanical construction hopper is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Proofreading System of Improved Phrase Translation Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The English translation proofreading system for grammar and phrases attaches great importance to the accuracy of proofreading results, but ignores the contextual coherence between the translation results. In view of this, this paper proposes a computer intelligent proofreading system based on an improved phrase translation model. The system improves the accuracy of search results through the design of the search module. The entire network searches the basic meaning of the vocabulary to be proofread and related subject content, and can record user behavior to provide users with more accurate translation results. In addition, we can use the design optimization of software modules such as system applications, network topology, client and organization management, and online collaborative translation. This can support translation and proofreading in multiple languages. The test of the system verified that the system can meet the proofreading needs of users for English translation and greatly improve proofreading efficiency and proofreading accuracy.

articleTitle: Informatization Development and Management of Marketing in the Internet + Era
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The advent of the Internet + era has not only caused changes in the flow of information, but has also affected the form of modern marketing management to a considerable extent. The characteristics of the socialist market economy determine that the market has a direct impact on the production and sales of enterprises. Therefore, marketing in the Internet era needs to fully conform to the characteristics of the market economy, and only in this way can it meet the needs of diversified market development. With the development of informatization in many industries, more and more companies are aware of the role of marketing management informatization for their own development, and are actively applying Internet information technology, and the overall effect is very significant. This article will focus on the analysis and research of the information development path of marketing in the Internet + era, in order to provide a reference for relevant units.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Algorithms for Video Service with Network-assisted
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The video service occupies a large proportion of the entire multimedia business. How to transfer the video files stored on the server to the client better and faster, and bring the user the best viewing experience, is a problem that we need to solve and optimize. In this paper, firstly, the SAND (Server and Network-assisted DASH) technology was simulated and successfully transmitted the network bandwidth information to the client as a reference. Finally, the extra another network-assisted method is proposed: all parameters of the physical layer of the network are extracted at intervals, and then these parameters are classified by means of machine learning, and the quality of the channel is represented sequentially from low to high. The reference value thus obtained is closer to the actual network condition. Compared with the traditional DASH algorithm, the QoE improvement can be seen very clearly.

articleTitle: Analysis of PDG, Penalty-BFGS and KKT in Economic Dispatch Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the past several decades, Economic Dispatch problem has been a hot topic in the field of mathematics. In general, Economic Dispatch problem can be regarded as a quadratic optimization problem in power system. This paper utilized projected gradient descent algorithm, penalty-BFGS algorithm and KKT conditions method, which can be used to minimize the cost function with equality constraints and inequality constraints, with an attempt to explain and address Economic Dispatch problem. Based on the three methods above, the corresponding results are presented and analyzed. The results demonstrated that the three algorithms have different performances. Each can solve the quadratic problem with efficiency to different degrees.

articleTitle: Design of Web table system
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to avoid the spread of new coronavirus, it is necessary to keep a distance, wear masks and wash hands, not close contact. When the academic research or market survey needs to fill in the questionnaire, it is a safe and necessary choice to use the network electronic form. In order to prevent the spread of virus, it is necessary to keep a safe distance between people. The demand for electronic forms is more diverse and vigorous. To prevent the spread of virus through interviews and questionnaires, we can change the way of filling in electronic forms to achieve the purpose of maintaining a safe distance. As a result, the demand for electronic forms has increased, and the electronic forms can be more convenient. At the same time, the anti-counterfeiting function of electronic signature is used. The undeniable characteristics of personal signature can be customized and diversified. At present, the system development and technology of web forms are various and mature. In order to increase the employability of college students, the implementation course of online spreadsheet is added to the professional courses of University, which has gradually become a popular option of software engineering for students' graduation design. From the system analysis and system design, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and other technologies are selected. Through the programming framework on the server, through the browser, it is convenient to use the web spreadsheet. The system functions are successfully implemented, and the graduation design of university professional courses is completed, which is a reference for successful cases of course practice. This model is a successful example of system development. Combined with the theory of university courses and the practice of project design, the system development, design and system testing are completed successfully within the effective time limit. From the system analysis and system design, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and other technologies are selected. Through the programming framework on the server, through the browser, it is convenient to use the web spreadsheet. The system functions are successfully implemented, and the graduation design of university professional courses is completed, which is a reference for successful cases of course practice. This model is a successful example of system development. Combined with the theory of university courses and the practice of project design, the system development, design and system testing are completed successfully within the effective time limit.

articleTitle: Identification method of danger sources at infrastructure construction site based on neural network multi-layer feature information
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Due to the complex site conditions of power infrastructure projects and the similar structural features of various danger sources, it is difficult to extract salient features suitable for classification. Although the neural networks with large numbers of available improved loss functions have good application effects in feature recognition, the single depth feature does not make full use of the complementarity between the multiple features of the field environment. In response to these problems, this paper proposes a method for classification and identification of danger sources at infrastructure construction sites based on neural network multi-layer feature information. It completes the image recognition of the infrastructure site by selecting the sparse self-encoding technology, extracts the multi-layer features in the neural network, and then sends the multi-layer features to the softmax classifier to solve the multi-classification problem of dangerous sources, and can extract more suitable based on the analysis of the characteristics of the danger sources on the infrastructure construction site. Through data analysis, the method illustrated in this paper effectively improves the identification rate of the danger sources and shows great significance to ensure the safety of infrastructure construction site.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Student Learning Evaluation Scheme of Hybrid Teaching Mode in Network Information Environment ―― Taking Business English as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of network technology and the improvement of information management level, information teaching has gradually penetrated into various colleges and universities. With the integration of various information teaching platforms, means and resources, the mixed teaching mode is more and more popular with teachers and students. This paper focuses on the course teaching based on Business English, and discusses the evaluation mechanism of students' learning effect from the aspects of evaluation subject, evaluation process, evaluation index and weight.

articleTitle: The Application Combination of Computer Aided Technology and Mechanical Design and Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of China's economy, the development of various professional fields has been given certain support and help, and the development speed is also very rapid. The development of mechanical design industry is very obvious, especially pay attention to efficiency in contemporary society, the mechanical design and manufacturing can't still like a traditional mechanical manufacturing in the design of manual drawing, so the efficiency is too low, but also difficult to improve on the problems existing in the mechanical design, which requires some aided design method for mechanical design and manufacturing of aided design, so as to design the intelligent and efficient. Therefore, this paper mainly aims at the combination of computer-aided technology and mechanical design and manufacturing, through the advantages of computer-aided design and mechanical design and manufacturing to improve the design efficiency of mechanical design and manufacturing. In this paper, the advantages and disadvantages of computer-aided technology and mechanical design and manufacturing are discussed and studied, and some suggestions are put forward for the advantages and disadvantages of the combination.

articleTitle: Research on Inspection Method of Space Error in Coordinate Measuring Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the progress of society, people put forward higher and higher requirements for the quality of products. As the key equipment to ensure the measurement and processing accuracy of workpiece, coordinate measuring machine and CNC machine tool, especially for the post-processing inspection of manufacturing parts, can play a key role in the inspection of spatial error. This paper provides a method to check the spatial error of CMM in measuring space. Using a standard device based on Renishaw inspection gauge to regularly check the spatial accuracy of CMM or CNC machine tool, the spatial error value within the length range of measuring rod centered on fixed point can be measured at one time.

articleTitle: Design and research of telescopic gate
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The application of gate in the field of rail transit greatly improves the traffic capacity of the throat area of the station, and saves considerable labor cost; however, due to the influence of the door structure, most gate machines under the existing technology are set with fixed gate units, that is, the number of gate machines set in the access channel is fixed, which restricts the adjustment of station capacity. In addition, it has the same advantages as the existing sliding gate in the design of the gate, and has the same design capacity as the existing gate.

articleTitle: Post-vulcanization Solid-liquid Separation Device for Medical Latex Gloves
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, the post-vulcanization process of domestic medical gloves is to manually salvage the products from the vulcanization tank. Workers are in a working environment of high temperature and humidity, with high labor intensity and low efficiency. In order to solve these problems, a method of separating medical latex gloves by negative pressure technology is proposed. Based on the PLC controller, the method achieved the purpose of reducing labor cost and improving production efficiency by utilizing the interaction of negative pressure suction, gravity action and sensor. this method, and provides an effective solution for the post-vulcanization process in the latex industry. In addition, it also provided an effective solution for the post-vulcanization process in the latex industry.

articleTitle: Fast Real-time Semantic Segmentation Network with an Asymmetric Encoder-Decoder Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Currently, the-state-of-art semantic segmentation methods often bring the huge computational cost to achieve high performance, and it is difficult to balance the inference speed and model accuracy, and it is difficult to deploy on the equipment with limited hardware resources. In this paper, we propose an asymmetric high-resolution (1024*2048px) real-time semantic segmentation network that can balance accuracy and speed-Fast Real-time Semantic Segmentation Network(FRSSNet). We combine the existing multi-branch network and encoder-decoder structure and design a new bottleneck. Meanwhile, we use multiscale to get better segmentation results. By combining spatial details with semantic information, the accuracy can reach 69.6% on Cityscapes and the FPS can reach 200.

articleTitle: Influence of High Altitude Environment on Electrical Performance of Miniature Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the high altitude environment, the electrical performance of the miniature circuit breaker will deteriorate. The influence of pressure on the external natural convection and internal breakdown field strength of the miniature circuit breaker was obtained through theoretical derivation in this paper. The thermocouple model and the electric field model were established. Combined with simulation and theoretical calculation, it was obtained that the temperature rise of the miniature circuit breaker at an altitude of 4300m rise by more than 12K and the air breakdown field strength drop by 36.8% compared to that in the plain area. At the same time, the temperature rise test and dielectric test were carried out in the high altitude area and the plain area. The simulation conclusion was verified by the test result.

articleTitle: Building Block Steering Gear Robot Product Design and Optimization Direction
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The main logical idea of this paper is to optimize the man-machine interaction of building block steering gear robot, to improve the man-machine interaction disadvantages of the existing products, and improve the now existing building block assembly structure, which can better meet the requirement of skeleton and appearance of steering gear robot product. It combines the Chinese mortise and tenon joint craft to improve the assembly method of building blocks, which makes the traditional robot enlightenment education more culturally meaningful. Designing and optimizing the man-machine relationship of building block steering gear robot can improve the disadvantages of the existing products and improve the appearance of the products. The optimized design can make the building block steering gear robot have more cultural features, easier to build and have more educational applications, and more beautiful appearance.

articleTitle: Flexural waves in metamatrerial beam with mechanical and electromechnical resonators
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, an elastic metamaterial beam model with mechanical and electromechanical resonators is proposed. The electromechanical resonator is composed of piezoelectric layers and shunt circuit, and the mechanical resonator is designed by high-static-low-dynamic stiffness (HSLDS), both of which can provide negative stiffness mechanism. Firstly, the fully coupled equations are established by using Hamiltonian principle. Secondly, under the assumption of an infinite number of resonators, the influence of resonator parameters on the bandgap characteristics is analyzed. In addition, the modal expansion method is employed to study the frequency response function of a cantilever beam with a finite number of resonators under the base excitation. The results show that the additional mass ratio, residual stiffness ratio and electromechanical coupling coefficient have great influence on the bandgap characteristics. Combining the mechanical and electromechanical resonators can effectively expand the bandgap ranges of the metamaterial beam. The locally resonant metamaterials with HSLDS and electromechanical resonators designed in this paper can obtain better bandgap characteristics and attenuation performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Static Law and Dynamic Law in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, through an in-depth comparative study of static law and dynamic law in the context of big data, we analyse the personality rights, property rights, intellectual property rights, and data rights attributes of big data rights and interests respectively, and study the content of big data rights from four stages: original data owner's rights, big data collector and miner's rights, big data processor and analyser's rights and big data applicator's rights, and analyse the attribution of big data rights in each stage separately. It is believed that the rights can be attributed to the owner of the data and the collector of big data, and the rights can be confirmed by contract law and autonomy in the processing and analysis stage, and the principle of sharing the results of big data application is adopted. In practice, big data frequently becomes the infringement object of personal information rights, copyright, and enterprise trade secrets. This chapter analyses the attribution principles, constitutive elements, and behavioural manifestations of personal information rights, copyright, and trade secret infringement types, and evaluates the advantages and disadvantages of different empowerment models to protect the rights and interests of big data.

articleTitle: Analysis of the solution to the interference of subway communication signal
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the phenomenon that the 2.4GHz Metro communication system is interfered by many other irrelevant signals, through analysis and simulation, it is concluded that the factors such as vehicle speed, complex environment and base station location will make the signal-to-noise ratio of the Metro Communication System worse. In this paper, the rationality of the conjecture is proved by theoretical analysis, simulation of signal intensity distribution and signal-to-noise ratio rise. This paper analyzes the two solutions of reducing interference source and protecting sensitive source signal. On this basis, it puts forward the scheme of installing shielding network to solve the interference of Metro communication signal, and analyzes the feasibility of several solutions.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the Thermal Regeneration Process of DPF
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the regeneration testing bench with additional heating sources, the thermal regeneration process of DPF and ignition point were investigated. The results show that: in the process of thermal regeneration, the regeneration heat mainly tends to accumulated at the rear central of DPF, which leaded to generate a hot zone, and the heat transfer from rear to front of DPF, gradually expanding the hot zone area and promoted particle regeneration. With the increase of carbon black load, the maximum wall temperature and regeneration efficiency gradually increased first and the gradually stabilized. There are two ignition modes during regeneration: uniform combustion at low carbon loading and multi-point combustion at high carbon load. The number of ignition points shows a similar parabolic trend with the increase of carbon load. With the increase of ash load, the maximum wall temperature and regeneration efficiency gradually increased, while the ignition modes were all multi-point ignition, and the number of ignition points remained unchanged with the increase of ash load.

articleTitle: Adjustable semi-automatic wallpaper sticking machine
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wallpaper was introduced into China in the late 1970s. As an important interior decoration material, it has gradually consolidated its development position in the Chinese market in the past 40 years. As far as the current development is concerned, the number of wallpaper production lines has exceeded 1,000 in China, producing more than 800 million square meters of wallpaper, accounting for about 20% of the total global wallpaper production. The economic output value is considerable, and the steady increase in sales has long been overwhelming. Compared with other wall decoration materials, wallpaper is more cost-effective, cheaper, and easy to construct, has a variety of patterns, and is easy to replace. Therefore, some rational consumers will choose to use wallpaper to decorate the walls. But posting wallpapers often requires the cooperation of two people, wasting time and energy. At the same time, when the wallpaper is posted, it cannot be posted well when encountering obstacles. Therefore, it is more convenient and faster to design an adjustable semi-automatic wallpaper sticking machine. Moreover, compared with various automatic wallpaper sticking machines in the laboratory stage, this design is more portable and economical, which better caters to the needs of users who stick wallpaper by themselves, and reduces the difficulty of using it in the process of sticking wallpaper by themselves.

articleTitle: Design and selection of biomass biogas mixing equipment for removing miscellaneous multiphase flow from livestock and poultry waste
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Animal manure contains sand, chicken feathers and other debris, in the biogas project fermentation tank before the raw material of poultry manure to remove miscellaneous. Methods: Based on the principle of multiphase flow mixing, the main structure, working principle and main characteristics of multiphase flow mixers for the removal of animal manure were designed. Results: The impurities such as chicken feathers and gravel were removed at one time. Conclusion: The purification of livestock and poultry excrement before fermentation can reduce production cost and increase working efficiency.

articleTitle: Cloud Accounting-based SME Investment Decision in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology and its widespread application in people's daily life production have pushed human society into the era of big data. The era of big data can not only provide massive data for various economic activities, but also provide valuable information for large and small business decision-making. In turn, it will ensure that corporate decision-making is scientific and reasonable, reduce corporate decision-making risks, reduce corporate losses, and help improve corporate competitiveness. In the era of big data, the competitive situation among enterprises has also been reshaped. We need to build a big data service platform for information sharing and combine it with management accounting to form a cloud accounting data service platform. This can effectively promote the innovation and development of enterprises and help enterprises seize market opportunities. Moreover, big data can also mine valuable strategic resources to ensure the accuracy of investment decisions, thereby enhancing the core competitiveness of enterprises.

articleTitle: Evaluation and analysis of college students' physical education relying on the algorithm of emergent words detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of physical education reform, attention should be paid to the evaluation of students' satisfaction with the quality of physical education and the establishment of a physical education quality evaluation system. This paper relies on the detection algorithm of emergent words, adopts the method of investigation and analysis, obtains the four main factors that affect the evaluation results of the classroom teaching quality of college physical education teachers, and conducts impact analysis, aiming to provide a reference for the evaluation of college physical education quality.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling technique for the positioning system of Marine Nuclear Power Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The positioning system of Marine Nuclear Power Platform (MNPP) is a kind of marine engineering structure with multi hinge connection. Because of the complexity of ocean load and the nonlinearity of multi hinge connection of soft rigid arm mooring structure, the conventional method of hydrodynamic simulation and pool model experiment, is unable to describe the movement characteristics and stress state of the soft rigid arm mooring system in service. Based on the idea of multi-agent modeling, this paper proposes a numerical modeling method for the positioning system of MNPP, which provides a general and domain independent model description, and expresses the most critical elements and their relationships in the system structure from a high level. The numerical modeling method proposed in this paper is suitable for the positioning system of MNPP in complex environment, and can provide comprehensive technical support for its intelligent operation and maintenance. Keywords-component; positioning system; numerical modeling; multi-agent modeling; intelligent maintenance.

articleTitle: A new type of building settlement monitoring system based on photoelectric self-calibration
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In response to the need for safety monitoring of buildings during construction and operation, this paper designs a new type of building settlement monitoring system based on photoelectric self-calibration. The whole system takes laser collimation system, inclination sensor and development board as the core, uses laser collimation characteristics, and uses laser dual-loop networking to set monitoring points. The development board Synchronously collect the real-time data of each monitoring point and transmit it to the cloud server through the 4G network. After data processing on the upper computer, the settlement monitoring point is found and the precise settlement amount is obtained, and then the total station is used for accurate measurement to achieve the purpose of mutual verification.

articleTitle: A method of abstracting short text for consulting clients
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Text abstracting is widely used in search engine, text database, information filtering. In the text extraction method, the mathematical model is usually established first and extracted by the model, but this method is not effective in solving nonlinear problems. Support vector machine (SVM), based on statistical learning theory, converts a certain amount of text into vectorized training text data for extraction. This paper adopts support vector machine (SVM) to study text extraction in telecommunication field, and we obtained good results.

articleTitle: Mechanical properties of heat resistant steel for main steam pipe of utility boiler after 6 years of service
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Grade 92 steel pipe was replaced after 6 years of service. In this paper, the steel was tested and analyzed by tensile test at room temperature and high temperature and microhardness test. The test results show that the mechanical properties of the steel still meet the requirements of relevant standards after 6 years of service.

articleTitle: Influence of Material on Gear Contact Stress
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Gear mechanism is one of the most widely used transmission methods in mechanical transmission. The stress change and deformation of gear under the same load under different material conditions are analyzed, which provides a reference for gear design and optimization.In this paper, the finite element analysis of a pair of meshing gears is carried out by using Ansys Workbench, and the contact stress and deformation of different materials under the same load are studied. Under the same load condition, the maximum stress and deformation of medium carbon alloy steel represented by No. 45 steel are less than that of low carbon steel represented by 40Cr, which is more suitable for making metal gear.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Reconstruction of Human Face Image Based on Network of Residual Dense Connection Channel Attentional
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural network is very important for super-resolution reconstruction of face images. However, deeper convolutional networks are more difficult to train for face super-resolution reconstruction. The input low-resolution face images contain a wealth of low-frequency information, these low-frequency information is processed equally in the channel, which hinders the characterization ability of the convolutional neural network, sequentially the recovery performance is affected, so that the super-resolution reconstruction results obtained are inaccurate. In order to solve these problems, we propose a residual convolution network with a compact structure. Specifically, we propose a modified residual structure group to deepen the network structure. In the residual structure group, the compact and dense connection structure is combined to make full use of the high frequency information learned by the previous network, and the features of the shallow small perception field are transmitted to the network to complete the specific task. In addition, we introduce an attentional mechanism for adaptive re-estimation of channel characteristics by considering the dependencies between channels. Experiment results show that the proposed network achieves better accuracy and satisfactory visual effect.

articleTitle: Research on Practical Teaching of Computer Software Course for Visual Communication Design Major
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the meaning of visual communication design and its application in life, and then analyzes the application of computer software course in visual communication design major, including the construction of curriculum model and the application of software. Then this paper discusses the importance of computer software course in visual communication design specialty. Finally, this paper discusses and studies the practical teaching of computer software course in visual communication design major. Based on the development status of visual communication design specialty in China, the practical teaching of computer software course is constantly improved.

articleTitle: Grid-connection Time Forecast of Synchronous Condensers
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of UHVDC power transmission, synchronous condensers with dynamic reactive power compensation capability begin to be applied on a large scale. In view of the grid-connection problem of synchronous condensers, based on the improvement of traditional phase-angle difference time function, this paper analyses the influence of change of acceleration on the synchronous point prediction of synchronous condensers in the process of inert deceleration grid-connection. Through theory and numerical example, the number of synchronous points in the maximum allowable slip range and the allowable closing time range of synchronous condensers are analysed during the grid-connection process, and the correctness of the analysis results is verified on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation software. The research in this paper provides great convenience for predicting the time of the closing pulse and further improves the grid-connection success rate of synchronous condensers.

articleTitle: Simulation of aviation anti-G regulator based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an important part of the life support system for high performance fighter pilots, the aviation anti-G regulator can protect pilots from overload during maneuvering flight. Based on the design library of mechanical and pneumatic components in AMESim, one-dimensional flow simulation model and mechanical motion model of the system were established according to the structural principle of the aviation anti-G regulator. By simulating the overlord environment, the working curve of the anti-G regulator under different overloads were obtained. By changing the structure parameters, effects of several key parameters on the performance were discussed. The simulation results can play a guiding role in the structural optimization of the aviation anti-G regulator. Keywords-Aviation anti-G regulator; life support system; overload; AMESim; Mechanical simulation; One-dimensional flow simulation.

articleTitle: Unmanned vehicles scheduling system with data fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Unmanned transportation mode can save a lot of human resources and economic costs. It has a wide range of application scenarios and good development prospects. In this paper, we design an unmanned vehicles scheduling system that combines data fusion technology in order to realize unmanned transportation mode. We also optimize the vehicle routing algorithm to improve the efficiency of unmanned transportation. The system will synthesize speed, economy, safety to generate the optimal transportation scheme. We evaluate the real-time performance of the system, and the results meet the requirements of data fusion transmitted by multiple information sources.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Thermal Warping Deformation of Brake Disc Based on AK-MCS Method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of reliability analysis in which the thermal warping deformation of the automobile brake disc presents an implicit complex nonlinear relationship with the design variables, a reliability analysis method of thermal warping deformation of brake disc based on AK-MCS method was proposed by combining Kriging model, active learning strategy and Monte Carlo Simulation. The Kriging model was used to construct the surrogate model of the thermal warping deformation performance function of the brake disc, and the continuous updating of the Kriging model was realized by establishing the learning function U. Based on this, Monte Carlo Simulation method was used to calculate the reliability of the thermal warping deformation of the brake disc, and the failure probability is 0.0035. The prediction accuracy of the Kriging model was tested and the results show that it meets the engineering requirements, so the reliability analysis results were proved to be efficient. The proposed method can be used for reference for the reliability analysis of automobile key parts.

articleTitle: Summary of Control Algorithm for Underwater Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The development of a country is inseparable from resources. With the shortage of land resources, all countries begin to explore underwater resources. Whether now or in the future, underwater robots are crucial equipment for all countries in the exploration and exploitation of Marine resources, and are a hot research topic in today's era. This paper introduces and studies the underwater manipulator studied by several foreign companies in recent years by looking up relevant literature and data, and at the same time briefly introduces the underwater manipulator studied by more mature research institutes and universities in China in recent years. On this basis, several common single control methods and complex control methods as well as relevant application examples are briefly introduced and analyzed. Finally, the future development and research direction of this hot topic are prospected.

articleTitle: Research on Airborne Real Time Processing and Prediction of Engine Total Pressure Distortion
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to monitor the engine inlet total pressure distortion index online in the flight test, an embedded real-time processing scheme based on airborne general data acquisition system is designed. Through the embedded real-time processing module, the collected total pressure and dynamic pressure parameters are processed at the airborne terminal, and the total pressure distortion index of the engine inlet is calculated in real time. The total pressure distortion index time series are predicted to solve the influence of distortion index calculation delay on safety monitoring. The future state is predicted, and the results are telemetered and transmitted down through the telemetry system. The flight test results show that the system can realize the real-time calculation of engine inlet total pressure distortion index, and the calculation results meet the requirements of accuracy and real-time. It is of great significance to improve the safety monitoring ability and flight test efficiency of related subjects.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of SDN Operating System Based on Linux Kernel
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: SDN is a new network architecture. Its function is to centralize the network control, shorten the network deployment cycle and expand network services. At present, OpenFlow protocol in SDN is relatively mature, but there is no mature network operating system architecture. This paper proposes a new network operating system architecture to solve this problem.

articleTitle: An Interactive Animation for Demonstrating Ship Maneuvering plotting
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on analyzing characteristics and requirements of naval ship maneuvering plotting, this paper puts forward an intuitive, accurate, and interactive animation. After introducing the basic elements of animation, such as geometric objects, computational objects, and annotation objects, we propose the time and position constraints between objects, and then describe the actual generation mechanism including dynamic geometric figures, object attributes and detail optimizing. The preliminary practice based on hand-drawn software proves the animation is superior to common forms. As an automatic solution platform for ship maneuvering plotting problems, the animation also provides a new idea for navigation plotting automation.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Gear Shift Synchronization Process for Tracked Vehicle Automated Mechanical Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of broken tooth and apical tooth caused by large gear shift impact for tracked vehicle Automated Mechanical Transmission (AMT), based on the analysis of the gear shift synchronization process and its evaluation indicators (shift synchronization time, impact degree, and sliding friction power), and establishing mathematical model, an optimal control method of gear shift synchronization process based on the minimum principle is proposed. Taking the impact degree and the sliding friction power of synchronization phase as optimization objective, a comprehensive optimal objective functional is established and optimized to obtain the comprehensive optimal shifting force change law in the synchronization process. Finally, the method is verified by MATLAB /Simulink, the simulation results show that this method can improve the shift quality and smoothness of tracked vehicle.

articleTitle: Fast Verification of Space Based on Hierarchical Bounding Boxes in Virtual Assembly
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tools are required to install or disassemble parts in virtual assembly or virtual maintenance. Tools need proper movement space, and components also need proper movement space for installation or disassembly. The movement mode of tools is mostly moving or rotating, and the movement mode of parts is mostly moving mode. The size of the movement space is one of the important factors to evaluate the performance of assembly or maintainability. Therefore, it is necessary to detect the collision of parts or tools when moving in the space and measure the size of the movement space. Aiming at the problems of the accuracy, low efficiency and even lack of algorithms for the calculation of the movable space in the existing virtual assembly and maintenance, we proposed an algorithm that can quickly and accurately calculate the collision verification of parts in the movable space. The algorithm firstly stretches the bounding box and triangle of the selected part to simulate object translation, then calculates the other parts colliding with the selected part on the path based on the detection algorithm of the hierarchical bounding box and triangle intersection, and finally calculates the collision distance by using dichotomy and progressive method.

articleTitle: Non-destructive testing of weld defects based on finite element analysis of magneto-optical images
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Magneto-optical imaging is based on the theory of leakage magnetic field and the Faraday magneto-optical effect. A magnetic dipole model of pit was established and verified by comparing with gray value of magneto-optical image of pit. The sag, pit, non-melting and non-defect of welded pieces made in the detection of magneto-optical were simulated by the two-dimensional finite element models. The magnetic induction intensity distributions of defects in the lift strength of 1mm were obtained in the simulations. Experiments on detecting the defects referred above by magneto-optical detection were carried out and magneto-optical images of the defects were acquired. The simulations were proved reliable when compared with magnetic field distribution of models and gray curves of magneto-optical images of the corresponding defects. Also, these models analyzed magnetic induction intensity distributions of different defects in different strengths of lift. Furthermore, it provided the theoretical and experimental basis for further study of the mechanism of magneto-optic imaging.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Incomplete Repair Strategy Considering Proportional Hazard Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to consider the incomplete maintenance problem into the transformer state maintenance strategy, this paper proposes a transformer state maintenance strategy based on the proportional strength model. First of all, this paper establishes a transformer proportional strength model, and gives a detailed calculation model of incomplete maintenance parameters in the proportional strength model. And this article has determined its reasonable value range and clarified the overhaul effect of incomplete overhaul activities. Secondly, this paper uses the least cost method to determine the condition maintenance threshold curve of the proportional strength model, and adds the lower limit of the threshold as the restrictive index of the condition maintenance strategy. Then, this paper uses actual transformer fault statistics and condition monitoring data to carry out a calculation example analysis. Finally, the effectiveness of the proportional strength model in the case of incomplete overhaul is verified through the analysis of a calculation example, which provides a reliable theoretical basis for the decision-making of the transformer's condition overhaul.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Linear Frequency Modulation Infrared Thermal Wave Detection for GFRP/Nomex Honeycomb Sandwich Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to explore the effectiveness of linear frequency modulation continuous light-excited infrared thermal waves to detect defects in GFRP/Nomex honeycomb sandwich structure, a three-dimensional heat conduction model of heat flow in the component was established and a finite element simulation study was carried out. By setting different detection parameters, the changes in contrast of the internal components with defects such as debonding, water accumulation and glue blocking are explored. The results show that the larger the debonding diameter and the smaller the thickness, the easier it is to detect; the higher the water accumulation height, the easier it is to detect; the thicker the plugging thickness is, the easier it is to detect. At the same time, the greater the initial frequency of the excitation signal, the earlier the first contrast peak will appear; the change in the stop frequency and the scan period will have less influence on the contrast.

articleTitle: Measurement of hydraulic oil pressure in pipeline based on Short-time Fourier method
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The steel pipe filled with No.46 hydraulic oil was taken as the experimental object, using a dedicated change the hydraulic oil pressure steel pipe pressure regulating equipment, using the center frequency of 5 MHz broadband ultrasonic transducer in the outer wall of steel pipe to detect the hydraulic oil, short time Fourier transform (STFT) is used to collect the velocity of ultrasonic in the hydraulic oil under different pressure spectrum and attenuation spectrum, analysis of ultrasonic velocity, the ultrasonic attenuation coefficient and the relationship between the hydraulic oil pressure. The results show that with the increase of the pressure of the hydraulic oil in the steel pipe, the velocity of ultrasonic increases and the attenuation coefficient decreases, and the relationship between the pressure and the velocity and attenuation coefficient satisfies a certain function. The pressure calculated by this function is less than 3% when compared with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Active distribution network reconfiguration considering Adjustable load and using two-track coordination algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, most of the existing optimal reconfiguration methods for power system active distribution network (ADN) aim to change the network topology without considering the Adjustable load. In ADN, the efficiency of the original reconstruction method can't meet the requirements when the proportion of the Adjustable load is increasing. Based on the consideration of the Adjustable load, this paper establishes the fast non dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) based on the coevolution and the dual track system coevolution group evolution model based on the coevolution total learning particle swarm optimization (CE-MOCLPSO), and solves the problem of the active distribution network reconfiguration and the simultaneous optimization of the Adjustable load. In this paper, based on the IEEE33 node distribution system design, several simulation examples are analyzed. The results show that the active distribution network reconfiguration considers the scheduling of Adjustable load, effectively improves the operation quality of the distribution network, and verifies the efficiency of the reconfiguration scheme is higher than the original two-stage reconfiguration method.

articleTitle: PM-AE: Pyramid Memory Autoencoder for Unsupervised Textured Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Anomaly detection for textured surface is a key task in product quality control. In recent years, supervised deep learning approaches have begun to be applied in this field, whereas most of the approaches are usually impracticable in collecting a large scale of defect samples. To this end, this paper proposes an efficient pyramid memory autoencoder. A new approach is developed by reconstructing background texture using autoencoder neural networks with multi-scale spatial pyramid pooling module and affinity memory module. With only positive samples for training phase, the proposed method managed to localize various defects on textured surfaces. Experimental results demonstrated not only its superiority on efficiency and accuracy, but also the great potential in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Research on the Fire Hose Burst Issues in the Stator of The Hydraulic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The safety issue of technical water supply pipelines in hydroelectric power plant has been an ingrained problem, especially for the old hydraulic power plants. On the one hand, the original design and manufacture are inferior in quality; on the other hand, as the corrosion aggravates over time, water leakage and seepage frequently arise. In acute cases, the workshop may be flooded and other major accidents may occur accordingly. Starting with an accident that the fire hose of stator broke apart, this paper analysed the causes for pipeline break and presented relevant rectification scheme. It has provided technical guidance for maintaining and reconditioning the same type of water pipes.

articleTitle: Based on BP Neural Network Compensating ADRC in Temperature of Molecular Distillation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, in order to get a stable temperature of Hot-oil-engine, an improved mathematical model of active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) is proposed based on BP neural network. In this model, all the parameters are real-time adjustment by BP neural network. Also, the process of stability is analyzed in detail. The results are shown that the stronger anti-interference performance can be obtained than the conventional ADRC. The verification is obtained between theory analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: Super Resolution for Remote Sensing Images via Improved Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the processing characteristics of remote sensing image super-resolution, this paper studies a super resolution method based on improved residual network. First, we optimize the structure of the residual block to meet the needs of super-resolution tasks; then, we further deepen the network level, so that the network has a stronger learning ability. The reconstruction results on the remote sensing images dataset show that the improved residual network achieves better visual effect, and the objective evaluation index is significantly improved, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of sawdust dust removal system based on PLC control
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of economy and society, the demand for wood in our country is increasing year by year, and the production and sales of wood processing are also increasing. Therefore, it is urgent to design and produce scientific and advanced dust removal system and carry out scientific dust removal. The sawdust dust removal system based on PLC control is operated by using PID adjusting frequency conversion machine and connecting the display screen in the form of pulse. The system is environmentally friendly, safe and energy-saving. The purpose of this paper is to introduce the relevant situation of the system for readers to understand.

articleTitle: Improved feeding device for machining
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Feeding refers to putting materials into machines for processing. However, with the development of society, more and more materials are needed. However, the efficiency of manual feeding is too low to meet the needs of production. In the process of mechanical processing, it is usually necessary to process parts or structures for stamping. The existing mechanical processing and stamping equipment adopts manual feeding, which not only has low efficiency, but also has great danger and high production cost. To solve the problems raised in the background technology, an improved feeding device for machining is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on TOX Riveting Properties of Dissimilar Metals
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The structure connection methods of steel and aluminum include mechanical connection, welding and bonding, and TOX riveting is an effective means for steel/aluminum dissimilar metal connection. The 1.5mm 5A05(0) aluminum plate and 1.5mm cold-rolled steel plate (SPCC) dissimilar metals were selected as the research object, and the steel/aluminum dissimilar metals TOX riveting tests of the different lap modes (steel plate pressed into aluminum plate, aluminum plate pressed into steel plate) were carried out under different pressures. The shear strength of the riveted joints under different pressure and lap mode was obtained, and the optimized process parameters were obtained according to the variation law of the shear strength. At the same time, the salt spray corrosion resistance of the riveted joints of steel/aluminum dissimilar metal under different treatment processes and the variation situation of joint properties after salt spray tests were studied. The test results showed that the bottom thickness decreased with the increase of pressure. When the pressure increased to 27 MPa, the change of the bottom thickness tended to be gentle, and the shear strength of the riveted joint reached the maximum. At the same pressure, the shear strength of the riveted joint when the steel plate was pressed into the aluminum plate was higher than that of the aluminum plate was pressed into the steel plate. The TOX riveted joint of steel/aluminum dissimilar metal had the best shear resistance when the steel plate was pressed into the aluminum plate at a pressure of 27 MPa. In addition, the riveted joints after painting had the best salt spray resistance, but the shear strength of the riveted joints was significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Coupling Utilization of Energy and Mass of Hot Metallurgical Slag: a review
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In modern society, the demand for energy is increasing day by day. How to get more energy from various channels is related to the future development of human beings. This paper starts with the waste heat recovery of blast furnace slag. Firstly, some common methods of waste heat recovery of blast furnace slag are described, including mechanical crushing method, mechanical mixing method, rotary drum method, rotary drum method, blast method, centrifugal granulation method and rotary disc method. Then, the system of slag waste heat recovery by a compound way is designed.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Clustering Algorithm for Personalized Recommendation of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: How to use the data mining and analysis algorithm to carry out e-commerce recommendation has become one of the important contents of the current information technology development. Therefore, in this paper, research on ant colony clustering algorithm for personalized recommendation of e-commerce was proposed. The domestic and foreign research on e-commerce recommendation was simply summarized. Through the classical clustering algorithm in ant colony algorithm, an e-commerce recommendation algorithm was designed. Then the experimental results of the proposed algorithm prove that the algorithm is a very effective e-commerce recommendation algorithm, but also better than other e-commerce recommendation algorithms.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Comprehensive Ability Assessment System for English Teaching from the Perspective of Computer Information Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to further improve the teaching comprehensive ability of college English teachers, we must have a scientific and reliable ability evaluation system. The system should set up the evaluation indexes strictly according to the talent training plan and the related psychological weight of each university in order to complete the evaluation order of comprehensive ability. However, because the parameters and data processing involved in the evaluation system are very large, this paper discusses the effective path of the construction of the comprehensive capability evaluation system on the basis of the advantages of big data technology.

articleTitle: Effect of marman clamp system on dynamic characteristics of spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Marman clamp system is usually used to fasten spacecraft and the launch vehicle, or different sections of spacecraft. In this paper, the axial stiffness of the marman clamp system was calculated by theoretical calculation. Then stiffness of marman clamp system was taken into account in the finite element method (FEM) model of spacecraft. Finally, modal analysis and frequency response analysis were carried out to validate the effects of marman clamp system on dynamic characteristics of spacecraft. The simulation results were compared with those results based on the FEM where the spacecraft was considered to be fixed to explore the effect of the marman clamp system on dynamic characteristics of spacecraft. The results showed that the fundamental frequency of satellite decreases when taking into account of marman clamp system, and the later fundamental frequencies at horizontal directions decrease more than the longitudinal direction. The acceleration responses of the satellite changed little when taking into accounting of the marman clamp system. The analysis method and results may extend to other spacecrafts with marman clamp system.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Security System Based on Hyper Text Markup Language 5 Gateway
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Smart security refers to the information technology of security services. With the rapid development of information technology in the 21st century, the boundary between intelligent security technology and computer is gradually disappearing. This article designs a smart security system based on HTML5 (Hyper Text Markup Language 5) gateway and UDP (User Datagram Protocol), with fingerprint recognition, password control, voice, remote control, user interface, HTML5 monitoring page multi-device login, touch buttons and other functions. At the same time, we complete the drawing and design of the PCB (Printed Circuit Board), realize the software and hardware design and construction, and complete the overall security system design.

articleTitle: Fault analysis and treatment of large centrifugal air compressor with insufficient discharge capacity
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes in detail the failure of MCL1204 air compressor, an important equipment in a refinery. Based on the mathematical modeling of the gas leakage of the bulkhead, the influence of the factor on the leakage is analyzed theoretically. With the help of laser alignment, the key parts of the unit were measured, the main cause of the fault was found and the fault was successfully repaired.

articleTitle: On the Reform of the Course of Monetary Banking in the Context of Internet Finance
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of social economy, the Internet has more and more influence on people's work and life, which not only changes people's working and life style, but also has a profound influence in the fields of economy and finance. This requires that the education of financial discipline should constantly adapt to the requirements of the new era and new changes, train new financial and monetary talents, and how to train new financial and monetary talents, which puts forward higher requirements for the reform of financial related courses in the new era. Under the background of Internet big data era, the curriculum reform of monetary banking is imperative. The purpose of this paper is to explore how to reform the course of multi-monetary banking in order to meet the requirements of the new era.

articleTitle: On the Black-Hole Numbers of the Iteration of Digital Biquadratic Sum in the Quanternary, Octonary or Hexadecimal System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are different periodic and fixed points under the iteration of biquadratic sum of digits of positive integer in different carry systems. There are three fixed points and one 2-circle in quanternary, seven fixed points in octonary, two fixed points, one 2-circle and one 6-circle in hexadecimal system.

articleTitle: Burst failure analysis of a gas cylinder
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A seamless steel cylinder filled with oxygen exploded during the hydraulic test. In this paper, the microstructure, wall thickness, chemical composition and mechanical properties of gas cylinders are tested and analyzed. The results are in accordance with the relevant standards. However, in the macro analysis of the gas cylinder, it is found that there are linear defects at the fracture surface, the cylinder is corroded seriously and there are a lot of circular block at the bottom of the cylinder. The comprehensive analysis results show that, the defects in the manufacturing process and oxygen corrosion in the use process are the main reasons for the cylinder rupture in the process of hydraulic test.

articleTitle: Research on the Surface Overlay Quality Problems of the Hubs in Axial-Flow Assembling Unit During Ex-Factory Acceptance
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The casting material of modified hub in a certain assembling unit was made from 20SiMn Furthermore, it used the puddle welding technology to generate 390L cladding as the surface of hub to improve its anti-cavitation ability. Nevertheless, quality issues were still spotted on the overlay of hubs in ex-factory acceptance. On the one hand, the detecting defects existed in the penetration test; on the other hand, the hardness test was ineligible. After turning off the defective surface, the inner puddle welding layer remained similar defects. Therefore, the surface overlay of hubs was completely turned off and then processed by puddle welding method so as to ensure the overall quality of the hubs.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning and Simulation of Intelligent Logistics Vehicle Based on Improved EKF-SALM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The traditional algorithm of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) has two problems. The local linearization method adopted by the traditional EKF causes cumulative errors. The SLAM algorithm is vulnerable to external environment interference. In this paper, an improved EKF-SALM algorithm based on error correction factor is proposed and applied to the path planning of intelligent logistics vehicles. The algorithm focuses on the errors between the predicted values and the observed values of landmark feature points. When any error exceeds the preset threshold value, the prior estimation error covariance will be adjusted through the error correction factor in order to make quick corrections to the error.
