Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of both vehicle positioning and map building.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Computer Application on Regional Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since contemporary information-retrieval systems rely heavily on the content of titles and abstracts to identify relevant articles in literature searches, great care should be taken in constructing both. In the advancement of regional economy, computer network technology highlights its unique value and injects the power of the times to optimize regional management. Relevant departments should take a long-term perspective on the meaning of computer technology and apply it in light of the forward characteristics of the regional economy. This can enable it to promote efficient technology under the change of regional economic structure, and cater to the ever-changing international market environment by changing the elements of economic development. The management department needs to use the current computer network technology to make targeted adjustments to the forward plan of the traditional regional economy. Under the rapid exchange of information, the resources can be transmitted in different regions, so that the resources can be reasonably and comprehensively allocated. This will have varying degrees of impact on the speed and quality of the overall advancement of the regional economy, creating a healthy and stable environment, and promoting the steady advancement of the regional economy in the new era with technical support.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Generalized Predictive Control for Ship Course
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the drawbacks of conventional autopilots such as slow speed, unstable rudder angle and large error, the basic methods of active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) and generalized predictive control (GPC) are combined to control the ship's course. Active disturbance rejection control uses the extended state observer to estimate and compensate for the uncertainty of the ship motion control model parameters and the variability of external disturbances. Generalized predictive control solves the problems of system dynamics and stability, and ensures the performance of the algorithm. In this paper, a simulation experiment is designed and compared with the traditional proportional integral derivative (PID) control method, it verifies the effectiveness and robustness of active disturbance rejection generalized predictive control in ship motion control.

articleTitle: Evaluation and analysis of strategic human resource management based on multi-mode fuzzy logic control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As the effectiveness of human resource management continues to be valued, how to conduct human resource management evaluation and analysis has become an important research direction. This paper relies on the multi-mode fuzzy logic control algorithm, evaluates the comprehensive level of employees' competence by establishing the degree of membership of work ability, etc., uses fuzzy sets and other methods to optimize the overall work efficiency, aiming to evaluate the effective support of enterprise human resource management.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and AMESim Simulation on Differential Relay Valve
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on physical structure and theory of aerodynamics, a mathematical model for differential relay valve (DRV) is established. A simulation model considering internal structure parameters of the valve equipped on a multi-axle heavy vehicle is proposed using the multi-domain simulation platform AMESim, then the static and dynamic performance of the valve are obtained under different simulation conditions. The results show that output pressure of DRV is determined by the larger one between the service brake pressure and the parking brake pressure, and exhibits good dynamical follow-up response performance.

articleTitle: Design of safety protection system for the elderly based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A safety protection system for the elderly was designed based on STM32 microcontroller. The main functions include: anti-loss function, anti-fall function for the elderly, alarm when the concentration of gas exceeds a certain level. The device can be used for alarm messages, voice broadcasts and GSM short message remote notifications. When the elderly sense danger, the device can alarm manually. This system can comprehensively protect the elderly's own safety and has certain practical application significance.

articleTitle: Application Prospect of Internet of Things Technology in Rural Revitalization
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to better realize rural revitalization and promote the development of agriculture in the direction of intelligence and efficiency, people need to combine the Internet of Things technology with rural revitalization. Moreover, as the Internet of Things technology continues to improve, its role will become more and more obvious. This article summarizes the problems existing in the process of rural revitalization based on previous work experience. The author discusses the application prospects of the Internet of Things technology in rural revitalization from five aspects: Internet of Things smart agriculture, smart elderly care and medical care, Internet of Things course education, technology integration, and science and technology to promote agricultural modernization.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Curtain Control System Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the quality of life, people are increasingly pursuing the intelligence and comfort of a home environment. This paper proposes a novel intelligent curtain control system based on ZigBee (ICCSZ), which can control the curtain by automatic, manual, and voice. The ICCSZ is based on an embedded platform and ZigBee technology. It can get a response to the control and adjustment of Household Curtain by using an intelligent terminal. The photosensitive resistance transmits the signal. The stepping motor is used as the executive component, and the CC2530 single-chip microcomputer is the main control component. The advantages of CC2530 single-chip microcomputer reduce the complexity of the hardware. The photosensitive resistance receives the external light signal. After a / D conversion, it transmits an electrical signal to the single-chip microcomputer. After processing, the single-chip microcomputer controls the stepper motor to make the corresponding action to control the opening and closing of the curtain. The ICCSZ makes the curtain control more convenient and stable.

articleTitle: Design and research of University intelligent education cloud platform based on Dubbo microservice framework
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, more and more people participate in online learning, online interaction and online communication. Online education has gradually become a new education model. Aiming at the cloud computing environment, this paper uses the hierarchical systematic design idea to deeply carry out the demand analysis and architecture design of smart education cloud in Colleges and universities. The system architecture design of the platform takes service and component as the core, and realizes the service encapsulation of each functional module of the platform through the micro service design of the single project architecture. At the same time, combining Dubbo microservice framework and distributed database technology, the platform's RPC communication, service discovery and traffic management capabilities are optimized, which effectively improves the intelligent management and application level of the platform.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Power Data Assets Based on EWM-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Power data asset is an important carrier for the deep integration of energy technology and digital technology. However, due to the characteristics of large volume, complex relationship and rapid time sequence growth of power data, it is easy to create data redundancy and hinder the management of data assets. There is an urgent need for accurate value evaluation of power data assets, so as to increase the efficiency of data assets management, application and realization. Therefore, this paper proposes a power data asset valuation model based on entropy weight method and technology for order preference by similarity to an ideal solution. The model puts forward the evaluation index system of power data assets, and constructs the value calculation method based on entropy weight method and TOPSIS. The model can effectively identify the value of power data assets and improve the efficiency of data asset management of power grid enterprises.

articleTitle: The design of smart cooker based on ALiCloud platform
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of our country, people's living standard is improving day by day. While pursuing food and clothing, we also have higher requirements for quality. Food is the most important thing for us, and rice is an indispensable staple food on our table, Having a good cooker can give us a pot of delicious rice and have a good cooking process, Intelligent cooker is based on this demand in the rapid development and popularization. Therefore, the design of cooker based on Alicloud platform is proposed. Stm32f401re is used as the control chip, esp8266wifi module is used as the communication module, and other hardware circuits and designs are combined to complete the remote control of the cooker, realize add rice automatic, washing rise, cooking and some other work module.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Lcomotive Axle based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the mechanical design and its related principles, the axle is structurally designed, a three-dimensional model of the axle is built by Solidworks software, and then the static analysis of the axle is imported into ANSYS Workbench. the main purpose of which is to study the stress and strain of the axle and compare it with the results of theoretical calculations to determine whether its strength meets the design requirements, so as to ensure its normal operation.

articleTitle: Mask detection device based on YOLOv3 framework
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In early 2020, novel coronavirus pneumonia broke out. In order to prevent the spread of the disease, governments around the world asked the masses to wear masks. However, there are still many people who do not wear masks in public places. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a mask detection device based on yolo3 framework. The device uses the yolov3 algorithm to extract the face prediction area, and uses the gray image to calculate the skin exposure rate of the mouth and nose of the face, so as to judge whether the recognized person is wearing a mask or not and whether the mask is wearing correctly. The model is deployed on the hardware to facilitate the staff to carry the detection. The experimental results show that the recognition rate is 86.6%.

articleTitle: Discussion and Practice of Computer Network Information and Network Security Protection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, especially the application of big data technology, the role of computer networks has become more and more significant. Computer network has a profound impact on people's life and work, and has even become a part of life and work. However, computer network technology has also exposed some problems while providing convenience to people's lives. For example, the resulting information security issues pose a threat to people's personal privacy, corporate security, national security, etc., thereby affecting the sustainable development of computer network technology. Based on this, we must strengthen the research on computer network security. In particular, it is necessary to strengthen the research on the phenomenon of computer network information leakage and its causes, and strengthen the computer network security management. At the same time, we should also take necessary preventive measures from both technical and management aspects to ensure the safety of computer network information and reduce computer network threats. In view of this, this article will analyze and explore the current factors affecting computer network security on the basis of related concepts of computer network information security. The author analyzes how we should strengthen defenses from the perspective of technology and management to ensure the security of network information.

articleTitle: Summary of spline Curve Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of numerical control technology, the research and application of spline curve interpolation technology has also made great progress. In the traditional nc machining field, linear interpolation and circular interpolation can no longer meet the current processing requirements. How to improve the processing efficiency and accuracy is the research focus of scholars. All the time, scholars and researchers in this field have been exploring and studying tirelessly, and the calculation of interpolation parameters has become the most critical technology. How to calculate the interpolation parameters and how to reduce the different velocity fluctuations caused by different interpolation parameter calculation methods have become the key research content.

articleTitle: Motor Imagery Recognition Method based on Multi-Classifier Integrated Desision
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Motor imagery brain-Computer Interface has a unique advantage in stroke rehabilitation. It encourages the patient to imagine the affected side of motor motion based on plasticity of brain nerve. Motor imagery plays an indispensable role on stroke rehabilitation for its benefit to the reconstruction of brain's damaged nerve. In order to further improve the classification accuracy and reliability, enhance patients' confidence in treatment, at the same time, it also provides more accurate feedback for the online training part of the follow-up rehabilitation system. SVM, KNN (k-nearest neighbor) and LDA (linear discrimination analysis) are used to classify EEG data. For each sampling data, three classification methods are used, each classification method produces a corresponding classification result, and the final classification result is determined by voting mechanism. The comprehensive classification effect of multi-classifier is 2 %~6% higher than that of SVM classifier only.

articleTitle: Effective heuristics to minimize total flowtime for distributed flowshop group scheduling problems
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper deals with the distributed flowshop group scheduling problem to minimize the total flowtime. By analyzing the problem-specific knowledge, the longest processing time rule (LPT) and the shortest processing time rule (SPT), we present a total of 20 constructive heuristics including 8 simple heuristics, 8 combinative heuristics, and 4 NEH-based heuristics for solving the problem at a reasonable computational effort. We carry out extensive computational evaluations based on the 405 instances. The results show that the proposed algorithms are very effective for solving the problem under consideration. Among them, the NEH-based heuristic using SPT in the job sorting process and LPT in the group sorting process performs best.

articleTitle: Research on railroad turnout faults based on CART classification tree algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an important part of railroad equipment, turnout is the weakest part of the track structure and its quality directly affects the safety and quality of railroad transportation. In order to solve the shortcomings that maintenance personnel can only use professional testing instruments for testing and maintenance manually and lack of systematic theoretical knowledge and limitations when barriers occur, the key features of turnout failure can be extracted by using the turnout action curve and transition time provided by the monitoring system to build a turnout failure identification model to automatically determine whether the turnout is in a fault state, which can effectively manage the turnout. It can effectively manage turnout equipment, predict turnout faults, and improve equipment monitoring efficiency. The experimental results show that the accuracy of fault detection is as high as 96.86%.

articleTitle: ResGRUA Model for Tool Wear Prediction Based on Encoder-Decoder
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tool wear prediction is crucial to ensure machine parts quality and machining efficiency. Many machine learning methods, especially deep learning, have been applied to the researches of tool wear intelligent prediction. Aiming at the problems of poor adaptability and low long-term prediction accuracy in traditional tool wear prediction methods, based on encoder-decoder framework, we combine residual GRU network and self-attention, proposing the ResGRUA model to realize intelligent prediction of tool wear. Firstly, features from the input time series are extracted. Then, feature encoder based on bidirectional LSTM network is designed and applied on the generated feature vectors to learn the dynamic laws of two directions. The ResGRUA network as the model decoder is finally trained to predict machine condition. Experimental studies on an open source dataset are performed to validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model. Meanwhile, the experimental results demonstrate that this method has high stability in training process and can predict tool wear more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of school education management decision system based on Data Mining Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Modern school education management has realized informatization, which greatly improves the convenience of the work, but also brings a huge amount of information data, which makes school administrators feel powerless. In the face of huge information data, manual can not conduct a comprehensive analysis in a short time, and can not clarify the classification of information data and the relationship between each other. Influenced by the huge amount of information and data, it is difficult for manual to make accurate decisions in school education management. Under this condition, data mining technology gives an opportunity to improve. Using this technology to build data mining architecture and establish school education management decision-making system can improve work efficiency and quality with the help of technical advantages, and deeply excavate information connotation. This paper mainly focus on data mining architecture, and put forward the construction method of school education management decision-making system.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Urban Aerial Image Based on Advanced YOLO v3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of large changes in object scale and complex background in urban aerial image, we propose an advanced YOLOv3 detection algorithm to solve it. First, we analyze the aerial data through a clustering algorithm and calculate optimal size of the prior anchors. Then, a relatively lightweight and easily extensible backbone network-deep residual network is used for feature extraction. Meanwhile, in order to obtain a better receptive field and further reduce the information loss in the process of convolution, we add deformable convolution to the 8 times down-sampling feature map. And it improves the network's learning ability for geometrically deformed objects and attention mechanism before the 32 times down-sampling feature map to adaptively learn the weight relationship between different channels. Finally, IoU (Intersection over Union) is added to the regression loss function to improve the accuracy of evaluating the bounding box. The experimental results show that the inference speed of the optimized algorithm we proposed can reach 50 FPS, and the avera ge accuracy is 20% higher than the original network, which can complete the detection more effectively.

articleTitle: Model selection based on particle swarm optimization for omics data classification
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A new model selection algorithm based on binary particle swarm optimization is proposed for omics data classification. Particularly, the algorithm is designed to handle the high dimensionality, small sample size and class imbalance problems that are inherent in omics data. The particles encode candidate combinations of data sampling, feature selection, classification models and their corresponding parameter settings. The binary swarm optimization is targeted at the best classification performance. The particle velocity and position are iteratively updated until some stopping iteration is met and the optimal solution model combination is output. The simulative results on eight real-world omics datasets show that the proposed model selection algorithm is capable of avoiding the bias introduced by manual settings and leading to accurate and reliable classification performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of order completion time based on the BP neural network optimized by GASA
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Accurate prediction of order completion time (OCT) is an important guarantee for the workshop to dynamically adjust production plans and ensure timely delivery of products. In order to improve the arracy of predicting the OCT based on the BP neural network, this paper proposes a prediction method of the optimized BP neural network based on the genetic algorithm and the simulated annealing algorithm (GASA-BP). Because the simulated annealing algorithm (SA) has strong local searching ability and can avoid falling into the local optimum in searching process, the Metropolis acceptance criteria in SA is introduced to GA, which compares the new fitness of GA with the fitness of the last iteration to find the optimal solution. The improved GA continuously optimizes the weights and thresholds of the BP neural network and we use the trained BP neural network to obtain the optimal prediction value. Finally, the performance of the proposed GASA-BP in predicting the OCT is compared with the optimized BP neural network based on the genetic algorithm(GA-BP). And simulation experiments demonstrate the accuracy and feasibility of GASA-BP.

articleTitle: The Position Measurement of Excavator Working Device
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the problem that the contact sensors measure position is not reliable, a method of identifying pose information of excavator working device by non-contact visual camera is studied. First, the camera takes a two-dimensional map of the excavator's working device, which is subjected to image processing to obtain a binarized image. Then, the image is extracted and the pixel coordinates of the joint of the working device are obtained, and the accuracy of the different algorithms is compared. Finally, the transformation matrix between coordinate systems is deduced by theoretical calculation, and the coordinates of the pixel are converted into world coordinates with OpenCV software, and the correctness is verified by experiments. Experimental results show that: the error between measurement results obtained with this method and Total Station is within 30mm and the two are in good agreement. They can be applied to the actual measurement of excavator's position and orientation.

articleTitle: Functional safety integrity verification method of public transportation escalator
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To improve the safety management of escalator management, especially the safety management level of public transportation escalators, it is necessary to study the safety integrity verification methods of public transportation escalators. This article introduces the definition and calculation method of the integrity level of escalator safety functions. The risk diagram method is used to calculate the escalator functional safety functions. The article points out that as an important part of escalator safety, functional safety includes system safety functions and safety functions execution ability, through research and verification of calculation methods, it helps to improve the safety and reliability of escalators, and fills the gap in the field of functional verification.

articleTitle: Discussion on mixed teaching mode of college English under the background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Under the background of the increasing progress of science and technology in China, the Internet, as a new industry, not only promotes the transformation of China's economic development mode, but also provides support for education. At the same time, the development of “Internet” has brought great innovation to the traditional educational thought and mode, and promoted the development of college English teaching. Nowadays, the innovation and development of college English education focuses on how to integrate the traditional classroom education method with the online teaching method, and what role the “Internet” will play in the process. This article will explore the promotion of the Internet to the innovation and development of traditional college English education, and briefly understand the situation and innovation of college English education and teaching under the background of intelligence. This paper studies the integration and application of mixed teaching mode in college English education under intelligent conditions.

articleTitle: Identification of X-ray Weld Defects under Artificial Intelligence Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the need of automatic detection of weld defects, an automatic extraction and classification algorithm for welding defect features based on convolution neural network is proposed. The algorithm directly takes the preprocessed weld images as the input and the welding defect type as the output, effectively avoiding the adverse effect of artificial identification subjective experience on the detection results. The experimental results show that the welding defect identification technology based on convolution neural network has a good identification rate and can provide an important reference for the research of welding quality detection.

articleTitle: The Design of an Airbag Automatic Inflator and the Simulation Analysis of Airbag in the Unfolding Process
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An airbag automatic inflator was designed, which consists of a column pressure vessel, a bidirectional solenoid valve and a spherical airbag, etc. By introducing a thermodynamic model, its key parameters were analyzed and calculated according to the mass flow formula equation system. The numerical analysis models of the airbag with folding modes such as planar direct folding, symmetrical folding and roll folding were established to study the dynamic characteristics of the airbag inflating and unfolding, and the effects of the folding modes, the inflating rate and the inflating amount on the change of the curves of the volume and internal pressure of the airbag in the unfolding process were discussed respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Coding of Vehicle Camera System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to realize the long-distance and low-loss transmission of vehicle high-definition video, the framework and principle of vehicle camera transmission system are studied in this paper. By combining the hardware circuit of the vehicle camera transmission system, hardware coding and decoding and the principle of video signal coding and transmission, a vehicle forward-looking camera module is developed in this paper. First of all, according to the research results, the overall environmental framework of the transmission system is simulated and built. Then, the research conclusions of the power supply and the initial coding and decoding of the video signal are applied in practice, so that it can encode stably and transmit the video effectively. Then, this article further explored the architecture of the serializer/deserializer, complete the configuration of the hardware, at the same time, collect and summarize the data waveforms. Finally, this paper analyzes and evaluates the image quality obtained after restoration, and completes a research on the vehicle-mounted camera signal transmission system scheme with serializer and deserializer as the core. The experimental results show that stable and real-time high-definition video images can be obtained by using serializer and deserializer chip and using differential signal transmission protocol with interface type FPD-Link III LVDS to transmit video signals over a long distance. The application of this scheme can basically transmit 1280×720 video images with long distance and lossless resolution, and finally serve for the current intelligent driving of cars.

articleTitle: Design of Non-contact measurement System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on embedded system, this system designs and realizes the non-contact measurement of object size and shape. In this system, images are processed on the machine vision platform, while edge detection is performed using Canny operator. Hough transform is used to judge whether the object is circle, quaternion detection method is used to judge whether the object is rectangle. The system also uses radar to scan targets, and get their distance and size after using the embedded system to process the data. The system can automatically find a planar or three-dimensional target in a non-contact situation, quickly measure and display the distance, shape, and size of the planar target, identify the object in the database and measure the nearest distance.

articleTitle: A small LAN Zero Trust network model based on Elastic Stack
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Recently, people have changed from using USB and other media to relying on network protocol for data transmission. However, for the sake of security, important confidential units still disable all networks and use USB to transmit files, which wastes a lot of human resources and personnel energy. This paper constructs a small Zero Trust network model based on Elastic Stack, aiming to try to solve the problem of no network availability for important confidential units, and provide a method for solving the hidden danger of leakage. This model uses fingerprint as the user login credentials, and maps all operations to people accurately. Beats components running on the computer can collect and audit information such as user operation records. The information will be sent to Elasticsearch(ES), which will also be monitored by Kibana analysis. Users will be recorded and alerted if they overstep their authority or violate the rules. The security concept and effect of Zero-Trust network are very consistent with the work requirements of important confidential units. This paper proposed that important confidential units should try to build a zero-trust network, and use the network to improve work efficiency while ensuring confidentiality.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Targeted Person Holographic Archive System based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the popularization of big data, public security organs are facing problems such as incomplete information collection, difficulty in fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, and poor data association collected by front-end sensing devices in the management and control of targeted person. Combining the current situation and needs of public security management, this paper analyzes the targeted person's full-element information based on the Apriori association rule algorithm to conduct frequent item mining on the targeted person's attribute characteristics and behavior characteristics, which can effectively identify the abnormal behavior of targeted person and obtain deduction information, and finally implements a holographic archive system based on JavaEE design that can completely describe the targeted person. Its main functions include add files, file details, advanced search, “my focus”, “my supplement” and “my search”. After testing, the various functions of the system are operating well, which is conducive to the public security organs in real-time grasp of targeted person's basic information, social information, behavior information and other full-element information.

articleTitle: Research on Data Integrity Protection Technology of Industrial Control Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The industrial control network was used in a closed network at the beginning of its design. But in recent years, with the rapid development of the Internet of Things technology, the industrial control network needs to be interconnected with other information systems, exposing the vulnerability to the new network environment. This article introduces the security status of industrial control network and the security threats it faces, briefly describes the differences between industrial control network and IT network, and discusses the key technologies that play a role in the protection of industrial control network data integrity.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics Simulation of the Repulsion Mechanism and the Magnetic Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As the new types of operating mechanisms, electromagnetic repulsion mechanism and magnetic mechanism have the advantages of simple structure, easy control and high reliability. Firstly, the principle of repulsion mechanism and magnetic mechanism is introduced in this paper. Then, the simulation models of 1100kV bypass switch repulsion mechanism and magnetic mechanism are established. The dynamic characteristics of the mechanism are simulated and analyzed, and the corresponding optimal parameters are obtained. Finally, the action speed, the output force and the control circuit current of the repulsion mechanism and magnetic mechanism are compared. The simulation results show that the initial output of the repulsion mechanism is too large and the later output is insufficient, while the driving current of the magnetic mechanism is moderate and the output is uniform, so the magnetic mechanism is more suitable for long stroke bypass switch.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and vibration reduction analysis of a negative Poisson's ratio honeycomb foundation support
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the excellent performance of negative Poisson's ratio material in vibration and noise reduction, the negative Poisson's ratio material is applied to design the structural of ship and other vibration damping foundation supports. In this paper, a dynamic vibration damping foundation support is designed based on the negative Poisson's ratio reentrant structure. Under the muti-body system dynamics, the element model of negative poisson's ratio vibration foundation support is established by the Lagrangian equation, and the dynamic behavior of the structure is observed by applying harmonic force, Vibration level drop is adopted to evaluate the reduction buffering and vibration damping performance of foundation support damping structures. The vibration level drop is obtained through experimental analysis, it proves that the support structure can be used to reduce vibration, and the article provides a new modeling method and idea for analyzing similar structures.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Fusion Based Dongba Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Dongba characters are hieroglyphs still used by The Naxi nationality in Yunnan province, and have a long history which is called “living fossils” of characters. In view of the neglect of the influence of similar characters on the recognition accuracy and the absence of the construction and application of relevant models in the existing studies on Dongba characters, this paper proposes a multi-scale feature fusion based the character recognition model for Dongba characters. First of all, due to the lack of Dongba characters data set, two Dongba characters data sets (including DB1424, a common data set, and DBS20, a data set about similar characters) are constructed. Then, the design of this model mainly uses ResNet34 as the basic network model. While extracting the ResNet34 network features of the input image, the traditional feature extraction algorithm is used to extract the directional gradient histogram (HOG feature) of the image that can better reflect its structure and shape. The structural features of shallow layer and the semantic features of deep layer in the network are fused with HOG features to form a combined feature, and finally the Softmax classifier is used to output the results. The results of the experiments illustrate that the accuracy of the recognition model proposed in this paper on DB1424 and DBS20 are 89.712% and 94.729% respectively. Compared with other deep learning models, the model proposed in this paper has better learning ability, and the precision and recall rate are also higher.

articleTitle: Research on Microstructure and Properties of Magnesium Alloy Double Arc Active Welding
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This article studies the use of a two-electrode gas shielded welding system to separate the heat source of the molten wire from the heat source of the base metal to reduce the arc energy concentration and the impact of the droplets. The author studied the relationship between the direct current path and thermal performance by comparing the actual heat input of TIG welding and MIG welding with the actual heat input of single arc welding. The direct current path between the two electrodes ensures the stability of the arc in the double arc welding, and a defect-free welding joint can be obtained. At the same time, the time of the double electrode double arc welding is greatly reduced. Taking magnesium alloy welding as the research object, the welding parameters can be optimized, and the microstructure of the welded joint can be analyzed. The author determined the best parameter configuration based on the analysis results, and further studied the effect of the addition of active agent on the performance of double arc welding.

articleTitle: Studies on fault influence of Yindong HVDC transmission system in Shandong Power Grid Based on PSCAD
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the actual parameters, the PSCAD simulation model of Yindong HVDC transmission system is established. This paper uses appropriate electromagnetic transient simulation method to establish the inverter side AC equivalent (Shandong power grid) model, establishes different types of faults in Shandong power grid, including unbalanced fault (grounding fault) and symmetrical fault (three-phase short circuit fault). The influence of Shandong power AC system fault on Yindong HVDC transmission system is studied and analyzed, so as to improve the stable operation of Yindong HVDC transmission system For some guidance.

articleTitle: Application Research of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Electric Automation Control
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Automatic electrical control is an important technology in the modern industrial field, which greatly improves the quality and efficiency of industrial production. With the continuous development and maturity of new technologies such as artificial intelligence, its application in electrical automation control systems has further improved the control accuracy of the automation control system. Moreover, its advantage of more convenient control and operation has greatly promoted the transformation and upgrading of traditional large-scale industrial production models to personalized and diversified production methods. Therefore, we must strengthen the research on artificial intelligence technology, and actively explore its application in electrical automatic control systems, and promote the modern development of China's science and technology.

articleTitle: Defective Graphene as a promising lead pollution absorbent from first-principles study
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An exhaustive first-principles based density function theory investigation of lead adsorption on single layer graphene has been performed to figure out the graphene geometry with the highest adsorption capacity to adsorb lead pollution in auto exhaust pipe. Pristine graphene, divacancy defected graphene, and stone-wales defected graphene were simulated and analyzed in this study. The result shows divacancy defected graphene with defect concentration of 6.25% has the greatest adsorption energy per carbon atom, which is -0.4322 eV. A relative low adsorption height is found for the adsorption case as 1.49 A. Assuming the temperature in exhaust gas pipe as 500 °C, we calculated the Arrhenius rate constant to be 0.0090 as a measure of adsorption efficiency. The results could serve as a reliable reference for the filter element material design for lead pollution regulation. We have further explored the electronic structure of 2D graphene by plotting band structure and density of states diagrams. An increase of density of states from 0 is observed after the existence of divacancy defect on 2D graphene, implying the significant role of divacancy defect in improving graphene adsorption performance.

articleTitle: Design of step-down high-power high-voltage switching power supply based on microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: High-power DC high-voltage power supply is widely used in industry and military field. This paper presents a design scheme of high-power and high-voltage adjustable feedback DC power supply. The output voltage of TL494 can be adjusted from OV to 900V by using the double voltage rectification technology and the step-down chopper circuit, and by changing the internal integrated operational amplifier reference voltage of TL494. The output characteristics of this power supply are good and the voltage is stable and adjustable, the output ripple voltage is lower than 40 mV, the ripple coefficient is lower than 0.094%, the load adjustment rate is 4.26%. The model has the advantages of strong universality, wide adjustable output range and low cost.

articleTitle: The Problems and Countermeasures of Computer Network Information Security
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The development and progress of science and technology has accelerated the optimization and perfection of network technology, which has made network technology widely used. The daily life of modern people cannot do without computers, and the Internet has become an important channel for people to understand and communicate. At present, more and more people use the Internet, and more and more problems are exposed in computer network information security. In recent years, information security issues have become increasingly prominent, which has caused many people's private information to be leaked, resulting in many losses. This article analyzes in detail the natural threats and man-made threats facing the current computer network information security. On this basis, the author puts forward that in order to maintain and guarantee the security of computer network information, we should face up to the problem of computer network information security, and combine science and technology to actively improve the information security protection system. We should install a firewall on the computer as soon as possible, and attach importance to the application of information encryption and authentication technology. In addition, we should also apply digital watermarking technology. The author hopes that this article can provide references for related researchers.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved SIFT algorithm in GPR images
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Classical scale invariant feature transform (SIFT) and its corresponding improved algorithm are widely used in computer vision and remote sensing images. However, in the detection and matching task of GPR images, the final feature matching quality of traditional SIFT algorithm will be directly affected by the richness of underground information. This paper introduces a more robust method to adapt to GPR images. The method combines the classical SIFT and NCC, and finally selects the best matching pair by stable matching strategy, and extracts more correct matching points and improves the accuracy rate from GPR images with low pixel density and less feature information. The experimental results show that, compared with the classical SIFT algorithm and the conventional combination of RANSAC and sift algorithm, the proposed algorithm can obtain more correct matching point pairs, and can be effectively applied to the detection of underground environment changes by GPR tomography images.

articleTitle: A Travel Recommendation Method Based on User Personalized Characteristics with Collaborative Fusion Matrix
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standards, people's spiritual needs continue to increase, which makes personalized travel recommendation more and more popular. However, the complicated and overloaded information in the internet have caused troubles for people to choose travel scenic spots. Although collaborative filtering is widely used for recommendation algorithms, neither user-based nor item-based collaborative filtering take the users' personalized characteristics into account. In order to recommend better travel scenic spots to users, we propose a personalized collaborative fusion algorithm combining user-based original collaborative filtering matrix with users' personalized preference matrix to make the recommendation more accurate and attractive. We build our experiments on the data of Qunaer, the results show that our proposed algorithms can not only recommend similar users' travel scenic spots, but also consider users' own personalized characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on Sensor Fault Tolerance Control of Machining Center Based on MPC Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the sensor gain failure and deviation fault of the machining center, the paper suggests an active fault tolerance control method based on model predictive control (MPC). Firstly, the method senses the fault of the sensor with fault detection and diagnosis (FDD); and then the monitor decision-making unit would adjust the prediction model in each sampling time to adapt to the fault of a sensor according to the fault information to reach the fault tolerance. In the end, the VDL600A machining center is the example in the paper to carry out the active fault tolerance control simulation. The simulation result proves the effectiveness of the methods mentioned above. The method could handle the restriction when adjusting the fault to reduce the complication of a traditional controller.

articleTitle: Research on Test Data Compression Method Based on Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper designs an implementation of a transformation-based test data compression design. We uses Cellular Automata (CA) was used as a random matrix to split and transform the test set. This method decomposes the original test set into the main component set and the residual set. The main component set is composed of the most suitable part selected from the matrix composed of Cellular Automata. The residual set is obtained by decompressing the data passed in by the tester. When implementing a test, the test set is obtained through the exclusive XOR of the principal component set and the residual set, and is finally applied to the circuit under test. This method encodes and compresses the residual set, and the generation of the principal component set requires a little hardware cost. Compared with encoding and compressing the test set directly, this method can significantly increase the compression rate of encoding and compression, and the hardware overhead is also acceptable.

articleTitle: Summay of Gas Evolution Behaviours for Storage Battery: Gas evolution behaviours for storage battery
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of battery energy storage industry, the safety of Li-ion batteries has attracted more and more attention. How to diagnose the risk of Li-ion batteries is an urgent problem in large-scale application of battery energy storage. The authors wonder whether the gas can be as the effective characteristic quantity to achieve the diagnosis of the risk of Li-ion batteries. For this propose, the gas evolution behaviors of Li-ion batteries are reviewed in this manuscript. In the summary, the authors fully discuss the gas evolution behaviors of Li-ion batteries in the respects of the measurements from high precision instrument and of the anode, cathode, and electrolyte. Meanwhile, the authors compare the gas released under normal cycling with that released under abnormal operation. It has founded that it is indeed that the species and amounts of gas are different before and after the Li-ion batteries being destroyed. Furthermore, overcharge test is conducted to prove that gas can be as the effective characteristic quantity to diagnose the risk of Li-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Computer English Assisted Learning System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The development of society and the advancement of science and technology have made new technologies in the computer field emerge in an endless stream. For computer-related majors, in order to improve learning efficiency and master new technologies, it is necessary to improve the level of computer English. Therefore, we should combine information technology and English teaching to design a computer-assisted English learning system. In this system, the learner's interest increases and the learning effect is improved. This article discusses how to design each module of the computer-assisted English learning system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Genes Associated with Alzheimer's Disease Using Mutation Information
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease(AD) is the most common cause of dementia and is considered to be a global epidemic. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have been conducted in this area to find genetic loci associated with the susceptibility of AD. Previous studies have found 533 SNPs and 126 genes associated with AD. Based on AD-associated genes and SNPs, this study applied mutation information in finding important genes associated with Alzheimer's Disease, using two kinds of data about mutation, 3DSNP and RVIS. This work mapped genes with mutation information and used unsupervised learning algorithm to cluster genes for analysis. It is learned that using RVIS score and the total 3DSNP score of all SNPs results in the best information and found three different locations of interest where genes may have important meaning from the map of genes and clusters.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Beidou Device Integrated Communication System based on Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Beidou satellite navigation system has unique short message communication ability. However, Beidou short message has the characteristics of small bandwidth and large time delay. Based on Beidou Short Message System, this paper designs a Beidou device Integrated Communication System supporting Ad Hoc network, which can set up a network that can communicate with each other among multiple Beidou devices, and realize the short message communication between Beidou Short Message System and other non-Beidou communication systems. In order to improve the efficiency of Beidou short message communication, the system also uses the piggybacking technology to improve the load capacity of Beidou short message, so as to improve the operating efficiency of the whole system. The system designed in this paper has a very prominent role in improving the application of Beidou short message system in the industry.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Reconstruction of Working Environment in Remote Control Excavator
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Remote control excavator solves the personal safety problem of operators in dangerous conditions, but the video surveillance of remote control excavators can't sense the stereo distance of the target. To solve the problem, the binocular vision method is used to reconstruct the 3D operating scene of the excavator, and help the drivers to effectively sense the spatial position of the target and bucket to improve the efficiency of remote control operation. Firstly, the noise generated by binocular camera during data collection was removed by guided filtering. And then, left and right images were matched by features based on Sum of Absolute Differences (SAD). Then, the generated disparity value was optimized according to the Winner Takes All(WTA) strategy. Finally, the disparity map of the working scene was obtained and the 3D reconstruction of the scene was completed. The experimental results show that the binocular 3D reconstruction system used in this paper can realize the 3D reconstruction of different scenes indoors and outdoors through the cooperation of software and hardware.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Mechanism of UGC Community Based on Blockchain — Take Steemit for Example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of the mobile Internet, the UGC (User Generated Content) community has played a very important role in people's daily lives. While the traditional UGC community stores content and information centrally, user data has security risks. In addition, it lacks an effective incentive mechanism, and the user viscosity is not very high. The use of blockchain technology can not only ensure the security of users' data, but the incentive mechanism contained therein can also well empower existing communities. This paper takes the blockchain-based community Steemit as an example, and focuses on the incentive mechanism. Moreover, we propose some improvement suggestions for the shortcomings in Steemit. We hope the UGC community based on blockchain can develop better in the future.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of avionics system based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Prognostics and health management can be used for monitoring and life prediction of integrated modular avionics systems. As one of the methods of prognostics and health management, the BP neural network has good self-learning, self-adaptation and generalization capabilities, but it is easy to fall into a local minimum during the operation. Therefore, this paper chooses to use genetic algorithm to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network training, which can greatly improve the accuracy of the BP neural network for fault diagnosis; at the same time, choose to use unsupervised learning self-organizing feature map for fault diagnosis. The simulation results show that the fault diagnosis accuracy rate of the BP neural network optimized by the genetic algorithm is greatly improved, and self-organizing feature map can reach a higher fault sample classification accuracy rate after 200 training.

articleTitle: Detecting DNS Tunnel Based on Multidimensional Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: DNS (Domain Name System) is an important basic application of the Internet. The network management strategy has less restrictions on DNS protocol, which makes DNS become one of the means for attackers to establish covert channel for malicious activities. Taking the DNS tunnel as research object, through multidimensional analysis, this paper mined the characteristics of DNS tunnel in domain name, packet and traffic dimension, and proposed a DNS tunnel identification method which combined machine learning classification and anomaly detection. The experiments proved that this method has high accuracy and low false rate and it can effectively detect DNS tunnels.

articleTitle: Modulation Recognition based on Incremental Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Incremental learning has emerged to solve the problem of incrementally updating the classification model as the number of data classes grows. There are many challenges in incremental learning such as catastrophic forgetting and learning efficiency. In this paper, we present a method of the modulation recognition based on incremental learning, that allows learning continuously with a class-incremental way. The new classes can be added into the existing model progressively from a sequential data stream. We conduct experiments on the modulation signal dataset characterized by the constellation diagram, the experimental results prove the feasibility of our incremental learning system. Our method performs similarly in classification accuracy compared to common multi-task joint training, but performs better in training efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on AGV Scheduling Based on Point-to-Point Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of AGV routing optimization in intelligent workshops, in this paper, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to optimize AGV walking path. The smoothness function is added to the fitness function of traditional genetic algorithm, the improved genetic algorithm not only requires the shortest path, but also can control the turning angle of AGV, The walking path of AGV is smoother, safer and more efficient while ensuring the good global searching ability and robustness of genetic algorithm itself. Experimental results show that, compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the proposed algorithm not only has a shorter walking path, but also has a smoother path. The feasibility of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Analytical Investigation of Vibration Characteristic about Spinning Cantilever Beam
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Spinning structure is one of important types of classical gyroscopic continua, and many interesting phenomena of the gyroscopic continua have been found due to the gyroscopic effect. In this paper, the vibration characteristic analysis of the spinning cantilever beam is studied. The two linear partial differential equations governing two transverse vibrations are derived by the extended Hamilton principle. The ordinary differential dynamic equations are obtained by using the modal expansion of Galerkin method. The natural frequencies, complex modes, and stability of the spinning cantilever beam are investigated by solving the standard eigenvalue problems of the linearized system directly. Some novel interesting phenomena have been obtained numerically and important conclusions have been drawn for this special spinning system.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Trajectory Control of Tire Bursting Vehicles Based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the yaw problem of a flat tire vehicle, a front wheel steering controller based on MPC is proposed to correct the vehicle's yaw and ensure that the vehicle runs on the safe path. Based on the model predictive control, the simplified double track vehicle model is selected, and the vehicle motion state is described by differential equation. The prediction equation is derived by linear discretization. Considering the vehicle stability factor, it is added as a constraint condition and transformed into the standard quadratic form to calculate the optimal solution. The closed-loop system is constructed for simulation. The results show that: the front wheel active steering controller based on MPC can keep the vehicle running stably and effectively control the running track of the flat tire vehicle. The sideslip angle of the center of mass, the sideslip angle of the tire and the yaw rate are all within the stability requirements, so that the vehicle can drive in the safe path and achieve the trajectory control effect of the tire burst vehicle.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Object Detection using Global Attention and Support Attention
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: General object detection methods in computer vision task typically require a lot of bounding box labeled data. In addition, after training on the training data of the specified category, only the existing categories in the training can be detected. In order to detect the new category, sufficient training data of the new category must be collected and the new category can only be detected after the network is trained again. In this paper, we design a few-shot object detection network, aiming to achieve object detection against unseen categories by using a small number of annotated sample data as support sets. Our network is based on Faster R-CNN, and using a Fixed-size Global Attention module on the features generated by the backbone so that the whole network has different attention weights for different positions of the image. A Support-Set Attention module is proposed which enables the network to focus the detection target on the categories provided by the support set. Finally, the relation detection module uses the similarity between the few-shot support set and the query set to give the matching score and the location regression. After training on the base class, our network can be directly used on N-way K-shot detection without fine-tuning. In our experiments, our network achieved equal or better results than others.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Analysis Technology of Power Monitoring Video Data Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid increase of on-site monitoring objects and technological development, the power on-site image monitoring data has increased geometrically. For security managers, it is necessary to efficiently and quickly identify valid data and conduct intelligent early warning. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent analysis method of power field surveillance video data based on convolutional neural network. Firstly, the original surveillance video material is extracted. Secondly, the video cloud storage platform is used for storage and data cleaning. At the same time, the hidden danger behaviors are classified and analyzed and marked. Finally, the proposed method is used for feature extraction, model training and field verification to realize intelligent early warning analysis of video big data. The field application effect shows that the method proposed in this paper can realize the functions of video image data feature extraction, model training, and improve the effect of image processing. Eventually, it can meet the needs of on-site video data intelligent analysis and has a certain promotion prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Pose Facial Feature Recognition Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A multi pose facial feature recognition method based on deep learning is proposed. Firstly, the face direction is determined by eyes and mouth combined with face features, and then the face is segmented according to the face direction to get the approximate forward candidate region of the face, which is then verified by the layered structure depth learning algorithm. Multi pose face detection algorithm based on face feature and deep learning algorithm. Most of the background regions are eliminated quickly by using skin color features, and the candidate regions are segmented according to the face direction determined by face geometry features, and the candidate regions are classified by using depth learning algorithm. The candidate regions are classified by deep learning algorithm, and the multi pose facial features are accurately recognized. This method can avoid the problem of increasing the complexity of the algorithm, such as multi pose face extended feature or pose detector, so as to improve the search speed and accuracy. The experimental results show that the multi pose facial feature recognition method based on deep learning can detect the multi pose face quickly and has good robustness to expression and occlusion.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis and Numerical Simulation of GFRP Specimens' Defects Detection Using Infrared Thermal Wave Testing Technology Based on Linear Frequency Modulation Excitation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation of GFRP specimens' defects detection using infrared thermal wave testing technology based on linear frequency modulation excitation was carried out in this paper. Based on the theory of heat transfer and material science, the heat transfer model of GFRP specimen was established and analyzed, and the heat transfer process excited by linear frequency modulation excitation heat flow was numerically simulated. Through three-dimensional modeling and finite element analysis, the detection effect of different size defects under experimental conditions was analyzed. By calculating the temperature difference and contrast curve, the influence law of the defect diameter depth ratio on the detection effect was obtained, which can provide a certain reference for the detection test research.

articleTitle: Analysis of Computer Network Security Technology and Preventive Measures under the Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper first summarizes what informatization is, and then analyzes the service of informatization computer network security management system in detail. Then, it analyzes the specific application and problems of informatization in computer network security management system, including hash function to protect network information transmission security, symmetric encryption strategy to protect computer network information security and establishment of computer network security protection system in information environment. Finally, it expounds the relevant countermeasures to solve the network security threats under the information environment, including comprehensively strengthening the computer network security management under the information environment, establishing and perfecting the computer network security protection system under the information environment, and strengthening the research on the black and evil prevention mechanism under the information environment to protect the computer network information security. In this paper, under the background of informationization, people pay more attention to the security technology of computer network and related preventive measures.

articleTitle: Wideband digital fractional time delay waveform generation method based on polynomial fitting
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Beamforming of wideband signals requires time delay, while traditional time delay methods are complicated and consume a lot of hardware resources. In this letter, a digital beamforming method that can be applied to any wideband signal is proposed. Taking the NLFM signal as an example, this letter studies the generation of digital fractional time delay waveform: the time delay is divided into integer time delay and fractional time delay, and then the fitted exponential polynomial is used to express the time domain phase function of the wideband NLFM signal, and finally fractional delay waveforms can be generated in DDS directly by extracting the parameters. The simulation experiment shows that each array unit produces a wideband time delay beam, the transmitting beam is pointed correctly, the method is easy to calculate and the hardware requirement is not high. It can be applied to any signals whose time domain phase function can be explicitly expressed.

articleTitle: Construction of Network Scene Generation System Based on OpenStack
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low utilization rate of physical resources and low efficiency of building scenes in traditional network scenes, this paper constructs a network scene generation system based on the advantages of OpenStack, an open source cloud platform, such as the flexibility of dynamically allocating resources, the unity of management, the low cost of maintenance and the open source, which provides a comprehensive simulation environment for network simulation, network attack and defense drills, and protection technology research.

articleTitle: Introduction to Japanese elevator Laws and standards
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The number of elevators in use in Japan is close to 900,000. Compared with our country, Japan has no laws specifically for elevators. This article introduces the laws and regulations at various levels in Japan, such as the Building Standard Law, the Building Standard Law Enforcement Order, the Building Standard Law Implementation Rules, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Building Safety Regulations, as well as government agencies and technologies in charge of elevators. This article provides a reference for the development of China's elevator industry.

articleTitle: Course on e-commerce in the context of Internet Strategies for Ideological and Political Implementation and Safeguard Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development and progress of social science and technology, people have entered the era of “Internet” science and technology, and the e-commerce industry has gradually entered the stage of social exchange and common development, which is no longer a simple field of e-commerce. E-commerce platform in order to obtain more customer visits and increase turnover, it will collect as many different kinds of information as possible, and the authenticity and accuracy of this information are difficult to distinguish. This paper will combine the development of e-commerce curriculum with the development of ideological and political education, the socialist ideological and moral construction, professional ethics and so on into the e-commerce professional curriculum teaching, fundamentally solve the shortcomings of contemporary college students in ideological learning and improve the moral protection of e-commerce in the use of the Internet.

Author Keywords: ideological and political implementation strategies and guarantees

articleTitle: Analysis of environmental factors of human resource management process model from the perspective of Computer Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Human resource management and competition are becoming more and more important in the development of enterprises. From the perspective of control and computer, this paper analyzes the elements of enterprise survival environment in the process model of human resource management. On the basis of systematic analysis, this paper creatively uses SWOT analysis algorithm to analyze the impact of corresponding environmental factors on human resource management mode, and formulates a complete set of human resource development strategy. At the same time, in view of the problems existing in the human resource model from the perspective of control and computer, this paper puts forward specific implementation rules and strategies, and theoretically verifies the effectiveness and reliability of the corresponding rules.

articleTitle: Using Multiscale Structural Fusion for Sonar Image Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Sonar imaging has broad and critical applications in marine technologies since it is able to solve the problem that the optical system cannot operate effectively in turbid water. During the process of underwater acoustic channel transmission, sonar images are easy to degrade and thus seriously influence the resultant feature extraction and target recognition. To that end, we devise a new SOnar Image Quality Evaluation (SOIQE) method in this paper for better monitoring and guaranteeing the visual quality of sonar images. Guided by highlighting the important task objects, our proposed SOIQE method makes a pixel-wise fusion of structures extracted at multiple scales. Experimental results on the newly established sonar image quality database show that our SOIQE approach is superior to the state-of-the-art image quality models in terms of implement efficiency and evaluation performance.

articleTitle: Human behavior recognition method based on second order motion description operator
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Human behavior trajectory is often submerged in complex background, and it is easy to be disturbed. The traditional dense trajectory behavior recognition method has high track redundancy, so it has a large amount of calculation. A human behavior recognition method based on foreground trajectory and motion differential descriptor is proposed. Firstly, optical flow method is used to estimate the amplitude of moving object in each frame, and then the foreground region is found. Only the foreground region related to behavior is extracted. In order to better describe the relative time information between different behaviors, a motion difference descriptor is introduced to describe the foreground trajectory. By calculating the direction information of the unit time motion difference of the trajectory points, the motion difference direction histogram is constructed. Then, the histogram features are encoded by Fv (Fisher vector) to form feature vectors. Finally, the behavior is classified by support vector machine (SVM). The experimental results on the benchmark data set show that the proposed method can extract human motion trajectory better, and can improve the recognition accuracy compared with the traditional methods.
