articleTitle: Research on Video Segmentation Method Based on Function Iteration
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a product of the development of multimedia technology, video images are becoming more and more accessible to people. Recognizing, understanding and retrieving these video data has gradually become an urgent need. Video segmentation is an important step in video data processing. In this paper, discrete cosine transform (DCT) basis functions are used as auxiliary functions to construct a dynamic system with gray-scale image sequences, and approximate attractors are iteratively obtained. These attractors can be used to distinguish different scenes of video images. Multiple DCT basis function matrices are combined with an image to construct a dynamic system, which can generate multiple approximate attractors, and these attractors can be used as image features. These attractors are subjected to two-dimensional Fourier transform to obtain the transformed matrix, and the correlation coefficients between the matrices are calculated and compared to determine the similarity of the image scene to achieve the purpose of video segmentation. Experiments have verified that this method can effectively segment video clips with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Chinese agricultural diseases named entity recognition based on BERT-CRF
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Named entity recognition work has achieved good results in some fields with rich corpus, but in the field of Chinese agricultural disease texts, named entity recognition work has not made much progress. In response to the problems faced by entity naming recognition in the agricultural field, we marked the text of agricultural diseases and selected the BERT-CRF model to achieve good results.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Computer Animation Technology in Micro-lecture
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the important role of applying computer animation technology in micro-lecture, then summarizes the matters needing attention in applying computer animation technology in micro-lecture, and finally explores the ways of applying computer animation technology in micro-lecture, so as to provide reference for related people.

articleTitle: Chinese Event Detection Combining BERT Model with Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and the scale of the Internet, it is particularly important to extract useful information from the increasing amount of information on the Internet. Among them, event extraction is one of the research hotspots in the field of natural language processing and an important research direction in the field of information extraction. Event detection is the first step of the event extraction task, which plays a decisive role in the subsequent event extraction work. The article adopts BERT for word vector training, joint lexical vector, named entity vector, and semantic dependency vector as the input of Bi-LSTM, and then input them into the CRF sequence tagging layer after acquiring the features of sentences to achieve the recognition of event trigger words and the classification of event categories. The CEC corpus is selected as the training and test set, and experiments show that the method is effective in event detection, with F-values up to more than 70%.

articleTitle: Application and research of artificial intelligence in mechatronic engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the 21st century, science, technology and humanity are developing rapidly, artificial intelligence as the darling of the era has been recognized and favored by the public. The wide application of artificial intelligence is in line with the needs of modern development and it is applied more and more widely in People's daily life, bringing people a lot of convenience. At present, the field of mechatronic engineering is integrating with artificial intelligence to seek more efficient development. The technological innovation and times change brought by artificial intelligence can help mechanical and electronic engineering to realize leapfrog progress and continuously improve the competitiveness of the industry. This paper will discuss the application and research of artificial intelligence in the field of mechatronic engineering.

articleTitle: Innovation and Development of Pedagogy in the Age of Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Now the society and science and technology continue to develop, “Internet”has now entered the world, people will use it in their daily life,“Internet” era has been closely linked with people's lives. Nowadays, the Internet has been widely used, not only in enterprises, but also in the field of education. The arrival of the Internet has changed people's way of life, changed the teaching mode and improved the teaching quality. The teaching mode in the era of “Internet” breaks some drawbacks in the traditional teaching mode and solves some problems and shortcomings in the past teaching. Now students, through the computer network, preview homework in advance, enrich their own cultural knowledge. Now it has gradually formed the “Internet” education model, improved the overall level of education, can promote the innovation of pedagogy. This paper analyzes the innovative practice of pedagogy in the era of Internet, and expounds the development trend of pedagogy in the future under the situation of combining with Internet.

articleTitle: Research on Internet Ideological and Political Education in Colleges and Universities under the Interpersonal Interaction of Internet New Media
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since contemporary information-retrieval systems rely heavily on the content of titles and abstracts to identify relevant articles in literature searches, great care should be taken in constructing both. Now is the era of new media, and many new online media play their roles in the field of communication. These media include video or text from the media, various social networks, e-books and publications. Various emerging media on the Internet have expanded various channels in the process of disseminating information, and the amount of information carried is also beyond the reach of traditional media. The new online media uses a variety of exciting audiovisual media to help everyone expand their horizons. In teaching, colleges and universities are also paying more and more attention to the use of new media for interpersonal teaching between teachers and students. Among them, it is a new type of teaching attempt for colleges and universities to combine new media with online ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Modal Analysis of Bogie Landing Gear Based on Hypermesh and Nastron
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The vibration of the main landing gear is principally generated during the aircraft landing process, which not only affects the safety of aircraft, but also causes the wear and tear on components, thereby affecting the reliability of the landing gear system. The vibration is induced by various factors, related to the natural frequency range of landing gear structure in the root. Hence modal analysis is of the first importance to investigate the vibration and suppression of the landing gear. In this paper, six-wheel bogie landing gear is under research by establishing finite element model in modal analysis through the use of Hypermesh, and obtaining its first six natural frequencies and mode shapes based on Nastron solver. Conclusions drawn by comparative analysis on the first-order modal frequency under different influencing factors can be helpful for the follow-up research on the anti-skid induced vibration and suppression of multi-wheel bogie landing gear.

articleTitle: Eye Diagram Analysis Based on System View -Taking PCM System as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The eye diagram is an important way to evaluate the quality of signal transmission. In order to have a better analysis of the eye diagram, this paper analyzed the eye diagram based on System View, taking the PCM system as an example. This article mainly introduced the method of obtaining the eye diagram on System View, as well as the index parameters. Finally, this paper analyzed the influence of noise on the eye diagram waveform. This paper highlights the various applications of System View and verifies the importance of eye diagrams for the signal transmission system.

articleTitle: Self-Organizing-Map-based Knowledge Fusion Method for Heterogeneous Ontologies in Power Grid Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Knowledge fusion is one of the fundamental factors of the knowledge graph technology. However in the recent big data applications with the multi-dimension and heterogeneous data structures, traditional machine learning (ML) based approaches adopted to the knowledge fusions may show limited accuracy and instantaneity. Hence, the paper proposes a self-organizing map (SOM) based on low complexity and unsupervised knowledge fusion method for ontology mapping in the heterogeneous data environment. The method targets providing efficient knowledge correlations meanwhile achieving a certain real-time requirement. It has been tested in the knowledge graph system developed by state grid Anhui electric power research institute (China). The efficiency and practicability of the proposed method is proved by comparing the performance with the traditional unsupervised ML algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Reform of Teaching Mode of Computer Animation Production in Colleges and Universities Based on Flip Classroom
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of Internet technology, the teaching of computer animation in colleges and universities is also facing new opportunities and challenges. As a new teaching mode, flip classroom has been widely used in domestic universities, which plays an important role in improving classroom teaching efficiency. Compared with traditional classroom, flip classroom can effectively improve students' learning efficiency in computer animation production. Based on this, this paper first briefly introduces the characteristics of flip classroom, then analyzes the problems existing in animation teaching mode at present, and then analyzes the reform measures of computer animation teaching mode under flip classroom mode from five aspects, so as to provide a reference for relevant people to exchange.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Management Development of Tourism Industry under the Background of "Internet+"
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the development status of the tourism industry under the background of "Internet +" and combining the problems of tourism industry integration management, this article proposes to strengthen the construction of smart systems, improve the network tourism management system, do a good job in the cultivation of compound tourism talents, and optimize the market through research. This paper mainly discusses the investment mechanism system, broadening marketing and operation methods and other solutions. The author's purpose is to improve the application effect of "Internet + Tourism" and promote the rapid development of local tourism industry economy.

articleTitle: Binary software vulnerability detection method based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the stack overflow vulnerability in binary software, this paper proposes a binary vulnerability detection method based on the attention mechanism. First, this paper analyze the basic characteristics of stack overflow vulnerabilities, and perform data preprocessing on the decompiled files to make the neural network better adapt to the characteristics of stack overflow vulnerabilities, then formulate instruction specifications at the assembly language level, and finally input the data into the fusion attention mechanism Learning in the neural network. This paper compares and analyzes three kinds of neural networks on the CWE121 data set. The experimental results show that after neural network training, the detection method based on the attention mechanism can be effective and accurately discover whether the target area has stack overflow vulnerabilities, thereby greatly improving the detection efficiency.

articleTitle: A Long read hybrid error correction algorithm based on segmented pHMM
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Although the second-generation DNA sequencing technology has high throughput and high accuracy, it can't cross the repeat region when the data volume is large due to its read length, which makes the analysis difficult. The third generation DNA sequencing technology can produce longer sequences, although it can make up for some of the weakness of the second generation sequencing, with the increase of sequence length, the error rate also increases. In this case, researchers usually combine the two methods, using short reads to correct long reads, so as to improve the accuracy of the sequence without losing the length of the sequence as much as possible. This paper proposes an error correction algorithm based on piecewise profile Hidden Markov Model (pHMM), which does not deal with the matching part, and uses HMM to correct the unmatched part or the part with more noise. The experiment results on E.coli and Yeast data sets show that the running time is reduced about 3 times compared with the Hercules algorithm.

articleTitle: A new Surface roughness measurement method based on image mosaic of template matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A surface roughness measurement method is proposed to address the current problems: The field of view limit cannot objectively characterize the surface quality of the part, and calculations are complex. A matching template is constructed by overlapping regions, similarity measures are calculated to achieve image matching and splicing, and the double of spliced images is smoothed by a weighted fusion algorithm. The Foreman algorithm is applied to extract the one-sided edge features of the surface roughness, and the least square method is used to fit the contour center line. Finally, the arithmetic mean deviation and the maximum height evaluation model of the roughness are established. The experimental results indicate that the contour length of the splicing of two adjacent frames are increases by 400μm on average. The measurement accuracy is improved by 1.16%.

articleTitle: Research on semantic Retrieval Framework Design based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology, network education has also received more and more attention, the application of teaching platform is more and more common. This teaching method has obvious advantages over the traditional teaching method. People can arrange their study time freely and gain more knowledge in their limited time. All such advantages of the network teaching platform are closely related to the teaching resource database module in the teaching platform. However, there are still some problems in the construction of teaching resource bank: Users have low efficiency in retrieving resources of the resource database and cannot quickly obtain the resources they need. Different teaching platforms have their own teaching resource pools, but these resource pools cannot be reused, which results in the repeated development of the resource pools. These two aspects of the problem, also gradually become a hindrance to the further development of the network teaching platform. This paper mainly studies Chinese word segmentation and constructs a more general resource management module. Finally, a semantic retrieval framework based on ontology is designed.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Online Learning System Based on Electroencephalogram Emotion Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The lack of emotion is the bottleneck to improve the efficiency of online learning. In this paper, an online learning system based on EEG emotion computing is developed by using Python and PHP mixed programming method. The original EEG data are collected by Emotive EPOC, PSD is extracted as EEG features, and SVM classifier is used to classify emotional states. The system can analyze the emotional state of online learners in real time and accurately. It has the characteristics of humanized interface and modular algorithm. It can enhance the emotional interaction in online learning environment, and has reference significance for the development of educational application based on BCI.

articleTitle: Research on omnidirectional movement and environment detection function of inspection robot
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, the big data industry is developing rapidly; the computer room of the data center has become an important part of all companies. In order to ensure a safe and stable operating environment for the equipment, it is necessary to inspect the computer room. The traditional manual inspection method has the disadvantages of low efficiency, poor quality, high cost and power consumption. In this paper, a kind of inspection robot is proposed, which can replace human to complete inspection task, so as to reduce cost and improve the reliability of inspection work. The robot chassis has omnidirectional movement feature in structure. In functionally, the robot adopts temperature humidity sensors DHT11, gas pressure sensor BMP180 and smoke sensor MQ-2 to inspection computer room environment. Furthermore, kinematics analysis and MATLAB simulation were carried out on the omnidirectional mobile chassis of the robot; the environmental detection function of the robot was tested by experiment. The results show that the robot can realize omnidirectional mobile and environment detection function.

articleTitle: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient Algorithm based Lateral and Longitudinal Control for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The traditional static path planning algorithm for automatic driving has the problems of insufficient robustness and unstable body control under complex road conditions. It can make full use of the reinforcement learning related technology to carry out vehicle decision-making and control, plan the dynamic obstacle avoidance route and enhance the driving safety. In this paper, a vehicle control algorithm is designed on the TORCS (The Open Racing Car Simulator) simulation platform combined with DDPG (Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient) algorithm. Combined with actor critic algorithm, experience playback and independent target network are added to improve the effect of deep reinforcement learning, with better robustness. And by designing a reasonable reward function, the car can be more stable in the driving process. In the simulation experiment, the algorithm is verified. The experimental results show that the algorithm designed in this paper can make the simulation car get more stable and effective learning in less training time, that is, the research idea of this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Analytical Compliance model for Flexure Hinge Considering Creep
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper deals with a study to determine a compliance model of flexure hinge considering creep subjected to pure applied moment. The work can be considered an extension of previous investigations on typical notched flexure hinge. Analytical equations are derived using Castigliano's second theorem and creep power-law that the creep constitutive equation and parameters is obtained from the standard uniaxial tensile creep experiments. The compliance considering creep is simulated using the finite element (FE) method and results show a maximum error of 1.27% between the theoretical value and simulation result, thus verifying the accuracy of our analytical compliance model. The proposed compliance model is able to predict the creep behaviour of the flexure hinge using on flexure mechanism under the space high temperature environment.

articleTitle: DC Side Voltage Control for Static Var Generator Based on DMC
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Static Var Generator (SVG) is an advanced equipment used to manage grid reactive power and low-order harmonics. Considering the influence of the DC side voltage on its performance and power consumption, the DC side voltage control problem of SVG is discussed, the voltage loop system model is given, and the DC side control method is discussed with the help of the dynamic matrix control (DMC) algorithm. The genetic algorithm of elite strategy puts forward the idea of optimization of time domain parameters of dynamic matrix control. The simulation results show that the time-domain parameter optimization method based on genetic algorithm is feasible. Compared with the traditional Proportional Integral (PI) control algorithm, the optimized dynamic matrix control algorithm has better control effect and can be used for DC side voltage control of SVG.

articleTitle: A FPGA-based accelerator implementaion for YOLOv2 object detection using Winograd algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used in many computer vision applications and the computational complexity of CNN has increased greatly. Since CPUs can hardly provide the massive parallelism required by CNNs, many hardware accelerators, such as GPU, FPGA, and ASIC, have been developed to improve the performance of CNNs. Of these designs, FPGA-based accelerators have become a special option due to their advantages of high flexibility, low power consumption and extensive DSP resources. In this paper, an OpenCL-based CNN accelerator is designed for FPGA and a variety of model compression techniques are applied to the YOLOv2 model. The accelerator uses the Winograd algorithm to implement convolution efficiently and reduce the number of multiplications by 38% to 60% for YOLOv2 model, also this design makes full use of the available memory access bandwidth and DSP resources. We evaluate our design on an Inspur F10A board with an Intel Arria 10 GX1150 and 16 GB DDR3 memory. Experimental results on YOLOv2 network show a 1.2x~1.9x speedup compared with im2col convolution algorithms and the performance of our FPGA design can reach 10ms per image in terms of latency, compared to 16ms per image with Nvidia Tesla V100 GPU.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Computer Network Security and Remote Control Technology Application
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As China gradually enters the age of network information, technologies such as the Internet of Things based on computer networks have been more and more widely used, and they have also greatly improved the convenience of people's production and life. The development and promotion of the Internet of Things not only need to further strengthen the application of remote control technology, but also put forward higher requirements for network security. The Internet of Things must reduce the security risks in the computer network based on the realization of remote automatic control, so as to ensure the safety of data and information and ensure the normal operation of the Internet of Things. This can ensure that the Internet of Things can give full play to its due functions, thereby promoting the modern development of my country's social economy.

articleTitle: An Optimized Interpolation Model Based on K–means Clustering for Rainfall Calculation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Rainfall is closely related to soil erosion monitoring. In geography, we collect rainfall data through precipitation stations, and then use interpolation algorithm to calculate the rainfall of a local area or a certain location. Based on the data from precipitation stations of Wuhan province, this paper proposes a data processing model based on the combination of K-means clustering algorithm and interpolation algorithm. Compared with the method only using interpolation calculation, the calculation error of the model with clustering algorithm is lower than that without clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: A Model Query Language for Domain-Specific Models
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Model queries play a crucial role in the Model-driven development processes, particularly for Domain-Specific Modeling (DSM) and Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE). The model queries are also regarded as the cornerstone for model-driven development activities, such as code generation, model transformation, and model constraints checking. The GOPPRR metamodeling approach is widely used to formalize the domain-specific models. Based on this approach, the KARMA language has been proposed to formalize models, metamodels, and code generation but lacks support for the model querying. This paper proposed one query language based on the GOPPRR metamodeling approach extended from the KARMA language to realize the unified query formalisms for multi-domain models. Finally, a case in a vehicle tracking system development is used to verify the availability of model query language, which is implemented in a domain modeling tool, MetaGraph. Keywords-Domain-Specific Language; model query language; model-driven development; Model-based Systems Engineering.

articleTitle: Working condition recognition of grate cooler based on an improved K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The working condition control of grate cooler always affects the efficiency of the whole cement process. In order to solve the working condition of grate cooler too parameter dimension and strong coupling problem, and according to the actual production of collecting the data of grate cooler used principal component analysis combined with an improved k-means clustering algorithm, is used to identify the conditions of grate cooler, working condition of the formation of grate cooler model, through the calculation speed and stability analysis is made of the advantages of the new algorithm, the accuracy as an important parameter of working condition of the grate cooler model verified, it provides the model basis for the subsequent grate cooler automatic control.

articleTitle: Security and Improvement of Aggregate Signature Scheme for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks and Certificateless Aggregate Signature Scheme for Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Due to the limited energy of underwater wireless sensor network (UwWSN) and the need to protect node location privacy, aggregate signature (AGGS) scheme which can batch verification signature is proposed to meet these requirements. Due to moving at high speed and the limited bandwidth of communication in vehicular ad hoc network (VaNET), certificateless aggregate signature (CTLAS) with the private key being generated by the signer itself and PKG (Private Key Generator) is proposed to solve the above problems. Recently, Yang et al. proposes a CTLAS scheme which can be applied into VaNET and Hua proposes an AGGS scheme which can be applied into UwWSN. This paper shows that Yang et al.'s CTLAS scheme and Hua's AGGS scheme both are not secure. In Yang et al.'s CTLAS scheme, an attacker can forge a signature assume that the attacker cannot know the masker key of PKG but the attacker can replace the public key of the signer. In Hua's AGGS scheme, a malicious node can forge a signature for any nodes after the malicious node obtains a temporary key. As an improvement, this paper also proposes an improved method for Yang et al.'s scheme and Hua's scheme respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Pedestrian Attitude Detection Algorithm from the Perspective of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the rapid development of science and technology today, the intelligence of the visual system has been highly valued. The recognition and detection of pedestrian attitudes in a complex environment have become the application trend of intelligent video. The widely used of camera machine does not have such a function. Therefore, this article deeply discusses the relevant algorithms of pedestrian gesture detection and recognition based on machine learning. The traditional HOG feature detection can only achieve the relevant detection of the upright walking crowd target. While when the pedestrian makes different gestures, its detection effect is directly affected and challenging to be recognized. So, this article uses the checking methods of the deformable part model (DPM) to check the target pedestrian gesture and elaborate pedestrian's attitude estimation algorithm for the deformable parts principle. Finally, it combines the algorithm with HOG+SVM principles to simulate with the MATLAB and gets the experimental results to show that this approach can make a pedestrian posture test implemented to achieve high precision accuracy.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation Research on the Evaluation of Star Point Positioning Accuracy of Star Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The star point positioning accuracy of the star sensor is an important indicator for evaluating the measurement accuracy of the star sensor. However, the star point positioning accuracy index cannot be directly measured by laboratory or outside experiments. In this paper, a method for indirect evaluation of star positioning accuracy of star sensors is proposed. Firstly, the definition of the star diagonal distance of the star sensor is given, and the imaging model of the star sensor is established. On this basis, the formula for transmitting the position error of star point is derived. A large number of simulation calculations are carried out by computer simulation method, and the quantitative relationship between standard deviation of Star diagonal distance and that of star position is obtained. The results show that under the condition of high-precision calibration of the focal length, there is a linear relationship between the standard deviation of star diagonal distance and that of star point position, and the standard deviation of star diagonal distance is about 1.42 times that of star point position. Therefore, star diagonal distance error of the star sensor can be measured and calculated through laboratory or outside experiments, and then star position error can be calculated with the method in this paper, so as to realize the evaluation of star positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Fusion Technology on the Condition of Information Deficiency Based on Improved IOWA-D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of information fusion in deficient data condition on airborne platform, we propose a fusion technology based on improved IOWA operator and D-S evidence theory in this paper. Firstly, aiming at the incomplete information of the enemy's radiator that is likely to occur in actual situation, we propose that predicting deficient data by introducing IOWA operator and form a complete information system. Then, to fuse the information system by making use of the improved D-S evidence theory. Simulation experiment results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper is much more effective in fusing information.

articleTitle: Research on UWB positioning method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper studies UWB signal localization based on deep learning. The experimental environment in this article is a laboratory on the fourth floor of the experimental building. In this paper, a neural network structure of self-encoder preprocessing is designed to solve the problems of missing data and low positioning accuracy caused by multipath effect in indoor positioning. It is verified in the deployed experimental environment that the performance of the neural network proposed in this article is better than the other two common neural networks.

articleTitle: Design of Cooling Water Temperature Control System for Microwave Plasma Chemical Vapor Deposition Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to realize the automatic regulation of cooling water temperature during the preparation of diamond film by microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition (MPCVD) equipment, a cooling water temperature control system based on STM32F103 was designed. With STM32F103 as the main control chip and stepper motor as the executive mechanism, the system has designed the flow signal acquisition circuit, 485 communication circuit, stepper motor drive circuit and other hardware circuits, and adopted the fuzzy PID control algorithm to solve the nonlinear and hysteresis problems in cooling water temperature control. The results show that the system can realize the automatic regulation of cooling water temperature during the operation of MPCVD equipment, with small overshoot, fast response speed and good temperature control effect.

articleTitle: Research on New Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS)-Geometrical Tolerancing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper first introduces the development process of GPS at home and abroad, the impact on manufacturing informatization and the status and role of GPS in the world. Then we compare the national standard GB / T1182 " Geometrical product specifications (GPS)-Geometrical tolerancing - Tolerances of form, orientation, location and runout " issued in 2008 and 2018, and analyze the changes of their main technical contents. Through two-dimensional and three-dimensional annotation examples, the meanings and marking methods of four auxiliary frames and offset tolerance zones in the new generation of GPS standards are analyzed, which will play a positive role in further strengthening the publicity and implementation of GPS standards.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis and fault diagnosis of coupling misalignment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Rolling machine is an important mechanical equipment in the building materials industry. Its universal joints are prone to failures, and timely fault judgments are made to predict the occurrence of failures and perform effective maintenance, which is of great significance to the safety of enterprises. Among them, the universal joint coupling often occurs due to unbalanced transmission shaft, loose bolts, loose transmission shaft, and cross shaft damage. Rolling machine failures usually cause abnormal vibrations. By measuring the vibration response and extracting effective features, the operating status and deterioration trend of the equipment can be predicted in time, the problem take can be solved in time before failure to prevent greater losses. This paper studies the monitoring, diagnosis and analysis methods for the alignment faults of the universal joint of the roller press, analyzes the causes, mechanisms and phenomena of the alignment faults of the roller press, studies the extraction methods of the fault features, analyzes the fault diagnosis model and failure trend prediction method, and built a monitoring system for experimental verification. Experiments show that the designed data acquisition method can capture the vibration signal in time, and the analysis model can also analyze and identify the fault type based on the existing fault knowledge and rules.

articleTitle: Research on Attention Classification Based on Long Short-term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Attention research is of great significance for driver attention monitoring. The biggest problem in existing attention research is that the recognition accuracy cannot be improved. The main reasons include the inability to extract the timing characteristics of the original EEG attention signal. Through designing experimental schemes, collecting original EEG data, training long short-term memory network (LSTM), and comparing various classic algorithms, the accuracy of attention recognition is further improved. Experiments show that LSTM can save the timing characteristics of the original EEG attention signal, which greatly improves the accuracy of attention recognition.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Computer Aided Product Innovation Design System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper starts with a brief introduction of computer-aided product innovation design technology, and then expounds the application of computer-aided product design technology in computer-aided innovation in detail. Then it expounds the hardware design of computer-aided product innovation system; Then it analyzes the application of knowledge resources in the process of computer-aided product innovation design, including the comprehensive utilization of knowledge resources in computer-aided product innovation design and the obstacles to the application of knowledge resources in computer-aided product innovation design. This paper starts with a brief introduction of computer-aided product innovation design technology, and then expounds the application of computer-aided product design technology in computer-aided innovation in detail. Then it analyzes the application of knowledge resources in the process of computer-aided product innovation design, including the comprehensive utilization of knowledge resources in computer-aided product innovation design and the obstacles to the application of knowledge resources in computer-aided product innovation design. Finally, the paper analyzes the product innovation design based on computer-aided innovation technology, including the problems in the process of product innovation design, how to solve the problems encountered in the process of product design, the generation of solutions to the problems in the process of product design and the process of value analysis in product innovation design, in order to make product design stakeholders pay attention to the research and specific research and development process of computer-aided product innovation design system.

articleTitle: Opportunities and Challenges of Educational Psychology under the Influence of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the 21st century, the world has entered the information age, and the Internet has become increasingly popular. At the same time, it is accompanied by various problems. At present, many college students are addicted to the virtual online world and become addicted to the Internet. As a result, they have psychological and physical health problems such as depression, confusion, and autism, and even embark on the road of illegal crimes. This article will give examples to analyze the opportunities and challenges of educational psychology in colleges and universities under the influence of information technology. The author hopes to provide references and suggestions for college students' mental health education.
